[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean soju advertisement poster, realistic premium editorial vertical layout for brand campaign, retail lightbox, and magazine advertising use.
Premium product-poster style emphasizing the chilled bottle, Korean typography, refined lifestyle atmosphere, and responsible adult branding.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: {브랜드명} soju bottle placed slightly left of center, occupying about 38% of frame height, with crisp label visibility, realistic green glass refraction, condensation, cap detail, and a clean recognizable silhouette.
- Supporting human element: {모델 톤} positioned near the bottle as a polished adult lifestyle cue, leaning or seated naturally beside the tabletop, with calm eye line and relaxed campaign-poster presence.
- Background treatment: matte off-white studio-to-bar hybrid backdrop with a faint green gradient wash, soft water-drop texture, translucent condensation bokeh, and subtle reflections from a premium tabletop setting based on {시각 컨셉}.
- Realistic poster contents: include a small campaign badge, date period, venue/sales channel line, QR-style information block, tiny barcode area, responsible drinking notice, and compact production/credit text.
- Text hierarchy: large headline at upper-right or upper-center, product details beneath, campaign/event details in a smaller mid-lower block, and brand information in small footer text.
- Composition feel: refined Korean beverage advertising with layered foreground, product photography depth, readable information zones, and tactile condensation details.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Hero area left 38%: {브랜드명} bottle with dew droplets, lit to show glass reflections, condensation trails, cap highlights, embossed label paper texture, and the deep green bottle palette; bottle stands on a glossy stone or acrylic bar surface with a soft realistic reflection.
- Product environment: add a chilled soju glass beside the bottle, a few melting ice cubes, tiny water beads on the table, and restrained green/coral graphic bubbles that echo freshness without competing with the bottle.
- Model zone lower-mid right: {모델 톤} in a natural adult pose, softly integrated with the campaign scene, wearing clean contemporary styling in off-white, green, or muted coral accents; the model supports the brand mood while the bottle remains the visual hero.
- Copy block upper-right 35%: {카피 한 줄} set as the dominant headline in large Korean type, with {제품명·도수} directly below in smaller, tighter tracking.
- Campaign detail block mid-right: include short Korean poster details such as '출시 기념 캠페인', '2026.05.01 — 05.31', '전국 편의점·마트 판매', and 'QR로 가까운 매장 찾기', arranged like a real printed liquor advertisement.
- Footer information area: {브랜드 정보} arranged as a compact compliance-style line with responsible drinking notice, tiny barcode/QR area, poster number 'AD POSTER NO.231', and small credit text such as '모델: {모델 톤}'.
- Visual accent: a restrained coral highlight appears as a ribbon label, small circular sticker, or underline accent, balanced against the deep green bottle palette and clean white background.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard Bold for the headline, Pretendard SemiBold for product details, Noto Sans KR Regular for brand information; headline size should feel like 72–96px equivalent, with tight leading and modern Korean ad styling.
- Color palette: use deep green, white, and muted coral from {컬러 톤}; support with off-white #F6F4EF, bottle green #1F4B3A, dark text #1A1A1A, accent coral #E88B7A.
- Border/shadow: soft studio drop shadow under the bottle, about 4px vertical offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity; use delicate printed-poster lines, small divider rules, and label-style accents where useful.
- Layout finish: magazine-cover clarity with a realistic printed advertisement hierarchy, premium Korean liquor campaign polish, crisp product edges, tactile paper/glass textures, and believable commercial poster micro-details.
- Information styling: QR and barcode elements should look like printed poster utility marks without implying a real scannable code; supporting text should be small but visually coherent.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: commercial product photography look, 85mm lens at f/4 for bottle clarity, with a slightly longer portrait compression for the model and controlled depth separation.
- Lighting: soft backlight from upper-left with gentle rim light on bottle edges, balanced by a faint front fill; use diffused studio lighting with a clean reflective highlight on the glass and bright sparkle points on condensation.
- Color grade: deep green, clean white, and subtle coral accent with a premium Korean liquor-ad palette; slightly cool shadows and neutral highlights.
- Surface realism: visible condensation droplets, chilled glass fogging, faint tabletop reflection, label paper grain, and soft specular highlights on ice and bottle shoulders.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean liquor campaign — contemporary magazine editorial like a high-end beverage spread from Vogue Korea / Dazed Korea, blended with a realistic retail poster and refined Seoul nightlife freshness.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: must render exactly these strings:
  - {브랜드명}
  - {제품명·도수}
  - {카피 한 줄}
  - {브랜드 정보}
- Supporting Korean poster text should be crisp and readable where used:
  - 출시 기념 캠페인
  - 2026.05.01 — 05.31
  - 전국 편의점·마트 판매
  - QR로 가까운 매장 찾기
  - 성인 인증 후 구매 가능합니다
  - 지나친 음주는 건강에 해롭습니다
  - 모델: {모델 톤}
- The bottle label Korean typography must be crisp, legible, and not distorted.
- Adult-only advertising tone: model must read as clearly 20s or older; no intoxicated, suggestive, or excessive partying cues.
- Keep the bottle as the primary hero object; the model remains secondary.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness

studio:prompts3:ours-230.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean night-time social media visual for a hop-house / pocha, designed as an atmospheric late-night dining poster and Instagram feed image. Create a real venue promo that combines warm food photography, street-side pocha ambience, readable Korean typography, and small practical information a customer would expect to see before visiting.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main venue identity should be anchored by {매장명} in the upper title zone, with the scene built around a late-night table setting, red canopy light, and warm street-side pocha ambience.
- Keep the composition vertical and editorial: top area for headline and date label, mid area for the table spread and venue details, lower area for event copy, SNS handle, hours, contact, and small micro-icons.
- Background treatment: black night base with red canopy fabric, hanging bulb strings, plastic chairs, stainless table edges, condensation on glasses, small menu slip, receipt corner, sauce dishes, chopsticks, napkin holder, street blur, and nearby shop-light reflections.
- Use {배경 디테일} as the environmental anchor, integrating it visibly into the venue background so the image feels like an actual neighborhood night scene.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Header zone (top 15%): place {매장명} as the primary title in large Korean typography, with a compact night-market / pocha poster feeling. Add a small date label such as "2026 NIGHT SEASON", "오늘도 18:00 OPEN", and a tiny issue-style tag "VOL.07 LATE TABLE" near the title.
- Concept line (top-mid 10%): place {컨셉} beneath the title in smaller supporting copy, aligned like a real SNS campaign subtitle. Add 1-2 short Korean blurbs around it, for example "퇴근길 한 접시", "불빛 아래 모이는 밤".
- Hero scene (middle 40%): depict a wide pocha table scene with {배경 디테일}, using realistic tabletop perspective and warm bulb reflections; the atmosphere should feel lively with real venue depth, passing silhouettes in soft blur, wall menu cards, and a glowing storefront sign in the background.
- Food spread zone (middle-lower 20%): arrange {시그니처} naturally across the table and side areas, as if ready for sharing; include side dishes, dipping sauces, metal chopsticks, wet tissue packet, small plates, beer/soju glasses on the table without people holding them, and clear appetizing textures.
- CTA / copy zone (lower 10%): render "{이벤트 한 줄}" in hand-lettered style, slightly angled or brush-script inspired, but still highly legible. Add small practical details nearby: "라스트오더 01:10", "포장 가능", "예약 문의 02-123-4567".
- SNS tag zone (bottom strip): include {인스타·해시} as a compact footer detail, balanced with a small Instagram-card style row: "좋아요 2,318  저장  공유", tiny heart/comment/share/save icons, "서울 밤골목 12 · 매일 18:00-02:00", and a small barcode/QR-like reservation block that reads as graphic detail rather than an official code.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard Bold for the main title, Noto Sans KR Medium for supporting lines, and a hand-drawn brush script 느낌 for the event copy; title size should feel like a poster masthead, supporting text at roughly 30-40% of title scale.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤} with deep charcoal black, warm tungsten yellow, coral-red accents, and soft amber highlights; keep whites slightly creamy rather than pure white.
- Layout details: allow layered sticker labels, menu-ticket strips, tiny price tags, dotted divider lines, receipt-style footer text, small venue map pin icon, and subtle paper texture overlays so the poster feels printed and posted from a real late-night venue.
- Border/shadow: use a subtle 4px lower drop shadow with 12px blur at about 15% opacity for text blocks; allow thin separator lines, soft glow around practical bulbs, and natural table reflections.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 35mm documentary-style street food shot, f/2.8 for the wide scene; use a slightly elevated tabletop angle for the food spread and a wider 24mm feel for the venue environment.
- Lighting: warm practical bulb light from above and slightly right, with soft spill from nearby shop lights; add gentle contrast so the red canopy, stainless tabletop, food textures, condensation, and background signage read clearly at night.
- Color grade: deep black shadows, tungsten amber highlights, muted coral accents, and a slight filmic grain similar to a modern nightlife editorial.
- Realism cues: include natural imperfections such as light fingerprints on a metal cup, tiny sauce marks on a plate edge, folded napkin texture, glossy broth highlights, charcoal grill reflections if relevant, and shallow background bokeh from passing street lights.

[6. MOOD]
Late-night Korean pocha editorial — a Kinfolk-meets-urban-street-photography mood with the sociable energy of a real neighborhood night scene, warm enough to feel inviting and detailed enough to look like an actual venue SNS post.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 표시해야 하는 문구: "{매장명}", "{컨셉}", "{이벤트 한 줄}", "{시그니처}", "{인스타·해시}"
- Additional Korean text must remain crisp and legible: "오늘도 18:00 OPEN", "퇴근길 한 접시", "불빛 아래 모이는 밤", "라스트오더 01:10", "포장 가능", "예약 문의 02-123-4567", "서울 밤골목 12 · 매일 18:00-02:00", "좋아요 2,318  저장  공유".
- Composition rules: adults-only atmosphere only; no intoxicated poses, no drinking-in-hand hero pose, no minors, no sensual framing.
- Food/table rules: emphasize table still-life, shared dishes, and venue ambience; make {시그니처} recognizable, appetizing, and commercially usable with believable night-market textures.
- Typography must be crisp and fully legible in Korean; do not distort or break Hangul characters.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean wine cellar / sommelier recommendation card series, magazine-style vertical poster for Instagram, wine bar menu book, or cellar tasting sheet.
Create a real-looking premium 4-card editorial layout that presents each wine bottle with concise tasting notes, origin details, pairing suggestions, and practical purchase information in a refined sommelier recommendation format.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Overall layout: 4-card series arranged as a polished editorial 2x2 grid, with {레이아웃} guiding the main structure, consistent gutters, and a realistic printed-menu feel.
- Physical scene: show the vertical recommendation sheet as a premium matte paper page photographed on a dark walnut wine bar table, with subtle surrounding cellar details such as corks, a brass wine key, folded tasting memo, faint wine-ring marks, and soft shadows near the page edges.
- Each card: bottle photo occupies the left 42–48% of the card, while the detail text block occupies the right 52–58%, creating a balanced catalog feel with enough room for Korean tasting notes and price lines.
- Header zone: top 12–15% reserved for {브랜드·시리즈} as a prominent magazine-style masthead, with thin gold rules, a small issue/date line, and editorial metadata such as “VOL.247 · 2026년 5월호 · SOMMELIER PICK”.
- Footer zone: include a discreet store/contact strip with Korean microcopy such as “와인 셀러 추천 리스트”, “문의 02-000-0000”, “서울 강남구 와인로 24”, “@winecellar_note”, and a small barcode-style price label area.
- Background treatment: warm cream paper texture with visible subtle grain, deep wine-red accent blocks, fine gold linework, small divider ornaments, and tactile print texture for a refined cellar-inventory look.
- Keep all four cards visually aligned in rhythm, with identical bottle scale logic, framing direction, text hierarchy, and editorial spacing.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Card 1 (top-left): {와인 4종} 중 첫 번째 와인을 realistic bottle cutout or premium bottle photo, placed left; right side shows {카드 디테일} in 4–5 compact lines, plus one small highlight line for style and pairing such as “추천 페어링 · 한우 스테이크”.
- Card 2 (top-right): second wine in the same layout, matching scale and text density, so the series reads as a unified sommelier selection set; include a small tag like “오늘의 셀러 추천” or “BEST WITH CHEESE”.
- Card 3 (bottom-left): third wine, keep bottle height consistent with Card 1; use a small accent label and thin divider line to separate 산지, 품종, 도수, 가격, and 시음 노트.
- Card 4 (bottom-right): fourth wine, similar balance and spacing; include a short pairing suggestion line at the bottom of the text block and a small availability cue such as “잔여 수량 12병”.
- Title treatment: {브랜드·시리즈} appears above the 4-card grid in a premium editorial header, with the series name slightly larger than the body copy and supported by short Korean cover-line text: “이달의 소믈리에 셀렉션”.
- Typography hierarchy: apply {타이포}; each wine name in bold serif, secondary specs in small sans-serif, tasting notes in light-weight text with clear line breaks, and micro labels in small caps 느낌.
- Realistic printed details: include page number “P.04”, section marker “CELLAR NOTE”, small rating-style taste indicators such as “산도 ●●●○○”, “바디 ●●●●○”, and short price examples like “₩38,000”, “₩52,000” where appropriate.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: serif headline in Noto Serif KR or Nanum Myeongjo Bold 28–34px; body in Pretendard or Noto Sans KR Regular 14–18px; captions in 11–12px small caps 느낌; use {타이포} as the primary typographic direction.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤} as the primary palette, supported by off-white #F5F0E8, charcoal #2B2725, muted burgundy #5A1F2B, and metallic gold #B08D57.
- Border/shadow: thin 1px gold rules, soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 14% opacity under each card, plus natural paper-page shadow on the tabletop.
- Card surface: matte paper texture, slightly warm, with crisp alignment, visible print grain, foil-like antique gold accents, and restrained luxury styling.
- Decorative editorial elements: include fine divider lines, small section labels, understated grape-vine line art, cellar inventory numbers, and a barcode/QR-style block rendered as decorative graphic texture rather than a scannable code.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Canon EOS R5 with 85mm f/1.8 lens look, studio product photography for the bottle cutouts, shallow depth of field on the surrounding table props, sharp label area, clean commercial detail.
- Lighting: softbox key light from upper-left at 45°, faint fill from right, controlled specular highlights on glass, realistic reflections on bottle shoulders, readable labels, warm ambient bounce from the wooden table.
- Color grade: deep burgundy + cream ivory + antique gold, with slightly desaturated shadows, polished editorial contrast, and warm cellar-bar atmosphere.
- Material realism: glass bottles should show subtle transparency, curved highlights, foil capsule reflections, paper label fibers, cork texture, and natural contact shadows.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean wine magazine spread — The New York Times Wine School meets Kinfolk editorial layout, photographed as a refined wine cellar tasting menu with mature sommelier catalog atmosphere.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 정확히 렌더되어야 함
  - {브랜드·시리즈}
  - {와인 4종}
  - {카드 디테일}
- Additional Korean text should be short and realistic, such as “이달의 소믈리에 셀렉션”, “와인 셀러 추천 리스트”, “산지”, “품종”, “도수”, “가격”, “시음 노트”, “추천 페어링”, “VOL.247”, “2026년 5월호”, “문의 02-000-0000”, “@winecellar_note”.
- Layout invariants: all 4 cards must remain in a consistent 2x2 series grid, each with bottle on the left and text on the right.
- Keep the tone strictly adult 20+ and editorial; the image should feel like a premium wine bar recommendation menu or sommelier catalog.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness

studio:prompts3:ours-228.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536
- format: Instagram vertical carousel card-news, 7 slides total, 1024x1536 per slide

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean Instagram carousel card-news series for alcohol-and-side-dish pairing, magazine-style food photo layout.
The series introduces {시리즈 제목} with six realistic pairing cards, designed for direct social posting with strong food photography, readable Korean typography, slide indicators, handle, hashtags, save/share micro icons, and a final CTA.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Overall format: 7-card vertical carousel: 1 cover slide + 6 pairing slides, each built as an editorial Instagram food card with a strong hero close-up, caption area, slide number, and social UI details.
- Main subject placement: food and drink duo occupies the central 60–66% of the frame, with a top title area, mid-card pairing label, and footer strip containing handle, hashtag, page indicator, and CTA.
- Background treatment: warm beige paper surface with visible matte grain, faint sauce rings, small salt flakes, crumbs, folded napkin edges, chopsticks, coasters, bottle reflections, and deep-tone accent blocks that change subtly by pairing.
- Instagram card details: include {계정명} at the upper-left or footer, small save/share/comment line icons, hashtag-style text using {해시태그}, and a carousel page mark such as 01/07, 02/07, etc.
- Content system: use {시리즈 제목}, {페어링 목록}, {톤·컬러}, {타이포}, {발행일}, {계정명}, {CTA 문구}, {해시태그}, {브랜드명}, and {비율} as the design source.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Slide 1 / cover: headline-led opener with {시리즈 제목} in large Korean type, a compact collage of two or three representative pairings, date label {발행일}, account label {계정명}, page indicator 01/07, and a small editorial tag reading “PAIRING NOTE”.
- Slide 2: 막걸리×김치전. Show a cloudy ceramic makgeolli cup beside a golden kimchi pancake with crisp edges, red kimchi flecks, soy dipping dish, scallion pieces, and chopsticks. Add a short pairing comment and page indicator 02/07.
- Slide 3: 소주×삼겹살. Show a clear soju glass and grilled pork belly slices with sear marks, sesame oil salt dish, garlic, ssamjang, lettuce edge, steam, and glossy fat highlights. Keep title block strong and left-weighted, page indicator 03/07.
- Slide 4: 맥주×치킨. Show a chilled beer glass with condensation and fried chicken pieces with craggy batter texture, pickled radish cube, sauce cup, and amber accent shape. Add compact pairing note, page indicator 04/07.
- Slide 5: 와인×치즈 플래터. Show a stemmed wine glass, cheese wedges, grapes, nuts, dried fruit, cracker fragments, and a small cheese knife on a linen cloth. Make it premium and balanced, page indicator 05/07.
- Slide 6: 위스키×다크 초콜릿. Show lowball whiskey glass with ice, dark chocolate squares, cacao nibs, toasted nuts, moody brown shadow, and subtle rim light. Use a darker editorial palette, page indicator 06/07.
- Slide 7 / end card: 사케×사시미. Show a small sake cup, carafe, sashimi slices on a pale ceramic plate, wasabi, shiso leaf, ginger, and a refined light-toned surface. Include final CTA band with {CTA 문구}, {계정명}, {해시태그}, save/share micro icons, and page indicator 07/07.
- Text hierarchy on every slide: drink name first, food name second, one-line pairing comment third, social footer last.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: title in bold sans-serif such as Pretendard ExtraBold or Noto Sans KR Bold, 42–56px range; accent phrases in hand-drawn or brush-script style at 20–28px; body note in Pretendard Medium 22–26px; footer metadata in Pretendard SemiBold 16–20px.
- Color palette: {톤·컬러}; base colors warm beige #F4EBDD, cream #FFF8EF, deep brown #4A342C, charcoal #222222, muted wine #7A3E3A, olive #78866B, amber #C98B2B, ink gray #3A332E.
- Card decoration: soft editorial shadow 0px 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.12), thin divider line in #D8CBB8, subtle rounded corners 28px, sticker-like slide number tab, small handwritten pairing memo, and tiny social icons in line-art style.
- Graphic rhythm: each slide uses one deep-tone accent block, one small circular or ribbon label, and a footer metadata row so the carousel feels like a cohesive saved Instagram guide.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 50mm or 85mm prime food photography look, f/2.8 for shallow depth of field on the hero dish; top-down only for the cover collage if needed.
- Lighting: soft diffused studio light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from right, slight specular highlights on glass, ice, sauce, oil, and glossy food surfaces.
- Color grade: warm cream base with deep-toned accents, slightly desaturated magazine food editorial finish, natural food contrast, realistic reflections, and tactile paper-and-tableware texture.

[6. MOOD]
Premium food editorial Instagram carousel — like a Korean magazine pairing guide with appetizing close-up photography, practical saved-post utility, warm home-bar atmosphere, and polished card-news design.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 렌더해야 하는 문구:
  - 이 술엔 이 안주 — 술별 페어링 가이드 6가지
  - 막걸리×김치전
  - 소주×삼겹살
  - 맥주×치킨
  - 와인×치즈 플래터
  - 위스키×다크 초콜릿
  - 사케×사시미
  - 궁합 포인트
  - 저장하고 오늘 메뉴 고르기
  - @prompts3
  - #안주페어링 #홈술메뉴 #푸드가이드
  - 2026.05.01
  - 01/07, 02/07, 03/07, 04/07, 05/07, 06/07, 07/07
- All 7 slides must keep the same editorial structure, accurate Korean typography, readable hierarchy, consistent footer metadata, and Instagram save/share/comment micro icons.
- Food should look appetizing and realistic, with responsible adult dining context, no intoxication cues, no binge drinking, and no explicit drinking behavior.
- Maintain vertical 1024x1536 readability for mobile viewing; text must remain legible at Instagram carousel scale.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[1. PURPOSE]
Japanese izakaya interior visual and menu-board poster for an adult sake bar, combining a refined store atmosphere with organized food and sake listings, store information, and reservation details.
Designed as a vertical brand/menu composition that feels like a premium Tokyo neighborhood izakaya editorial, suitable for storefront display, social promotion, and printed menu signage.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Subject placement: {매장명} signage sits in the upper 16% as the visual anchor, counter and bottle display occupy the middle 50%, and the menu / store-info block fills the lower 34% with a readable price hierarchy.
- Background treatment: warm wood interior, indigo noren curtains, washi paper texture, handwritten reservation tags, small ceramic dishes, chopstick rests, soy sauce cruet, and red lantern accents; wall surfaces should feel matte, slightly weathered, and lived-in.
- Framing: front-facing vertical poster composition with a slight depth perspective into the counter area; include layered shelves, hanging menu slips, and a believable izakaya counter rhythm.
- The visual identity should balance store atmosphere and menu readability, with {컨셉} expressed through interior props, bottle arrangement, seasonal recommendation tags, and menu typography.
- Use {매장명}, {컨셉}, {사케 셀렉션}, {안주 메뉴}, {오늘추천}, {주소}, {연락처}, {영업시간}, {예약문구}, {좌석정보}, and {컬러 톤} placeholders as the exact content variables to be rendered.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Top header zone: place {매장명} as a crisp Japanese-inspired signage area, pairing kanji/japanese-style lettering with Korean text directly beneath it; add a small subtitle line reading {컨셉} and a discreet red lantern icon-like graphic.
2) Hero interior zone: show a compact izakaya counter scene with wood grain, red lantern glow, noren curtains, washi paper screens, stacked masu cups, ceramic tokkuri, small appetizer plates, folded cloth napkins, and handwritten daily-special strips.
3) Sake display zone: on the counter and back shelf, place Japanese sake bottles and tokkuri vessels with clean labels matching {사케 셀렉션}; make each label legible and spaced like a curated seasonal shelf display.
4) Menu zone: compose {안주 메뉴} in a neat grid with Korean names, occasional Japanese-style side labels, clear won prices, small category dividers, and thin charcoal rules; include a highlighted box for {오늘추천}.
5) Store info zone: add a grounded footer panel with {주소}, {연락처}, {영업시간}, {좌석정보}, and {예약문구}; include small micro-icons for location, phone, clock, and reservation without overpowering the menu.
6) Accent zone: use the palette from {컬러 톤} for lanterns, shadows, trim, stamped-looking category labels, menu dividers, and subtle edge highlights; keep the contrast editorial and atmospheric.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Noto Sans KR for Korean body text, Pretendard SemiBold for menu headings, and a Japanese mincho-style serif for kanji labels; header size should feel like 42–56px equivalent, body text 22–28px equivalent, footer info 16–20px equivalent.
- Color palette: anchor with black ink, indigo navy, warm wood brown, vermilion red, and rice-paper ivory from {컬러 톤}; whites should feel warm like washi paper.
- Dividers / shadow: use thin charcoal divider lines, small red category tabs, stamped menu markers, and soft shadows with 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity under bottles, plates, and menu blocks.
- Surface finish: matte paper menu texture, subtle fiber grain, lightly aged wood, brushed ceramic glaze, condensation on chilled glassware, and gentle lantern bloom.
- Menu realism: prices should align consistently, item spacing should feel like an actual shop menu, and footer details should read as practical storefront information.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 35mm full-frame look, f/4, front-facing interior editorial framing with mild depth of field separation between counter objects and background.
- Lighting: warm practical lantern light from the upper-right, soft ambient fill from the left, and a faint bounce off the wood counter; highlights remain gentle and controlled.
- Color grade: indigo shadows, warm amber lantern highlights, muted red accents, creamy paper whites, realistic wood browns, and restrained saturation.
- Rendering detail: sharp enough for menu legibility, with natural imperfections such as paper fibers, tiny wood scratches, bottle label texture, and ceramic reflections.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Japanese izakaya editorial — a Tokyo backstreet sake bar poster with the polished restraint of Kinfolk and the atmospheric warmth of a Nobu-style dining interior, but with practical Korean menu-board clarity.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 렌더해야 할 문자열 — "월담 이자카야", "제철 사케 셀렉션 + 일본 가정식 안주", "月の桂 純米吟醸", "八海山 純米", "獺祭 39", "久保田 千寿", "大七 生酛", "다시마키 6,000", "야끼토리 8,000", "사시미 모듬 22,000", "가라아게 9,500", "시메사바 11,000", "우메슈 절임", "오늘의 추천: 시소향 사시미와 준마이 긴죠 페어링", "서울 마포구 동교로 27길 18", "02-3144-0927", "18:00–01:00 / 일요일 휴무", "바 10석 · 테이블 4개", "예약 및 단체 문의 환영".
- Layout invariants: menu text must remain aligned in rows and columns; prices should sit on the right side of each item; bottle labels must be readable; all listed sake items should appear as a curated set.
- Store realism: include address, contact, hours, seating note, recommendation callout, small dividers, and footer information as part of the designed menu poster.
- Adult-only presentation: keep the scene focused on refined dining, pairing culture, and venue atmosphere, with no intoxication-centered behavior.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or recognizable real-person likenesses
- Underage-associated cues or youthful drinking imagery

studio:prompts3:ours-226.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
수제맥주 펍 매장 광고용 세로 포스터.
산업적 무드의 브루어리 인테리어와 탭 라인업을 전면에 보여주면서, 실제 매장 입구와 SNS 공지 이미지에 동시에 쓰일 법한 이벤트 정보, 영업 안내, 푸드 페어링, 예약 정보, 협업 라벨까지 담은 현실적인 매장 홍보 비주얼.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 전체 구도는 세로형 1024x1536 포스터로, 상단 15%는 매장명 헤더와 슬로건, 중앙 55%는 바 카운터와 탭 라인업, 하단 20%는 안주 테이블·행사 안내·예약 정보·협찬 라벨 영역이 자연스럽게 차지하도록 구성한다.
- 메인 바 카운터는 화면 중앙 하단을 가로지르며, 황동 탭 핸들이 가장 눈에 띄게 배치되고 배경의 칠판 메뉴 보드, 작은 공연 포스터, 천장 행잉 글라스, 우드 선반의 병과 캔, 벽면 스티커와 코스터가 깊이감을 만든다.
- 전체 배경은 다크 우드 패널, 브릭 또는 콘크리트 질감, 은은한 연무감이 섞인 실내 조명으로 채우고, 바닥과 벽면에는 오래된 펍 특유의 사용감, 금속 브라켓, 케이블 조명, 손글씨 메뉴 흔적, 맥주 얼룩이 묻은 코스터와 작은 계산 영수증을 더한다.
- 모든 텍스트는 {매장명}, {슬로건}, {컨셉}, {탭 라인업}을 기준으로 정확한 한글·영문 타이포가 읽히도록 배치하되, 실제 광고 포스터처럼 {이벤트명}, {이벤트일시}, {영업시간}, {주소}, {예약문의}, {대표가격}, {페어링세트}, {협업문구}, {해시태그}도 함께 포함한다.
- 포스터 가장자리에는 작은 이벤트 정보 블록, 티켓형 쿠폰 박스, 협업 로고 영역처럼 보이는 라벨 스트립, 얇은 황동 라인 디바이더를 넣어 인쇄물의 현실감을 높인다.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Header area (top 15%): {매장명}을 가장 크게 배치하고, 그 아래에 {슬로건}과 {컨셉}을 보조 카피처럼 작게 넣는다. 검은 칠판 위 흰 분필 타이포 또는 밝은 아이보리 서체로 대비를 강하게 주며, 오른쪽 상단에는 작은 스탬프형 라벨로 “{이벤트명}”, “{이벤트일시}”, “{영업시간}”을 넣는다. 헤더 한쪽에는 “BREWED IN SEOUL”, “SMALL BATCH ON TAP” 같은 짧은 영문 보조 문구를 작게 배치한다.
- Main bar zone (middle 35%): 긴 카운터 위에 황동 탭 핸들 8~10개를 일렬로 세우고, 각 탭에 {탭 라인업}의 라벨이 정확하게 보이도록 배치한다. 라벨은 반듯하게 정렬하고 서로 겹치지 않게 하며, 탭 아래에는 작은 가격표 형태로 “{대표가격}”, “TASTER 4종 12,000원”, “TODAY’S PICK”, “NEW BATCH” 같은 짧은 안내를 넣는다. 탭 핸들마다 IPA는 호박색, 페일에일은 밝은 골드, 흑맥은 짙은 브라운, 바이젠은 탁한 밀색처럼 액체 색 차이를 보여준다.
- Background zone (upper-middle 20%): {배경 디테일}을 활용해 천장에서는 유리잔이 매달리고, 뒤편 벽에는 칠판 메뉴 보드가 보이게 하며, 우드 선반과 금속 브라켓으로 인더스트리얼 구조감을 강화한다. 칠판에는 읽히는 짧은 한국어 문구로 “오늘의 게스트 탭”, “로컬 브루어리 협업”, “라스트 오더 23:30”, “한정 배치 입고”를 적고, 작은 양조장 일러스트, 홉 콘, 보리 이삭 드로잉을 장식처럼 넣는다. 배경 깊은 곳에는 잔을 닦는 바텐더와 대화 중인 손님 실루엣을 흐릿하게 넣어 실제 영업 중인 느낌을 만든다.
- Foreground table zone (bottom 20%): 테이블 위에 {안주 디테일}을 실제 펍 푸드처럼 가지런히 놓고, 종이 받침, 금속 트레이, 작은 소스볼, 냅킨, 맥주 받침, 반쯤 찬 파인트 글라스, 수분감 있는 맥주 거품과 어울리는 따뜻한 색감을 준다. 하단 정보 패널에는 “{페어링세트}”, “{예약문의}”, “{주소}”, “입장 무료 · 한정 탭 소진 시 종료”를 작은 글씨로 넣는다.
- Event and sponsor detail pass: 포스터 하단 또는 오른쪽 세로 스트립에 “TAP TAKEOVER”, “DJ SET 20:00”, “스탬프 카드 제공”, “{협업문구}”, “현장 결제 가능”, “단체 예약 환영”을 넣고, 협찬 영역처럼 보이는 작은 사각 박스 2~3개에는 추상 로고마크와 “LOCAL MALT”, “PUB FRIENDS”, “YEAST LAB” 같은 비공식 텍스트를 배치한다. 하단 모서리에는 티켓 절취선처럼 보이는 작은 쿠폰 박스를 만들고 “첫 잔 1,000원 할인”, “카운터 제시”를 넣는다.
- Surface detail pass: 바 상판에는 미세한 물방울, 금속 광택, 나뭇결, 잔의 반사광, 맥주 거품의 크리미한 질감, 사용감 있는 코스터와 메뉴 카드의 종이 질감, 작게 말린 영수증, 분필 가루, 얼룩진 펍 매트, 소스가 살짝 묻은 그리스프루프 페이퍼를 넣어 실내의 실제감을 높인다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard SemiBold for {매장명}, Pretendard Regular or Noto Sans KR for {슬로건}, {컨셉}, and {탭 라인업}; 헤더는 42~60px급의 강한 대비, 서브카피는 18~24px 수준으로 정돈된 산세리프. 이벤트 정보는 condensed sans 또는 칠판 손글씨 스타일을 섞어 실제 펍 포스터처럼 보이게 한다.
- Korean text blocks: Set small poster text in Korean: “오늘의 추천 탭”, “한정 배치 입고”, “페어링 플레이트”, “예약 가능”, “라스트 오더 23:30”, “첫 잔 1,000원 할인”, “단체 예약 환영”. All Korean must be clean, legible, and naturally spaced.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤}을 기반으로 #8C5A2B brass, #3B2A1F dark wood, #2F4A3F chalkboard green, #F2E7D2 warm ivory, #111111 near-black accents. 맥주 액체에는 호박색, 밀맥주 골드, 스타우트 브라운, 사워 맥주의 옅은 핑크 골드를 섞어 탭별 차이를 만든다.
- Border/shadow: 포스터 가장자리에 아주 얇은 다크 브라운 프레임을 두고, 탭 핸들과 글라스에는 soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 18% opacity를 적용한다. 정보 패널은 인쇄된 종이 라벨처럼 살짝 낡은 가장자리와 미세한 잉크 번짐이 보이게 한다.
- Decorative graphic elements: 홉 콘, 보리 이삭, 맥주 거품 라인, 얇은 황동 라인 디바이더, 작은 화살표, 원형 배지, 티켓 절취선, 칠판 메뉴 박스를 사용해 시선을 헤더에서 탭 라인업, 하단 행사 정보로 자연스럽게 이동시킨다.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 35mm full-frame documentary interior shot, f/2.8, slight perspective from eye level with a subtle downward angle to capture the bar top and back wall in one frame.
- Lighting: warm tungsten practical lights mixed with soft overhead diffused fill, plus a gentle rim light from the left to make brass taps and glassware sparkle; shadow areas remain rich and moody.
- Color grade: amber highlights, deep espresso browns, muted green chalkboard tones, low-saturation industrial pub grade with cinematic contrast.
- Material realism: brushed brass, wet glass, chalk dust, scratched dark wood, matte black metal, folded paper menu, greaseproof food paper, frothy beer foam, condensation on cold pints, printed poster paper grain, and slightly worn sticker labels should all be visible.

[6. MOOD]
Premium neighborhood brewery poster — a mix of Kinfolk interior editorial and Eater bar-feature photography, with the grounded realism of a Japanese craft-beer taproom. Lively but grown-up, warm, local, slightly smoky, and full of practical details that make the pub feel open tonight: the taps are cold, the food is ready, and the event is about to start.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문자열: {매장명}, {슬로건}, {컨셉}, {탭 라인업}, {이벤트명}, {이벤트일시}, {영업시간}, {주소}, {예약문의}
- 탭 라벨은 {탭 라인업}의 각 항목이 개별적으로 또렷하게 읽혀야 하며, 철자·띄어쓰기·한글/영문 혼용이 깨지면 안 된다.
- 추가로 보이는 포스터 문구는 “오늘의 추천 탭”, “한정 배치 입고”, “페어링 플레이트”, “예약 가능”, “라스트 오더 23:30”, “{대표가격}”, “{페어링세트}”, “첫 잔 1,000원 할인”, “카운터 제시”, “{해시태그}”처럼 짧고 현실적인 매장 광고 문구로 구성한다.
- 매장 내부 구조는 성인용 펍 분위기로 유지하고, 과음·취한 사람·미성년자 연상 요소는 넣지 않는다.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

[INPUT]

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean whiskey bar and lounge atmosphere editorial, wide interior scene for magazine-style promotion.
Dark wood premium lounge environment with bottle display, conversational guests, tasting culture, and realistic hospitality details for a refined promotional spread.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Wide 16:9 composition with {매장명} as the visual anchor across the middle 60% of the frame, integrated as a brushed brass wall sign or softly backlit lettering above the central bar.
- Left and right seating zones frame the center counter; the bottle display stays sharply readable on the back counter shelf, with premium glassware, menu cards, pairing plates, and warm table lamps adding depth.
- Background treatment: dark wood paneling, deep green upholstery, copper accents, amber practical lights, leather Chesterfield sofa, ceiling-height bookshelf-style whiskey cellar, vintage globe, candles, framed tasting notes, decanter silhouettes, and {배경 디테일} woven naturally into the room.
- Add editorial poster details within the scene: a small tabletop reservation card reading “오늘의 테이스팅”, a slim brass placard with “2026.05 라운지 셀렉션”, and a subtle lower-corner magazine-style label reading “BAR GUIDE VOL.247”.
- Include 2 adult guests in their 30s wearing a mix of suit and smart casual, seated and talking naturally; one may rest a hand near a nosing glass on the table while the other reviews a tasting menu.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Foreground (bottom 18%): polished wood counter edge with realistic reflections, a copper jigger, leather coaster, folded napkin, cut crystal tumbler, small candle, water carafe, and a printed tasting menu card reading “페어링 노트 / 다크 초콜릿 · 견과 · 스모크”.
- Midground (center 50%): {매장명} lounge seating with leather Chesterfield sofa, muted deep green textiles, brass table bases, marble-topped side tables, two adults in natural conversation poses, and a small pairing plate with dark chocolate and roasted nuts.
- Product line (upper-mid 20%): {시그니처 셀렉션} bottles arranged on the counter and back shelf, labels fully visible and crisp, varied in height and glass tone like a real curated whiskey lineup with believable reflections and refractions.
- Background (top 30%): bookshelf-like whiskey cellar structure reaching toward the ceiling, vintage globe, catalog tags, warm ambient lamps, framed menu board, bottle ladder rail, and architectural wood grain visible across shelves and wall panels.
- Atmosphere layer: warm amber backlight from behind bottles, subtle haze only enough to catch highlights, cinematic shadow structure emphasizing wood grain, leather texture, brass edges, candlelight, and glass contours.
- Branding clarity: {매장명} and {시그니처 셀렉션} must read exactly and cleanly, with no distortions or partial occlusion; supporting Korean copy may include “프라이빗 테이스팅”, “예약 문의”, “시그니처 페어링”, and “마감 01:00”.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard and Noto Sans KR, bold for main brand emphasis, medium for supporting copy, size hierarchy suitable for a landscape editorial poster; crisp sans-serif with high legibility.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤} anchored by deep walnut brown #3B2A22, forest green #1F3A2E, copper #B46A3C, amber #C98B3B, and warm cream highlights #E8DDCB.
- Border/shadow: soft realistic shadow under bottles and furniture, 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity; highlights should feel like polished wood and glass rather than glossy plastic.
- Add layered hospitality graphics as real objects: cream menu paper, brass table number, tiny reservation tag, bottle neck labels, and a discreet lower-third editorial caption reading “{컨셉} · {비율}”.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame interior editorial look, 24mm tilt-shift lens at f/5.6 for straight architectural lines and balanced depth across the lounge.
- Lighting: warm practical lamps mixed with amber backlight behind the bottle shelf, plus soft diffused fill from front-left at 45° to preserve label readability and face detail.
- Color grade: dark mahogany + deep green + copper amber, with controlled contrast and slightly muted blacks, like a premium hospitality spread in Wallpaper* or Kinfolk.
- Material realism: visible walnut grain, worn leather creases, cut-crystal facets, brushed brass patina, candle wax texture, linen napkins, paper menu fibers, and subtle fingerprints on glass where appropriate.

[6. MOOD]
Premium whiskey lounge editorial — Aesop-like restraint mixed with a luxe hotel bar atmosphere, cinematic but composed, warm enough to feel like a real evening service with quiet conversation and curated tasting rituals.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: {매장명}, {컨셉}, {시그니처 셀렉션}, {컬러 톤}, {배경 디테일}, {비율} must appear exactly if text is rendered.
- Render supporting Korean text cleanly if used: “오늘의 테이스팅”, “프라이빗 테이스팅”, “시그니처 페어링”, “예약 문의”, “페어링 노트”, “다크 초콜릿 · 견과 · 스모크”, “2026.05 라운지 셀렉션”.
- Bottle labels must stay readable and unwarped; no bottle duplication errors.
- Guests must look like adults in their 30s with relaxed, refined behavior; no youth-like features or drunken behavior.
- Interior geometry should remain realistic with straight shelves, clean counter lines, believable spatial depth, and consistent reflections across wood, brass, leather, and glass.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]

- Broken Korean characters

Focus on an adult-only Korean traditional pub atmosphere with elegant interior styling, readable Korean typography, appetizing shared dishes, signature bottle labels, and realistic shop information that feels ready for an actual opening campaign.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: {매장명} as the hero brand environment, occupying the middle 65% of the frame with the entrance, counter, and seating area clearly visible.
- Composition: vertical editorial poster layout, slightly angled interior view, with strong depth from foreground tabletop items to background hanok architecture; the viewer should feel like they are standing just inside the doorway before dinner service.
- Background treatment: modern hanok interior with exposed wood beams, hanji paper windows, stacked earthenware jars, brass tableware, hanging warm bulbs, handwritten menu slips, and small paper lantern details on warm textured surfaces.
- Place {컨셉} as the design direction across the interior styling, menu board, bottle shelf, table settings, and overall brand mood.

- Counter/table zone (lower middle 22%): place clearly legible bottles of {시그니처 술} on the counter or table, with crisp labels facing camera and soft reflections on wood grain; add a small bottle-neck tag reading “오늘의 추천주”.

- Menu/pricelist insert: include a vertical paper menu card on the table or wall with store name, 4 items, and prices: “해물파전 ₩18,000”, “낙지볶음 ₩24,000”, “도토리묵 ₩15,000”, “달빛 막걸리 ₩9,000”.

- Color palette: earthy brown, soot black, warm rice-paper beige, muted amber, brass gold, and soft lacquer red, matching {컬러 톤}.
- Border/shadow: soft realistic shadow under bottles, dishes, paper menu cards, and brass cups, 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity; subtle vignette only at edges.
- Surface treatment: tactile wood grain, matte ceramic, slightly fibrous hanji texture, aged brass, woven coaster texture, condensation on chilled makgeolli bottles, and natural brush-ink print marks; avoid a glossy restaurant-flyer look.

Premium traditional Korean tavern editorial — a refined Kinfolk hospitality spread mixed with a modern hanok lounge atmosphere, suitable for a late-evening adult dining destination and a carefully designed makgeolli bar launch poster.

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean traditional liquor label and packaging design mockup, front-facing bottle presentation for premium retail use.
Modernized hanji-and-ink aesthetic for a makgeolli / traditional liquor product, suitable for shelf display, online store product detail pages, and brand presentation with realistic retail packaging cues.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: a single front-facing bottle mockup centered and occupying about 55% of the frame height, with the label fully readable and the cap aligned vertically.
- Composition: product hero in the middle with a matching paper carton or sleeve placed slightly behind the bottle, plus small realistic packaging details such as a neck tag, label edge texture, batch code, volume line, and a quiet lower information strip.
- Background treatment: warm off-white hanji paper surface with visible fibrous grain, subtle deckled paper edges, faint ink-wash staining, and a tactile premium craft-paper atmosphere.
- Framing direction: refined studio product layout with the full bottle silhouette visible, label edges sharp, and surrounding package elements supporting the premium traditional liquor identity.
- Use {술 종류}, {브랜드명}, {제품명·도수}, {라벨 톤}, {모티프}, {설명 카피 한 줄}, {병 형태} placeholders.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Bottle hero area (center 55%): render a transparent glass bottle with a short neck, filled appropriately for {술 종류}, using {병 형태}; the bottle must be front-facing, crisp, and proportionally elegant, with realistic glass thickness, liquid meniscus, condensation-free clarity, and controlled studio reflections.
2. Label area (lower center on bottle): place {브랜드명} as the main brand mark and {제품명·도수} as the primary product title; build the label with {라벨 톤} and make the typography feel like a refined modern Korean craft liquor label.
3. Motif area (label ornament): integrate {모티프} as a restrained line illustration, hand-ink motif, or seal-inspired graphic aligned to the label geometry, supporting the text without becoming an official-looking certification mark.
4. Copy area (small secondary text): place {설명 카피 한 줄} below the main title in a smaller, quieter line; maintain generous tracking and clear hierarchy.
5. Retail information area: add realistic small label text blocks in Korean, including “대한민국 전통주”, “750ml”, “원료: 쌀, 누룩, 물”, “냉장보관”, “LOT 0526”, “제조일자 2026.05.01”, and a small barcode-style rectangle on the lower side label or carton panel.
6. Packaging feel area: suggest premium traditional packaging through paper grain, ink density, subtle label edge detail, a matching carton sleeve behind the bottle, a small hanging neck tag, and printed side-panel microcopy.
7. Surface/shadow area: add a soft realistic drop shadow beneath the bottle and carton, with slight contact darkening on the hanji surface and a natural product-photography tabletop feel.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use a mixed system of bold hand-brushed Korean calligraphy for the brand headline, Noto Sans KR or Pretendard for secondary copy, and a restrained serif-like structure for product information; headline weight should feel strong but refined, with secondary text around 24–36px equivalent and product title around 42–64px equivalent.
- Color palette: hanji ivory #F4EFE5, ink black #111111, warm gray #B8B1A7, muted jade #7C8A78, soft charcoal #2B2B2B, and a faint rice-wine amber tint if needed.
- Border/shadow: thin ink rules, subtle label frame lines, hand-printed registration marks, light paper embossing, and a soft drop shadow with about 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity; avoid harsh bevels or plastic-looking glossy sticker effects.
- Packaging details: include small vertical side text, fine ingredient microcopy, a simple barcode area, recycled-paper texture, tasteful ink bleed, and a matching carton/sleeve design that repeats {브랜드명} and {모티프} in a smaller scale.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: studio product photography look, 85mm lens at f/8 for a clean front product mockup with crisp label edges and minimal distortion.
- Lighting: softbox key light from upper-left at about 45°, gentle fill from right, and a very subtle rear rim to define the glass edges; keep reflections controlled and realistic across curved glass, cap, paper label, and carton.
- Color grade: warm cream + ink black + muted stone gray with a restrained traditional-paper tone, similar to premium editorial product packaging photography.
- Material rendering: emphasize transparent glass, milky or amber liquor depending on {술 종류}, slightly porous hanji label stock, matte carton paper, printed ink absorption, and a finely textured tabletop surface.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean craft spirits editorial — like an Aesop-style packaging still with a traditional hanji print sensibility, museum-shop retail realism, and the quiet tactility of a contemporary artisan distillery.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following verbatim Korean strings must appear correctly in the rendered image: {브랜드명}, {제품명·도수}, {설명 카피 한 줄}.
- Additional Korean text must be clean and legible where visible: “대한민국 전통주”, “750ml”, “원료: 쌀, 누룩, 물”, “냉장보관”, “LOT 0526”, “제조일자 2026.05.01”.
- Label readability: all Hangul and any included Hanja-style details must be clean, correctly formed, and fully legible.
- Bottle layout: the bottle must remain front-facing with the label centered and not warped; preserve a single-product hero mockup presentation while allowing the carton, neck tag, barcode area, and paper texture to enrich the packaging context.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean cocktail bar signature menu card, magazine-style SNS visual, vertical poster for adult bar promotion.
Four signature drinks are presented as a polished editorial menu/pricelist with realistic cocktail photography, clear pricing, store details, social tags, and refined late-night bar atmosphere suitable for Instagram feed or story promotion.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main composition: a premium 4-item cocktail menu card with {매장명} at the top, a compact concept line using {컨셉}, four drink entries arranged in an editorial grid, and {인스타·태그} anchored in a social footer.
- Subject placement: top 15% contains masthead, date/edition label, and concept subtitle; middle 68–72% contains four signature drink modules; lower 12–15% contains address/contact, booking note, small icons, and the social tag footer.
- Background treatment: {배경} rendered as a dark tactile bar surface with realistic wood grain, brushed metal reflections, condensation rings, cocktail napkins, citrus peel, stirrer shadows, glass highlights, and warm candle glow; keep all details atmospheric while preserving legibility.
- Framing and density: poster-like vertical layout with believable printed-menu details, thin dividers, small microcopy, corner labels, tiny QR/barcode-style reservation block, and subtle decorative linework that feels like a real bar menu photographed for SNS.
- Use {매장명}, {컨셉}, {시그니처 4종}, {컬러 톤}, {배경}, {인스타·태그} placeholders throughout the layout.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header area: Place {매장명} as the main masthead centered near the top in a magazine-cover/menu-board style, with a refined subtitle line using {컨셉} beneath it. Add small realistic labels such as "SIGNATURE MENU", "VOL.024", "2026.05", and "SEOUL NIGHT BAR GUIDE" near the header.
2. Store information strip: Under the subtitle or along the lower header edge, include compact Korean microcopy such as "영업 18:00–02:00", "서울 용산구 한강대로 24길 7", "예약 02-0000-2026", and "테이블 차지 별도" in small readable type.
3. Menu grid: Split the central area into four drink cards for the four items in {시그니처 4종}; each card should contain a realistic drink photo, a Korean name line, an English name line, a short tasting note, and the price line, all arranged consistently.
4. Drink photo treatment: Make each drink image look like a tightly cropped premium bar photograph with visible glass silhouette, ice clarity, condensation, garnish detail, cocktail pick or peel, and reflections from nearby candles. Each drink should have a distinct vessel and color while sharing the same editorial system.
5. Drink content details: Add short Korean tasting notes such as "유자·레몬필·부드러운 산미", "스모크 오크·비터·오렌지 제스트", "리치·라임·은은한 허브", and "에스프레소·카카오·크림 폼" below the English names in smaller type.
6. Visual emphasis: Use the drink colors as the main visual accents against the dark setting, so citrus yellow, smoky brown, lychee pink, and espresso dark tones stand out clearly with copper-gold highlights and controlled amber reflections.
7. Footer area: Set {인스타·태그} at the bottom in a neat social-footer strip with tiny save/share/comment-style micro icons, a small reservation QR/barcode area, and compact CTA text such as "오늘의 바 좌석 예약" and "DM 예약 가능".

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for Korean text, paired with a clean sans-serif for English; title in semi-bold 700–800, menu names in 500–600, prices in 600, size hierarchy clearly visible at poster scale.
- Color palette: {컬러 톤} plus supporting tones like deep charcoal #111318, warm copper #B87333, muted gold #C8A96A, candle amber #D6A15F, smoky navy #0B111A, and cream paper text #E8DDC9.
- Graphic details: thin hairline dividers, copper corner marks, small section labels, subtle embossed menu-card edges, realistic paper grain, faint glass-ring stains, matte poster texture, and refined menu icons for ice, citrus, smoke, and coffee.
- Border/shadow: thin hairline dividers, soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity for drink cards and text blocks; avoid heavy neon bleed.
- Layout finish: editorial crispness, premium menu realism, clean alignment, layered bar-surface texture, and high contrast for readability.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: premium beverage photography look, 85mm f/1.8 for the drink cutouts and 50mm f/2.0 for the overall menu scene, crisp focus on the glasses and menu text.
- Lighting: low-key studio lighting with soft key light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from front-right, and a subtle rim light to catch glass edges, condensation, metal jigger reflections, and glossy liquid surfaces.
- Color grade: deep navy shadows, copper-gold highlights, warm amber candle reflections, restrained neon accent from a small background sign, and rich blacks that keep detail in wood, glass, and printed paper.
- Realism: make the final image feel like a professionally styled cocktail menu photographed on an actual bar counter, with believable print texture, slight perspective depth, natural reflections, and sharp readable Korean typography.

[6. MOOD]
Premium cocktail editorial — a refined late-night Seoul lounge atmosphere, combining magazine-style bar guide design, tactile printed menu details, candlelit wood, polished glassware, and sophisticated adult after-dark energy.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 렌더될 문자열 — "Mood Lab", "시그니처 트위스트 칵테일 + 어쿠스틱 무드", "Yuzu Sour", "18,000", "Smoky Old Fashioned", "22,000", "Lychee Gimlet", "17,000", "Espresso Espresso", "19,000", "@moodlab.kr · #moodlab".
- Each of the 4 drink entries must show one Korean name line, one English name line, one short Korean tasting note, and one price line, consistently aligned across the grid.
- Include realistic menu/pricelist details in Korean: "SIGNATURE MENU", "VOL.024", "2026.05", "영업 18:00–02:00", "서울 용산구 한강대로 24길 7", "예약 02-0000-2026", "DM 예약 가능".
- Adult bar atmosphere only, presented as responsible premium lounge promotion with clear prices and readable SNS/menu information.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]

- Broken Korean characters
- Unauthorized celebrity likeness or composite portraits

[1. PURPOSE]
Wine bar SNS main visual in a magazine-editorial style, horizontal hero image for social media cover, Instagram feed announcement, and reservation promotion use.
Premium dining-space atmosphere with natural wine selection, designed to highlight venue identity, signature pours, opening hours, location, and social handle at a glance.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Wide horizontal composition with the dining room occupying about 70% of the frame, while editorial typography is layered naturally across the upper-left brand area and lower-right reservation area.
- The interior should feel upscale but approachable: warm wood paneling, dim pendant lights, visible wine-cellar shelving, linen napkins, small plates, menu cards, a brass reservation stand, corks, coasters, and upholstered armchairs arranged for real conversation.
- Place {모델·인물} in the mid-foreground, slightly off-center, so the scene feels candid and editorial rather than staged.
- Use {매장명}, {컨셉}, {시그니처}, {시간 정보}, {위치라벨}, {예약정보}, {인스타핸들}, {해시태그}, and {메인 컬러} as visible brand anchors in the layout.
- Include tasteful SNS-card details: a small save/share icon row, a date label, a location tag, subtle hashtag strip, and a soft sticker-like caption badge integrated into the magazine spread.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Background architecture: build a refined Seoul wine-bar interior with dark wood wall panels, a subtle wine-cellar backdrop, brushed metal details, a marble or walnut counter, pendant lights receding into depth, and softly glowing bottle shelves.
2) Primary dining zone (center-left 45%): arrange two or three small tables with armchairs, linen napkins, small ceramic plates, a candle, printed tasting notes, and a few opened bottles to make the venue feel actively prepared for service.
3) Counter/product zone (lower-center 25%): display {시그니처} on a small tabletop menu card and nearby shelving with bottle labels upright and readable, premium but not commercial-brochure exaggerated.
4) Human presence layer: place {모델·인물} as relaxed adult guests talking naturally, leaning slightly toward one another with calm evening gestures, while the staff area and table settings add a lived-in hospitality feeling.
5) Title and brand text zone: render {매장명} as the main headline, with {컨셉} as a smaller subtitle, {시간 정보} as a concise schedule line, and {예약정보} as a reservation CTA in the lower-right information block.
6) SNS information layer: add {인스타핸들} near the top-right, {게시일자} and {위치라벨} as a small editorial label, {해시태그} along the bottom edge, and a micro icon row showing save · share · map pin · reservation symbols.
7) Color emphasis: apply {메인 컬러} across accents, bottle styling, typography separators, candle reflections, and small UI-like labels, keeping the overall palette grounded in deep burgundy, warm wood, and restrained gold.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard Bold for {매장명} headline, Pretendard SemiBold for {컨셉}, and Noto Sans KR Medium for {시그니처}, {시간 정보}, {예약정보}, {위치라벨}, {게시일자}, and {해시태그}; headline size should dominate, with subtitle and schedule set smaller and tightly tracked.
- Color palette: {메인 컬러} plus deep burgundy #4A1F2A, walnut brown #5A3E2B, candle amber #C89B5C, muted olive #6B6A45, and ivory text #F4EBDD for contrast.
- Graphic treatment: use thin gold separators, small rounded caption badges, refined editorial drop shadows, 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity on text blocks, bottles, and UI labels.
- Render social micro-elements as premium hospitality design: small bookmark icon, share arrow, map pin, reservation dot, and a discreet caption sticker reading {마이크로카피}.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 35mm full-frame editorial interior shot, shot on a Sony A7R IV with a 35mm f/1.4 lens at f/2.8 for moderate depth of field and crisp environmental detail.
- Lighting: warm practical pendant lights from above, soft fill from camera-left, candle glow on tabletops, subtle reflections on glassware, and a faint back rim from the cellar side to separate people and bottles from the darker wood background.
- Color grade: deep burgundy, amber tungsten, walnut brown, and muted gold with slightly lifted shadows for a polished magazine spread finish.

[6. MOOD]
Sophisticated evening hospitality editorial — somewhere between Kinfolk dining feature and Aesop interior storytelling, with the calm polish of a high-end Seoul natural wine bar and the practical readability of an Instagram main visual.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 정확히 보여야 함:
  - {매장명}
  - {컨셉}
  - {시그니처}
  - {시간 정보}
  - {예약정보}
  - {위치라벨}
  - {게시일자}
  - {인스타핸들}
  - {해시태그}
  - {마이크로카피}
- Bottle labels and tabletop menu text should remain upright, clean, and readable; no mirrored or garbled lettering.
- {모델·인물} must appear as adult guests only, ages 20+, with natural conversation poses and calm wine-bar etiquette.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]

- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or recognizable public-figure likenesses

[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Convert an attached portrait into a casual dark-room mirror selfie, like a friend’s candid Instagram daily post. Keep the identity intact while turning the scene into a raw, lived-in dorm-room snapshot with personal details, small everyday objects, and subtle story-post decoration that makes the moment feel real.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Keep the original person as the main subject, occupying about 55–60% of the frame through the mirror reflection, with the phone partially blocking the lower face or torso for a realistic mirror-selfie feel.
- Compose vertically, with the mirror reflection centered slightly above mid-frame and the messy room wrapping naturally around it.
- Use {원본 보존} for the person’s face, body type, hair, and expression, and {의상} for the outfit.
- Pose the subject as {자세}, with a relaxed, unposed posture that feels spontaneous rather than staged.
- Background should be a real small-room interior based on {배경}, with visible everyday clutter, uneven storage, clothing, cables, boxes, books, cosmetics, laundry, chargers, cups, notebooks, and soft disorder.
- The mirror surface should show a natural reflection, subtle smudges, fingerprints, edge distortion if needed, and a slight handheld-phone selfie angle.
- Add authentic lived-in details: a wrinkled blanket, tote bag, open drawer, tangled earphones, small desk lamp, wall tape marks, receipts, and a chair or bed edge that supports the casual pose.
- Include subtle selfie-post elements integrated into the image: a small date/location label near one corner reading “2026.05.01 밤 11:42 · 내 방”, a tiny caption sticker reading “오늘도 방콕”, and one or two small decorative tag stickers such as “조용한 밤” or “퇴근 후”. Keep them understated, like an Instagram story saved from a phone.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Mirror-reflection hero area (center 60%): the subject reflected naturally in the mirror, holding a smartphone toward the glass; the phone is realistic in scale and angle, with slight hand tension and no exaggerated pose.
- Upper environment band (top 15%): dark room ceiling area, dim ambient light spill, hanging clothes or shelf edges, tape marks, faint LED reflection, and indistinct room details to reinforce the cramped indoor setting.
- Side room context (left/right 20% each): visible clutter from {배경}, such as stacked boxes, scattered clothes, books, cables, lockers, plush toys, bags, storage bins, cosmetics, folded towels, receipts, or half-open drawers, arranged asymmetrically for authentic dorm-room messiness.
- Seating/floor interaction area (bottom 20%): if visible, include a sofa, bed edge, chair, rug, slippers, laundry pile, charger cable, or floor clutter that supports the relaxed seated pose from {자세}.
- Phone and mirror details: show the phone case, lens bump, hand grip, faint screen glow, mirror dust, corner chips, tape residue, and soft reflected highlights from the room.
- Lighting behavior: place low-intensity practical light sources from {광원}, with deep shadows, slightly lifted midtones only on the face, and a faint phone-screen or flash glow reflected in the mirror if it feels natural.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: allow only small, realistic social-story style text elements and stickers; set Korean text cleanly and legibly: “2026.05.01 밤 11:42 · 내 방”, “오늘도 방콕”, “조용한 밤”, “퇴근 후”. Do not make the text dominate the selfie.
- Color palette: muted charcoal, warm brown, dusty beige, soft gray, and dim amber from {필름 톤}; keep saturation restrained and avoid polished influencer-filter colors.
- Graphic treatment: if story-post stickers or date labels appear, keep them semi-transparent or softly glowing, aligned like casual phone app decoration, while the room and mirror remain photographic.
- Keep the room texture realistic: matte walls, slightly worn surfaces, fabric folds, dust, tiny scratches, reflective glass, tangled cables, and small household objects with imperfect placement.
- Preserve natural phone-camera imperfections: low-light noise, mild motion softness, uneven exposure, slight barrel distortion, and a tiny highlight bloom around practical lights.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: handheld smartphone selfie aesthetic, equivalent to a 26mm–28mm smartphone wide lens look, slight perspective distortion, portrait orientation.
- Lighting: low-light indoor practical lighting with a dim lamp, indirect room light, or LED strip feel; shadows should be deep, with a soft spill from one side and minimal fill.
- Color grade: warm low-light documentary grade with faint grain, subdued contrast, and a lived-in daily-photo look; mild noise is acceptable and desirable.
- Surface realism: mirror glass should catch small smears and reflected light; fabrics should show folds and lint; the phone case should have believable wear, fingerprints, or stickers.

[6. MOOD]
Candid dorm-room mirror selfie — like a raw Instagram story frame or a personal snapshot in the style of everyday bedroom photography, intimate, quiet, slightly messy, and emotionally ordinary.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: if visible text appears, it must be readable Korean only, especially “2026.05.01 밤 11:42 · 내 방”, “오늘도 방콕”, “조용한 밤”, and “퇴근 후”.
- Identity must stay unchanged: {원본 보존} must be preserved exactly, including facial structure, body proportions, hair, and expression.
- The image must feel like a real mirror selfie taken in a messy personal room, not a polished studio shoot.
- The phone, mirror reflection, hands, seated posture, and room perspective must remain anatomically and physically plausible.
- Maintain {의상}, {자세}, {배경}, {광원}, {분위기}, and {필름 톤} as the guiding style inputs.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- language: Korean

[1. PURPOSE]
Create a vertical 4-cut solo photobooth-style life grid based on the attached single-person photo, designed like a real Korean self-photo booth printout that someone would actually take home, tape to a journal, or share as a memory card. The result should feel like a natural self-affirmation snapshot strip with printed paper texture, small studio labels, dated notes, and hand-drawn encouragement details, not a CG composite.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- A single person occupies all 4 panels; keep the same identity, face shape, body type, hairstyle, and overall appearance from {참고 이미지} unchanged across every cut.
- Arrange the four panels in a vertical 4-cut layout with thin white borders, slight spacing between panels, soft paper thickness, and a subtle realistic drop shadow so it resembles a printed photobooth strip laid on a warm desk or scanned from a real print.
- Each panel should show a distinct emotional progression using {컷별 감정 흐름} and matching {포즈 흐름}, while keeping the same person framed in a believable booth-style crop.
- Background should be a real Korean photobooth-like white/gray studio field with a warm film tone from {배경·톤}, including gentle booth-wall texture, faint curtain shadow, soft vignetting, and realistic light falloff.
- Add a personal handwritten title, date/location label, frame numbers, small caption notes, and {낙서·스티커} as supportive decorative accents around the strip design without covering the face or key pose moments.
- Make the strip feel content-rich: include tiny printed booth metadata such as “FRAME 01/04”, “SELF PHOTO LOG”, “2026.05.01”, “SEOUL”, a small serial code, and a bottom memo area like a real photo-card keepsake.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Panel 1 (top): Show the subject in {컷별 감정 흐름} 1st state with {포즈 흐름} 1st pose, framed like a standard photobooth head-to-waist crop, expression restrained and natural. Add a tiny corner label “FRAME 01” and a small handwritten note “오늘의 나”.
2) Panel 2: Shift to the next emotion from {컷별 감정 흐름}, with the body language from {포즈 흐름} becoming more relaxed; keep the same lighting and background continuity. Add a small sticker-like tag “천천히 괜찮아” and a subtle film timestamp “2026.05.01”.
3) Panel 3: Show the brightest emotional peak from {컷별 감정 흐름}, using the third pose in {포즈 흐름}; this panel can feel the most expressive, but the subject must remain anatomically realistic and clearly the same person. Add a cheerful doodle burst or heart from {낙서·스티커} and the short caption “수고했어”.
4) Panel 4 (bottom): End with the final calm state from {컷별 감정 흐름} and the last pose from {포즈 흐름}, giving a gentle, self-assured closing frame. Include a small bottom caption “오늘도 화이팅” with a soft underline or tape-label effect.
5) Title area: Place {감성 타이틀 (2~5단어)} as a handwritten-style caption that feels like a personal encouragement note, positioned as part of the strip design, preferably in the upper or lower white border area with enough contrast to read clearly.
6) Doodle/sticker layer: Scatter {낙서·스티커} as small accents around corners, frame edges, label tabs, or the bottom memo area; include subtle stickers such as a tiny star, smile mark, paper tape, check mark, or heart to make it feel personally decorated.
7) Keepsake details: Add a small photo-booth footer with “SELF PHOTO LOG · SEOUL”, “NO. 0526-04”, a tiny QR-style square or barcode-like print block, and a micro caption line “나를 기록하는 네 컷” in clean Korean sans-serif.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Use a handwritten Korean script feel for {감성 타이틀 (2~5단어)}, paired with clean sans-serif support text for dates, frame numbers, location labels, and memo captions; title size should be medium-large, soft brush or marker style, with slightly imperfect human handwriting rhythm.
- Korean text details should look printed or handwritten on the physical strip: “오늘의 나”, “수고했어”, “오늘도 화이팅”, “천천히 괜찮아”, “나를 기록하는 네 컷”, “SELF PHOTO LOG · SEOUL”, “FRAME 01/04”.
- Color palette: off-white #F4F1EA, light gray #D9D9D9, warm beige #D8C7B0, soft brown #8C6B4F, muted pink #E7B7B2, cream highlights #FFF9F2.
- Borders/shadow: thin white borders around each panel, soft drop shadow with 4px y-offset, 12px blur, about 15% opacity, subtle enough to feel printed rather than floating; add slight paper grain, rounded print edges, and very faint scanner-like tonal variation.
- Decorative rhythm: Use warm beige tape labels, muted pink sticker dots, soft brown handwritten strokes, and cream highlights so the design feels like a realistic Korean photobooth keepsake with friendly emotional detail.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: photobooth-style 50mm equivalent, front-facing portrait crop, f/2.8 look with gentle depth separation and slightly soft edges like a real booth camera.
- Lighting: soft diffused frontal light with a slight upper-left fill, even skin rendering, natural booth softness, catchlights in the eyes, and believable shadows from a photobooth softbox and white reflector.
- Color grade: warm film scan grade with mild cream tint, reduced contrast, soft highlights, faint nostalgic print finish, subtle halation on bright whites, and realistic paper surface texture.
- Realism: Preserve natural skin texture, hair detail, fabric folds, small pose-to-pose variations, and real photobooth timing imperfections such as slightly different shoulder angle, blink timing, smile strength, and hand placement.

[6. MOOD]
A real Korean self-photo booth strip with the editorial tenderness of a Kinfolk-style lifestyle spread and the casual honesty of a Seoul photo-booth snapshot, enriched with small memory-card details, date labels, friendly stickers, and warm self-encouragement.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문구: “오늘의 나”, “수고했어”, “오늘도 화이팅”.
- Additional Korean text should be legible and natural if included: “천천히 괜찮아”, “나를 기록하는 네 컷”, “2026.05.01”, “서울 셀프사진관”.
- Identity invariants: the subject must remain the same single person across all 4 cuts; no additional people, no face swapping, no changes to facial structure, body shape, hairstyle, or identity.
- Layout invariants: exactly 4 panels, vertical strip, thin white borders, natural-looking printed shadow, realistic photobooth paper feel, and emotion progression from neutral to calm as specified by the chosen flow.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness

[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Create a vertical 4-cut family photobooth collage based on the attached family photo, designed to feel like a real Korean “인생네컷” booth print.
Warm, sentimental, shareable family keepsake style with natural expressions, playful handwritten details, realistic print-paper texture, and a soft film finish.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- The full family in {가족 구성} should remain exactly the same as the reference image: no additions, no removals, no changes to face, body type, age appearance, hairstyle, or identity.
- Compose as a single tall photobooth sheet with 4 stacked panels, thin white borders between panels, a subtle outer margin like a real booth print, and small real-print details such as frame numbers, date label, booth code, and tiny footer text.
- Keep the background in {배경·톤} across all panels, with consistent booth-like depth, soft perspective, and believable close-range studio lighting.
- Preserve believable spacing so it feels like everyone is standing in the same booth; only pose, distance, hand gesture, gaze direction, and facial expression should change naturally per panel.
- Add {감성 타이틀 (2~5단어)} as a handwritten-style header area, and integrate {낙서·스티커} as small decorative doodles, sticker labels, hearts, stars, tape pieces, speech-bubble notes, or photo-booth stamp marks around the edges without covering faces.
- Include a small date/location-style label such as “2026.05.01 · 우리 가족 기록”, a tiny booth footer like “SEOUL PHOTO BOOTH / FRAME 01-04”, and a small reorder/print code area near the bottom to make it feel physically printed.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Panel 1 (top): Arrange the family in a front-facing group pose, centered and stable, with everyone clearly visible and evenly lit. Add a tiny corner label “CUT 01” and a small handwritten caption like “오늘의 우리”.
2) Panel 2: Shift into a playful candid moment based on {컷별 흐름}, keeping the same family members and booth setting while making the motion feel spontaneous and real. Add light doodle motion marks, small sticker accents from {낙서·스티커}, and a “CUT 02” marker.
3) Panel 3: Emphasize affectionate parent-and-child eye contact or warm family gazes from {컷별 흐름}, with subtle pose variation, relaxed shoulders, and a cozy candid-photo feeling. Include a small caption label such as “함께라서 좋아” and “CUT 03”.
4) Panel 4 (bottom): Resolve into a loving closing pose from {컷별 흐름}, such as embrace, cheek kiss, hand-heart, or everyone leaning together, while maintaining a natural real-booth composition. Add “CUT 04”, a small bottom caption “다음에도 같이 찍자”, and a tiny print timestamp.
5) Add the handwritten title {감성 타이틀 (2~5단어)} in a one-line placement near the top or upper margin, then distribute {낙서·스티커} around corners, side gaps, header/footer space, and panel edges as if added by a photobooth template.
6) Keep the print feeling authentic: thin white frame lines, slight glossy print-paper texture, subtle dust/fiber specks, gentle separation between the 4 cuts, tiny booth-template typography, and mild paper curl/shadow so it looks like a booth strip ready for sharing or printing.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: handwritten Korean script for the title, casual brush-lettering style, medium thickness, 42–64 px feel; keep it natural and slightly imperfect like a marker note. Use smaller neat sans-serif Korean labels for date, cut numbers, captions, booth code, and footer text.
- Color palette: beige, ivory, warm cream, soft caramel, muted blush, and gentle brown accents; do not introduce saturated neon colors.
- Border/shadow: thin white borders around each cut, plus a soft drop shadow with 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity for a printed-photo feel.
- Decorative details: include believable Korean photobooth-template elements such as mini hearts, simple flower doodles, soft tape corners, tiny sparkle marks, sticker captions, print ID text, and a small QR/barcode-like reorder block in the footer.
- Keep the overall retouching natural, with realistic skin tones, visible human warmth, natural hair detail, fabric texture, and no over-sharpening or heavy beauty filtering.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 50mm portrait lens at f/2.8, booth-photo framing, realistic smartphone-photo-like clarity with mild depth separation.
- Lighting: soft diffused booth lighting from the front-top area, balanced fill, no harsh flash hotspots, gentle shadow falloff on faces, and subtle catchlights in the eyes.
- Color grade: warm film grade with ivory highlights, beige midtones, and slightly muted shadows, similar to a family snapshot edited with Kodak Portra 400-like softness.
- Material realism: semi-gloss photo paper, faint print grain, very slight edge shadow, soft reflections on the white border, and a tactile souvenir-strip look.

[6. MOOD]
Warm family memory print with a modern Korean photobooth souvenir feel, like a sentimental lifestyle spread from Kinfolk translated into a real “인생네컷” strip. The final image should feel affectionate, lived-in, and worth keeping on a refrigerator, diary page, or phone case.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 표시할 문구: “{감성 타이틀 (2~5단어)}”
- Additional small Korean text should be legible and natural, such as “2026.05.01 · 우리 가족 기록”, “오늘의 우리”, “함께라서 좋아”, “다음에도 같이 찍자”, “CUT 01”, “CUT 02”, “CUT 03”, “CUT 04”.
- Keep the same number of family members as the reference image; absolutely no additions or deletions.
- Faces, age appearance, body shape, hairstyle, and identity must remain unchanged from the reference image.
- Make the composite look like the family really posed together in one booth; no awkward cutout edges, no mismatched scale, no CG feel.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
