[1. PURPOSE]
Korean nail art design catalog poster for a trendy salon, seasonal theme menu, vertical editorial layout.
Designed for Instagram feed, KakaoTalk booking share, and in-store display as a realistic salon price catalog with seasonal design recommendations.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Top header zone (top 18%): place {네일샵명} as the main salon name, a catalog tag such as {카탈로그번호}, and a large seasonal headline for {시즌/테마}. Add a small date line {카탈로그날짜} and a delicate “Monthly Pick” badge.
- Main content zone (middle 64%): 6-card design grid showing manicure close-ups paired with elegant hand crops. Each card includes a numbered design name, a short material note, {디자인 종류}, and {가격대} in a salon-menu format.
- Side and divider details: add thin pearl-gold dividers, tiny flower and pearl decorative graphics, small category tags such as “NEW”, “BEST”, “예약추천”, and subtle swatch chips matching the nail colors.
- Bottom info bar (bottom 18%): show {매장 정보}, {영업시간}, {예약혜택}, address/contact style details, Instagram handle, and a small QR-style booking box with the text “예약 문의”.
- Background surface: soft warm beige paper texture with subtle pink undertone, delicate pearl sheen accents, faint floral micro-patterns, and salon-menu sticker details around the catalog page.
- Spacing and framing: equal gutters between cards, rounded card frames, layered paper slips, small price ribbons, and a balanced vertical retail-poster hierarchy.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Header area: place {네일샵명} in a large decorative title treatment at the top, with {시즌/테마} as a smaller subheadline underneath. Include {카탈로그번호}, {카탈로그날짜}, and a thin soft divider so it reads like an actual monthly nail design catalog.
- Grid area: arrange 6 nail design cards in a 2-column x 3-row grid. Use realistic card titles such as “01 파스텔 프렌치”, “02 튤립 그라데이션”, “03 밀키 마블”, “04 진주 플라워”, “05 미니 자수 포인트”, “06 핑크 시럽 젤”. Each card should contain a hand crop, the nail art design, one short label from {디자인 종류}, and a compact price line from {가격대}.
- Card treatment: each card uses a soft off-white or blush background, thin beige border, rounded corners, slight shadow, tiny color swatches, small Korean captions, and a small badge showing “BEST” or “NEW” for a premium salon catalog page.
- Nail visuals: show Korean 20s female hands with natural skin texture from {모델 컨셉}, fingers relaxed and elegant, nails polished to match the seasonal palette. Use varied poses such as holding a pearl, resting on silk ribbon, touching a dried flower, or overlapping fingers on a ceramic tray.
- Menu/pricelist details: include a small “OPTION” strip with text like “글리터 +5,000 / 파츠 +7,000 / 제거 별도”, plus a note line “디자인 변경 가능 · 컬러 변경 무료”.
- Bottom information area: set {매장 정보}, {영업시간}, and {예약혜택} in clean text with tiny icon-like separators, a mini map-pin label, phone/DM prompt, and a QR-style square so the poster looks ready for real salon booking.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for body text, with a handwritten accent font for small labels; title can use a semi-bold display style, 52–68px equivalent, body 20–28px equivalent, prices slightly smaller but still legible.
- Color palette: use beige #F4EBDD, blush pink #F5D6DC, pearl white #FAF8F4, soft mauve #D8B7C7, warm gray #8E857D, pale gold #D7C2A3, and small botanical green accents #A8B8A0.
- Border/shadow: thin 1px border in #E7D7D0, soft drop shadow 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.08), gentle inner highlight for a polished catalog-card feel.
- Decorative system: use pearl dots, micro floral line art, washi-tape corners, soft sticker labels, tiny calendar and location icons, and color-chip samples that support the nail menu theme.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: high-resolution studio beauty shot, 85mm f/1.8 for the hand crops, with a slightly top-down product-catalog framing; each card feels like a refined nail menu photo.
- Lighting: softbox key light from upper-left at 45°, subtle fill from right, controlled shine on pearl decorations and gel surfaces, clean reflective highlights on glossy nail polish.
- Color grade: warm cream + pastel pink + pearl ivory with a faint rosy highlight, lightly desaturated to match a fashionable Korean nail salon aesthetic.
- Material realism: visible gel thickness, fine glitter particles, tiny pearl parts, dried flower decals, smooth cuticle oil sheen, real paper grain, silk ribbon texture, and ceramic tray reflections.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean beauty salon editorial — polished Instagram nail-menu aesthetic with a Niipi / Mideu Nail style influence, romantic spring boutique mood, realistic booking catalog energy.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 정확히 보여야 함: {네일샵명}, {시즌/테마}, {카탈로그번호}, {카탈로그날짜}, {디자인 종류}, {가격대}, {매장 정보}, {영업시간}, {예약혜택}.
- Render readable Korean salon copy inside the poster, including: “월간 추천 디자인”, “컬러 변경 무료”, “예약 문의”, “BEST”, “NEW”, “디자인 변경 가능”.
- Layout invariant: 6-card grid must be consistent in size and spacing, and each card must clearly show one nail design plus its label, short caption, and price.
- Hands: anatomically correct Korean female hands, natural proportions, exactly 5 fingers per hand.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters or garbled Hangul
- Celebrity composites or unlicensed celebrity likenesses

Designed for social sharing, saving, and quick reading, with a Korean health-magazine hierarchy, clear section separation, and realistic poster details such as issue/date, trainer credit, progress badges, and CTA footer.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Top header band occupies about 18% of the frame: bold workout title on the left, effect headline and issue/date metadata on the right, aligned to a strong editorial grid.
- Main middle zone takes about 55%: 4–6 posture illustration steps arranged in a vertical flow or staggered grid, each with a clear Korean label, step number, short cue, and simple directional arrows.
- Bottom zone takes about 27%: boxed panels for {세트시간}, {식단팁}, preparation notes, caution text, and a save/share CTA strip.
- Add realistic health-magazine details: {발행정보}, {작성자}, {운동장소}, {난이도}, {소요시간}, {칼로리}, {준비물}, {해시태그}, {CTA문구}, plus a small barcode-style strip and page marker near the footer.
- Use {운동주제}, {핵심효과}, {자세단계}, {세트시간}, {식단팁}, and {컨셉톤} as the primary editable content anchors.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Header area: place {운동주제} as the main title in large bold Korean sans-serif, with {핵심효과} directly beneath it as a smaller subheadline; include {발행정보} in a compact top-right magazine label and {작성자} as a spine-style vertical credit along one side.
- Quick-info badges: directly below the headline, add small pill badges for {운동장소}, {난이도}, {소요시간}, and {칼로리}, using simple line icons such as home, flame, timer, and level bar.
- Main exercise section: show {자세단계} as 4–6 simplified but anatomically clear workout illustrations, each step inside a rounded rectangle or floating card, labeled in Korean with step numbers, short posture cues, and small muscle-highlight accents.
- Flow guidance: connect the steps with thin arrows, dotted motion lines, or numbered progress markers so the routine reads top-to-bottom without ambiguity.
- Set/time box: display {세트시간} in a prominent bordered panel with clock and repeat icons, using bold numerals and compact sans-serif layout.
- Diet tip box: present {식단팁} in a separate lower panel with plate, protein, vegetable, and water icons, using short line breaks for readability.
- Prep/caution strip: include {준비물} and {주의문구} as small but readable utility text near the lower section.
- Footer system: add {해시태그}, {CTA문구}, a small save/share icon pair, page marker “INFOGRAPHIC 01/01”, and a barcode-style decorative strip with tiny numerals.
- Accent system: apply {컨셉톤} through colored bands, subtle illustration fills, warm paper texture, editorial dividers, and premium health-magazine graphic rhythm.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold for titles, Pretendard SemiBold for subtitles and badges, Pretendard Regular for body text; title size large, labels medium, supporting text small but legible.
- Color palette: deep black #111111, forest green #2F5D50, mustard #C89B2C, off-white #F7F4EE, light gray #D9D9D9; use {컨셉톤} to guide emphasis balance.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]

- Lighting: studio-style even illumination with no harsh cast shadows, slight highlight edges to separate panels, all elements readable at a glance.

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean or overseas travel illustration map poster, postcard-style editorial graphic for travel blogs, exhibitions, souvenir prints, and itinerary guide cards.
A simplified city map with landmarks, food spots, lodging, route notes, travel stamps, and short Korean labels, rendered as a warm handmade illustration with useful guide-map details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Create a horizontal travel illustration map for {도시·여행지}, with the main illustrated map occupying the central field and editorial information arranged around it like a premium postcard-guide poster.
- Build the map from simplified roads, river lines, mountain silhouettes, coastline curves, bridges, neighborhood blocks, transit hints, and walking-route dots that make the destination feel specific and lived-in.
- Add icon markers for {주요 명소}, {맛집/카페}, and {숙소}, each with small Korean label tags, tiny pictograms, and marker numbers that correspond to a side legend.
- Use {핵심 카피} as the main headline, supported by {지도 부제}, {여행 기간}, and a small maker credit {제작자} in a postcard-style title block.
- Include practical travel-map details: 추천 루트 box, 교통 메모 strip, small compass, illustrated scale bar, weather doodle, ticket-stub sticker, postage-stamp motif, and souvenir-style caption notes.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Base map layer — Draw the city layout with simplified topographic logic: main roads as curved pen lines, water as soft blue watercolor shapes, hills or mountain outlines as gentle contours, bridges and station hints where relevant, and coastlines if relevant to {도시·여행지}.
2. Landmark layer — Place icon-style markers for {주요 명소} across the map with small illustrated building silhouettes, tower shapes, palace roofs, market awnings, observatory forms, or scenic symbols that visually distinguish each stop.
3. Food and café layer — Mark {맛집/카페} with plate, bowl, coffee cup, storefront, street-food cart, or bakery icons, using warm accent colors and short natural Korean labels.
4. Lodging layer — Add {숙소} as a cozy accommodation marker using a guesthouse, hotel, or hanok-style icon with a pin badge, room-key doodle, and a short Korean label.
5. Editorial guide layer — Add a numbered legend titled “지도 범례”, a route card titled “추천 동선”, the text {추천 루트}, and a small transport note using {교통 메모}; connect route points with dotted walking lines and tiny arrows.
6. Postcard information layer — Set {핵심 카피} in a hand-drawn or editorial title treatment with {지도 부제}, {여행 기간}, {스탬프 문구}, and {제작자}; add a small faux postcard code, date line, and travel-note caption {지도 하단 정보} near the lower edge.
7. Decorative finishing — Add passport-stamp circles, compass marks, dotted route lines, tiny cloud and wave accents, washi-tape corners, luggage tag graphics, small flower or food doodles, and watercolor paper grain so the map feels like a collected travel memory.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard SemiBold or Noto Sans KR Medium for small labels and legend text; a hand-drawn or Nanum Myeongjo style for the main title {핵심 카피}; maintain crisp, readable Korean letterforms across all map labels.
- Color palette: use the palette implied by {일러스트 톤}, specifically warm beige, muted mint, soft sage, light sand, paper white, desaturated teal, coral accent, and restrained charcoal outline.
- Border/shadow: use a subtle paper edge, postcard margin print, washi-tape corners, and faint 10% opacity icon shadows with 2px y-offset and 6px blur to separate markers from the textured background.
- Linework: thin pen lines with consistent stroke weight, slightly irregular handmade edges, watercolor pooling near coastlines and rivers, and lightly textured pigment fills.
- Information hierarchy: headline first, destination name second, map icons third, legend and travel notes fourth; all Korean text should be intentionally placed and readable at postcard size.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: top-down flat illustration composition inspired by a wide 35mm editorial layout, as if viewed on a scanned travel sketchbook spread.
- Lighting: diffuse daylight feel with no strong direction, like soft overcast window light over watercolor paper.
- Color grade: warm cream + muted mint + beige + desaturated teal, with low contrast, gentle pigment bleeding at the edges, and tactile scanned-paper grain.

[6. MOOD]
Travel sketchbook editorial — somewhere between a Kinfolk city guide spread, a refined Moleskine notebook illustration, and a handmade souvenir map found at a small local bookshop.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 다음 문자열이 정확히 보여야 함: {도시·여행지}, {주요 명소}, {맛집/카페}, {숙소}, {핵심 카피}, {지도 부제}, {여행 기간}, {추천 루트}, {교통 메모}, {지도 하단 정보}, {스탬프 문구}, {제작자}
- 지도 안에 “지도 범례”, “추천 동선”, “도보 15분”, “오늘의 코스”, “기념 엽서” 같은 짧은 한국어 보조 문구를 자연스럽게 배치.
- Labels must be short, legible, and rendered in natural Korean without broken characters; marker numbers and legend entries must correspond visually.
- Map elements should remain geographically suggestive and editorially simplified, with recognizable local atmosphere rather than a technical GIS diagram.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likenesses
- Misleading official tourism-board identity or government document styling

[INPUT]

- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean travel card news / itinerary visual, vertical infographic poster for Instagram sharing.
Design a content-rich, realistic travel planning card that feels like a saved influencer itinerary: clear day-by-day schedule, editorial travel notes, small map-route cues, food highlights, accommodation info, and shareable card-news details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Overall layout: vertical 1024x1536 poster with a strong top header, a richly organized itinerary dashboard occupying the central canvas, and supporting travel elements such as route markers, mini photo-card panels, checklist notes, weather chips, and local landmark accents.
- Header area (top 18%): {여행지} as the main destination title, followed by {핵심 카피} as a large Korean headline. Add a small card-news label such as "TRAVEL ITINERARY", "VOL.247", "2026년 5월호", and a slide/page indicator "01/05" near the top edge.
- Main schedule area (middle 62%): a 3-day visual timetable using DAY 1 / DAY 2 / DAY 3 blocks, each with time, place, menu, movement, and short memo entries laid out in readable columns. Include small labels like "AM", "PM", "DINNER", "CHECK-IN" for realistic planning depth.
- Supporting details: {주요 장소}, {주요 메뉴/맛집}, and {숙소} should appear as concise itinerary items with pin markers, food icons, mini caption tags, route dots, and a small accommodation card.
- Background treatment: warm off-white paper texture with subtle scanned grain, beige base, soft sage panels, light blue route shapes, coral highlight stickers, tape-like labels, small receipt-style note fragments, and soft shadows to make the card feel printed and collectible.
- Use {여행지}, {주요 장소}, {주요 메뉴/맛집}, {숙소}, {핵심 카피}, {컨셉 톤}, {비율/사이즈} placeholders.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Header strip (top): place {여행지} in large bold Korean type, with {핵심 카피} beneath it as a prominent subtitle. Add a thin travel-route line motif in soft blue, a tiny airplane or ferry icon, and small credit text such as "editor @slow.route" and "photo note by 여행기록".
- Overview chips (upper-middle): create 4–5 rounded chips for key trip highlights using {주요 장소}, {주요 메뉴/맛집}, and {숙소}; each chip should have a tiny pictogram such as a pin, fork, wave, camera, ferry, or bed. Add small Korean labels like "핵심 동선", "맛집 메모", "숙소", "사진 포인트".
- Mini map / route cue: include a small simplified island or route-line graphic beside the chips, with numbered dots ① ② ③ and tiny place labels from {주요 장소}. Make it feel like a practical travel note, not a blank decorative shape.
- Itinerary table (center): render DAY 1, DAY 2, DAY 3 as stacked rows or three equal columns, each containing time, place, food, and memo text blocks. Use realistic example time labels such as "09:30 도착", "12:00 점심", "15:30 카페", "18:30 저녁", while integrating {주요 장소} and {주요 메뉴/맛집} visibly.
- Day detail content: enrich each DAY block with small travel-note fragments such as "렌터카 이동 35분", "일몰 체크", "카페 대기 가능", "바람막이 챙기기", "예약 확인". Keep the hierarchy clear with bold day labels, colored bullets, and compact captions.
- Detail emphasis: highlight the most photogenic spots from {주요 장소} with slightly larger text, numbered map pins, or a colored bullet. Treat {주요 메뉴/맛집} as a food callout in a coral accent box with a fork icon and a small caption like "꼭 먹을 것".
- Accommodation block (lower-middle): show {숙소} as a compact card with a bed icon, check-in/check-out notes, an address-style line, and a short overnight stay context such as "오션뷰 근처 / 주차 확인".
- Extra information row: add a small budget/weather/checklist strip near the lower area with Korean microcopy such as "예상 경비 ₩320,000~", "날씨 18–22℃", "준비물: 얇은 겉옷 · 보조배터리", and "교통: 렌터카 + 배편".
- Decorative graphics: add friendly flat illustrations of food, sea, mountain, orange, camera, ticket stub, map pin, and landmark motifs around the layout. Use them as meaningful editorial accents connected to travel planning.
- Footer area (bottom 12%): include a card-news CTA line and Instagram-style micro UI details: "저장해두고 여행 전날 다시 보기", "다음 장: 코스별 이동시간", small save/share/comment icons, hashtags like "#제주여행 #3박4일코스 #여행카드뉴스", and page indicator dots "● ○ ○ ○ ○".

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for the main body in regular/medium weights; use Pretendard ExtraBold or Noto Sans KR Bold for the title; keep headline size large and body text compact but readable at mobile-card scale.
- Color palette: use the palette implied by {컨셉 톤} with specific tones such as beige #E9DDC8, sage #A8B8A6, coral #F2A38A, soft blue #AFC8E8, and deep charcoal #2B2B2B for text.
- Border/shadow: rounded cards with a 1px warm gray border, soft drop shadow 0px 6px 18px at 12% opacity, layered paper-card depth, and subtle inner spacing for a polished magazine-like structure.
- Graphic treatment: simple flat travel icons, thin divider lines, small pin markers, dotted route paths, sticker labels, tape corners, receipt-like snippets, and pastel blocks; avoid glossy 3D effects.
- Information density: make the design feel like a real saved itinerary with many useful micro-details, while preserving clear reading order from title to overview, schedule, lodging, checklist, and CTA.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: editorial flat-lay infographic aesthetic, as if designed for a travel magazine spread and photographed as a printed card on textured paper; if adding image textures, keep them as paper-scanned details with a 35mm documentary layout sensibility.
- Lighting: simulated soft daylight from upper-left, even and diffused with gentle paper shadows, like an overcast afternoon in a travel editorial workspace.
- Color grade: beige + sage + coral + soft blue with muted saturation, airy paper-white highlights, gentle charcoal text contrast, and warm printed-paper realism.
- Surface realism: include believable paper fiber, tiny ink texture, subtle halftone dots in mini photo-card panels, and soft edge shadows so the card feels tactile and professionally produced.

[6. MOOD]
Korean travel media editorial — similar to CATCH! and influencer-style itinerary cards, with a calm, organized, warm, highly saveable planning feel. The final image should look like a polished travel card-news slide someone would screenshot before a trip.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following strings must appear exactly and correctly in the rendered image: "제주도 3박 4일", "협재 해변 / 함덕 카페 / 비양도 / 우도", "흑돼지 / 갈치조림 / 우도 땅콩 아이스크림", "해변 게스트하우스 (애월)", "제주의 봄, 천천히 흐르는 시간".
- Additional Korean card-news text should be crisp and realistic, including short labels such as "VOL.247", "2026년 5월호", "01/05", "저장해두고 여행 전날 다시 보기", "다음 장: 코스별 이동시간", "예상 경비 ₩320,000~", "날씨 18–22℃", "준비물: 얇은 겉옷 · 보조배터리", "#제주여행 #3박4일코스 #여행카드뉴스".
- Keep all Korean characters crisp and correctly formed; no broken Hangul, no misspellings.
- If DAY labels are shown, render them consistently as DAY 1, DAY 2, DAY 3 with matching layout and spacing.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

- Top header occupies about 10% of the canvas, with {스토리 제목} centered in a warm title band, plus a small handle, date/location label, and page indicator for a real Instagram recap card.
- Main body uses a strict 3x2 grid: 6 equal panels, each panel with consistent margins, thin separators, realistic snapshot framing, and clear left-to-right / top-to-bottom story flow.

- Overall palette must stay in warm beige, green accent, and wood tones, with realistic apartment lighting, natural material textures, and gentle lifestyle-editorial contrast.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header band: centered {스토리 제목} at the top, with the main title text “자취방 변신 스토리 — TIMELAPSE”; add small supporting microcopy “@one_room_note · 2026.05 · 서울 관악구”, a tiny “1/6” page indicator, and small save/share-style icons on the right.
2. Cut 1 panel (top-left): {컷 1 BEFORE} shown as a cramped 7-pyeong studio with scattered clothes, cup noodles, delivery boxes, tangled charger cables, unwashed mugs, an old folding table, gray cast, low light, and visibly messy surfaces; include a small corner label “BEFORE — 자취방의 현실” and a tiny caption strip “퇴근 후 쌓인 생활감”.
3. Cut 2 panel (top-middle): {컷 2 청소} shown with 2–3 cleaning workers actively organizing, vacuuming, wiping shelves, separating recycling, and airing out the room; include believable cleaning props such as gloves, microfiber cloths, spray bottles, trash bags, labeled boxes, and a partially open window; add the label “DAY 1 — 청소” and small checklist text “분류 · 세탁 · 환기”.
4. Cut 3 panel (top-right): {컷 3 리노베이션} shown mid-renovation with wallpaper replacement, tile work, dust in the air, a ladder, masking tape, paint tray, utility knife, wallpaper rolls, sample swatches, and covered furniture; emphasize improvement in progress through organized tools and visible craftsmanship; add the label “DAY 3 — 리노베이션” and small note “벽지 교체 / 조명 설치”.
5. Cut 4 panel (bottom-left): {컷 4 AFTER} shown as a modern cozy studio with white walls, light wood furniture, soft bedding, woven rug, small plants, books, framed print, linen curtain, compact storage, clean desk setup, and soft daylight; this should be the most polished and calm panel; add the label “AFTER — 새로운 공간” and caption “7평도 넓어 보이는 배치”.
6. Cut 5 panel (bottom-middle): {컷 5 친구 방문} shown with a woman in her 20s pressing the doorbell and entering, wearing a surprised expression as she sees the transformed room; include hallway light, shoe rack, reusable tote bag, bouquet or small housewarming gift, doorbell panel, and a glimpse of the renovated interior behind the door; add the label “DING DONG — 친구 방문” and speech-bubble sticker “진짜 여기 맞아?”.
7. Cut 6 panel (bottom-right): {컷 6 행복} shown with two friends at a small dining table drinking hand-drip coffee and chatting in a warm afternoon setting; include ceramic mugs, dripper, dessert plate, phone, small vase, sunlit curtain texture, cozy shadows, and relaxed natural gestures; add the label “AFTER — 행복한 오후” and a small end-card CTA “저장하고 다음 집들이 보기”.
8. Bottom footer strip: very small social-card footer beneath the grid with “ROOM MAKEOVER LOG · SAVE • SHARE · #자취방꾸미기 #비포애프터”, matching the warm beige-green palette.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for the header, labels, captions, footer, and stickers; bold for panel labels, medium for the title, around 24–34px for the title and 14–18px for panel labels, with microcopy around 9–12px.
- Panel labels must be small, crisp, and fully legible in Korean, placed at each panel corner with consistent padding; captions may sit in translucent rounded rectangles so they feel like real social-media overlays.
- Color palette: warm beige #E8DDCF, muted green #8FA58B, soft wood brown #B78E66, off-white #F7F3ED, cool gray #8C8C8C, with natural highlights from window light and subtle warm shadows.
- Border/shadow: thin off-white separators with subtle shadow, 2px line weight, soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity; add small rounded sticker shapes and divider ticks that look printed rather than sterile.
- Include realistic apartment textures: painted wall grain, laminate floor seams, paper boxes, fabric wrinkles, ceramic reflections, wood grain, cleaning-tool plastic, and soft curtain translucency.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: realistic interior photo look, 24mm wide-angle for room panels and 50mm standard lens feel for the people-focused panels, f/4 to f/5.6, clean editorial framing.
- Lighting: before panel uses dim indoor ambient light; cleaning and renovation panels use neutral overhead interior light; after panel uses soft window light from upper-left; friend and coffee panels use warm afternoon window light from the side.
- Color grade: cinematic beige-green-wood grade with slightly softened contrast, natural skin tones, and gentle highlight roll-off, similar to a premium lifestyle editorial spread.
- Rendering approach: realistic photo collage with subtle editorial polish; maintain believable Korean studio-apartment scale, real human proportions, readable overlay text, and natural depth in every panel.

[6. MOOD]
Premium home-transformation editorial — like a refined Kinfolk magazine before/after spread mixed with a polished Instagram Reels recap and a warm Korean 자취방 집들이 post.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 렌더링되어야 하는 문자열 — “자취방 변신 스토리 — TIMELAPSE”, “BEFORE — 자취방의 현실”, “DAY 1 — 청소”, “DAY 3 — 리노베이션”, “AFTER — 새로운 공간”, “DING DONG — 친구 방문”, “AFTER — 행복한 오후”.
- Additional small Korean/social text to render clearly where space allows: “@one_room_note”, “2026.05 · 서울 관악구”, “1/6”, “퇴근 후 쌓인 생활감”, “분류 · 세탁 · 환기”, “벽지 교체 / 조명 설치”, “7평도 넓어 보이는 배치”, “진짜 여기 맞아?”, “저장하고 다음 집들이 보기”, “#자취방꾸미기 #비포애프터”.
- The layout must remain a 3x2 grid with exactly 6 evenly sized panels, plus header and small footer UI elements outside the panels.
- Keep the transformation tone positive, realistic, and non-sensational; the messy room should feel like an ordinary lived-in studio before a genuine reset.
- All hands, faces, body posture, reflections, doorbell interaction, cleaning actions, and coffee-drinking gestures should look natural and anatomically correct.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536
- format: {비율/사이즈}
- target_style: {컨셉 톤}

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean Instagram webtoon, 4-panel comic grid, cute everyday comedy with a dog mascot. Designed as a vertical 9:16 social post that feels like a real uploaded Instagram comic card, including a compact profile/header area, four readable gag panels, and a footer with caption, hashtag text, and micro interaction icons.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Top social header band: about 13% of the canvas, with a small circular dog avatar, {인스타 계정}, {업로드 날짜}, {위치 라벨}, and {만화 제목} as the main comic title.
- Main comic body: about 80% of the canvas, exact 2x2 grid of four equal panels with rounded black comic frames, consistent gutters, and identical yellow narration strips at the bottom of each panel.
- Footer strip: about 7% of the canvas, styled like an Instagram card footer with {좋아요 문구}, {하단 캡션}, {해시태그}, tiny save/share/comment/heart micro icons, and a small page indicator 1/1.
- Keep the mascot character consistent across all panels using {메인 캐릭터}; the larger dog in panel 2 and the owner in panel 4 should be clearly secondary characters but still expressive and charming.
- Add lively everyday park details that naturally support the story: leash curve, dog paw prints, grass clumps, bench, walking path, small park sign, treat pouch, fallen leaves, and tiny comic sound-effect marks.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header area: Place a small circular avatar of {메인 캐릭터} on the left, {인스타 계정} beside it, and a date/location chip reading {업로드 날짜} · {위치 라벨}. Center or slightly emphasize {만화 제목} in a cute bold Korean display style on a warm cream header strip, with tiny paw-print stickers and a bone-shaped divider.
2. Panel 1 — Introduction (upper-left): Show {메인 캐릭터} arriving at a neighborhood park, body angled forward with excited tail wagging, leash bouncing, and bright eyes. Speech bubble contains {컷 1 — 도입}. Background includes a curved path, mint-green grass, a bench, trees, and a small Korean park sign. Yellow narration strip contains {컷 1 — 노란 자막}.
3. Panel 2 — Conflict setup (upper-right): Show {메인 캐릭터} facing a larger dog wearing a simple bandana, both in a tense but cute stare-down. Speech bubble contains {컷 2 — 발단}. Add comic tension marks, tiny sweat drops, paw-print dust, and a nearby owner’s shoe or leash handle for realistic context. Yellow narration strip contains {컷 2 — 노란 자막}.
4. Panel 3 — Climax (lower-left): Show a playful dog scuffle as a soft dust-cloud gag, with visible tails, paws, motion lines, starbursts, and funny Korean sound-effect lettering like 우당탕 and 멍멍. Speech bubble contains {컷 3 — 절정}. Keep the action cute and comedic, like an Instagram slice-of-life gag. Yellow narration strip contains {컷 3 — 노란 자막}.
5. Panel 4 — Resolution (lower-right): Show the owner gently separating the dogs while {메인 캐릭터} is being pulled away with a proud, slightly embarrassed expression. Speech bubble contains {컷 4 — 결말}. Include leash, treat pouch, park lamp, scattered leaves, and the larger dog looking confused but friendly in the background. Yellow narration strip contains {컷 4 — 노란 자막}.
6. Footer area: Add a realistic Instagram-style bottom UI row with tiny heart, comment bubble, share arrow, and save bookmark icons; show {좋아요 문구}, a short caption {하단 캡션}, {해시태그}, and a small 1/1 page indicator aligned near the right edge.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard ExtraBold for the title, Noto Sans KR Bold for speech bubbles, and a rounded handwritten Korean style for narration strips; title around 44–56 px, dialogue around 26–32 px, footer/caption text around 18–24 px.
- Color palette: warm pastel peach, soft mint, pale sky blue, butter yellow, cream white, caramel brown, and deep black outline; keep the yellow narration strips in saturated pastel yellow with crisp black Korean text.
- Border/shadow: thick black outlines with rounded corners, subtle 2–4 px inner spacing, and a soft 4 px drop shadow at 12 px blur, 15% opacity for the header and footer card areas.
- Decorative graphics: use paw stickers, tiny bone icons, speed lines, emotion marks, dust puffs, and hand-drawn divider strokes to make the comic feel like a polished Korean Instagram upload.
- Text hierarchy: speech bubbles and yellow narration strips must be the most readable elements inside panels; header and footer UI text should remain smaller but still legible.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: clean flat illustration look inspired by a 35mm editorial comic layout, front-facing composition, no realistic camera distortion.
- Lighting: evenly lit like a scanned printed webtoon page with soft ambient fill, no hard shadows.
- Color grade: warm pastel comic palette with cream highlights, muted greens, gentle peach accents, and subtle paper-grain texture for a printed Instagram webtoon feel.

[6. MOOD]
Playful Korean Instagram webtoon — friendly slice-of-life comic energy with the tidy, approachable pacing of a LINE Webtoon gag strip, enriched with cozy neighborhood-park details and humorous pet-owner realism.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보여야 하는 문구: {만화 제목}, {인스타 계정}, {업로드 날짜}, {위치 라벨}, {컷 1 — 도입}, {컷 2 — 발단}, {컷 3 — 절정}, {컷 4 — 결말}.
- Yellow narration strips must show: {컷 1 — 노란 자막}, {컷 2 — 노란 자막}, {컷 3 — 노란 자막}, {컷 4 — 노란 자막}.
- Footer text must show: {좋아요 문구}, {하단 캡션}, {해시태그}, plus tiny heart/comment/share/save icons and 1/1 page indicator.
- The four story panels must remain an exact 2x2 equal grid with consistent border thickness and identical yellow narration strips at the bottom of each panel.
- Keep all Korean characters and punctuation crisp, correctly spaced, and fully legible.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or real-person likeness swaps
- Graphic violence, blood, injuries, or intimidating realism

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536
- target_format: vertical Instagram selfie / profile-card style image
- aspect: {비율_사이즈}

[1. PURPOSE]
Realistic Korean Instagram influencer selfie-tone photo, suitable for social media post, lookbook header, blog banner, or lifestyle profile card.
Natural daily fashion image with a warm film aesthetic, polished but casual, centered on a Korean female influencer vibe, enriched with believable Instagram-style metadata such as handle, date/location label, caption, hashtags, and small save/share micro icons.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject placement: {모델_컨셉} occupies about 55–65% of the frame, slightly off-center for a casual selfie feel, with the face clearly visible and the upper body included.
- Scene framing: {장면_구도} as the primary environment, with soft background blur and realistic lived-in details such as glass reflections, tableware, curtains, small plants, magazines, tote straps, charging cable, or a half-finished coffee placed naturally around the scene.
- Wardrobe visibility: {의상} should be readable in silhouette, texture, and fabric folds, with the tote bag, coffee cup, or phone integrated in the lower third as a believable daily object.
- Expression and pose: {표정_포즈} should feel candid and approachable, with a relaxed shoulder line, natural hand placement, and physically plausible selfie or mirror-selfie arm angles.
- Instagram profile-card overlay: add a light translucent UI layer that feels like an exported Instagram post preview: top-left date/location pill, top-right handle, bottom caption area, hashtag line, decorative tag sticker, and tiny interaction icons.
- Background treatment: warm indoor surfaces such as light wood, cream walls, cafe glass, soft curtain fabric, and muted city reflections, with enough real environment detail to make the image feel inhabited and contemporary.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Face and upper body: {모델_컨셉} shown with realistic Korean facial proportions, clean skin texture, natural brows, and a soft, trendy everyday makeup finish.
2. Outfit layer: {의상} rendered with clear fabric weight, stitching, folds, sleeve volume, denim texture, and accessories styled as a believable Korean casual influencer outfit rather than editorial runway fashion.
3. Pose and prop interaction: {표정_포즈} integrated naturally, with the coffee cup or smartphone held in a relaxed, believable grip and anatomically correct fingers.
4. Scene context: {장면_구도} created as either a cafe window selfie or a mirror selfie at home, with daylight falling naturally into the room, subtle reflections around the edges, and small lifestyle props that reinforce a Seoul daily-life mood.
5. Light and tone build: {조명_카메라} used to create soft depth, warm highlights on skin, gentle bokeh separation from the background, and natural falloff on clothing and hair.
6. Final color treatment: {컬러_팔레트} applied consistently across skin, clothing, background, shadows, UI panels, and decorative tags, with a lightly faded film finish and gentle highlight roll-off.
7. Text and UI layer: include legible Korean social-media text using {인스타_핸들}, {위치_라벨}, {날짜_라벨}, {캡션_문구}, {해시태그}, and {장식_태그}; the overlay should feel like a stylish Instagram card rather than an advertisement.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use clean Korean social-media typography such as Pretendard SemiBold 28–42px for labels and 20–28px for micro text; all Korean text must be sharp, readable, and correctly spaced.
- Color palette: use {컬러_팔레트} with warm beige, light brown, creamy off-white, muted tan, soft denim blue, and gently desaturated shadow tones.
- UI panels: use translucent rounded rectangles, soft cream sticker labels, small heart/bookmark/share icons, and subtle film-grain texture so the social card layer blends into the photograph.
- Decorative details: add tasteful handwritten-style tag stickers, tiny sparkle marks, date stamp styling, or a small location pin icon, while keeping the subject as the clear focus.
- Realism: preserve natural skin pores, stray hair, phone reflection logic, lens perspective, fabric creases, glass reflections, and indoor daylight behavior.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame digital look with a 50mm f/1.8 or 50mm f/1.4 portrait perspective, shallow depth of field, selfie-like proximity without distortion.
- Lighting: natural window light from upper-left at about 45°, soft fill from the front, gentle reflected bounce from cafe surfaces or wall paint, no harsh flash.
- Color grade: warm film grade with slightly desaturated beige-brown tones, gentle highlight roll-off, subtle vintage Instagram filter feel, fine film grain, and softly lifted shadows.

[6. MOOD]
Korean lifestyle influencer snapshot — warm Seoul cafe realism, relaxed daily-fashion confidence, polished Instagram lookbook energy, soft Kinfolk editorial warmth, and intimate profile-card storytelling.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Required rendered Korean UI text: top label must read “{위치_라벨} · {날짜_라벨}”, handle must read “{인스타_핸들}”, caption must read “{캡션_문구}”, hashtag line must read “{해시태그}”, and decorative sticker must read “{장식_태그}”.
- Required micro icons/text: include small readable interaction labels such as “♡ 12.4K”, “댓글 248”, “저장”, “공유” in the lower UI area.
- Korean text accuracy: all Hangul must be complete, readable, naturally spaced, and not garbled; do not replace Korean with random glyphs.
- Anatomical correctness: realistic Korean body proportions, natural facial features, exactly 5 fingers per hand, no warped phone grip, no extra limbs, no unnatural shoulder or neck shapes.
- Pose realism: selfie or mirror-selfie framing must look physically plausible, with natural arm angles, believable reflections, and correct smartphone orientation.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity face composites or impersonation
- Counterfeit verification badges or official ID-style claims

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1536x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Create a realistic food truck / flea market booth promotional visual, suitable for social media, event posters, vendor listings, and local market recap articles.
The image should feel like an authentic on-site photo of a retro vintage food stall with readable signage, menu boards, pricing, payment notices, event details, and warm market atmosphere.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: a hero food truck or market booth filling about 65% of the frame, with the front service window angled slightly toward camera so the sign, menu board, counter, and food trays are visible together.
- Add believable market activity: one staff member plating food behind the counter, one customer ordering at the window, and one or two people browsing nearby stalls in the background.
- Background: {장소}, with neighboring tents, folding tables, pavement texture, tote bags, crates, string lights, small banners, and urban street details softly receding into the distance.
- Integrate {브랜드명}, {업종설명}, {대표메뉴}, {가격표기}, {컨셉키워드}, {외관디자인}, {행사명}, {행사일시}, {부스번호}, {결제안내}, {주소연락처}, and {SNS핸들} as physical printed or handwritten booth elements.
- The composition should look like a real vendor scene captured during a busy but comfortable market day, with signage readability supported by natural placement on the truck, hanging boards, counter labels, and small tabletop cards.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Exterior hero zone: build the truck or booth as the main focal point, applying {외관디자인} across the body panels, awning, service window trim, menu board frame, and small table skirts.
2) Main signage zone: place a large front sign reading {브랜드명}, with a subtitle reading {업종설명}; add a small vertical side banner with {컨셉키워드} and {부스번호}.
3) Menu / price zone: show a side menu board and counter price cards with neat dividers, item rows, and readable prices: 치즈볼 {가격표기}, 치즈핫도그 {가격표기}, 치즈튀김 {가격표기}; include small labels such as “BEST”, “오늘의 추천”, and {추천문구}.
4) Event information zone: add a poster or hanging placard attached to the booth showing {행사명}, {행사일시}, {장소}, {부스번호}, ticket/free-entry style notice, sponsor strip area, and a small map-pin icon.
5) Product zone: show {대표메뉴} in paper trays, wire baskets, parchment sheets, and takeout cups near the counter, with realistic fried texture, cheese pull on one sample piece, condiment bottles, napkins, tongs, and order tickets.
6) Transaction zone: include a small payment sign reading {결제안내}, a printed QR-style payment placard, a receipt pad, a tip jar or coin tray, and contact/SNS card displaying {주소연락처} and {SNS핸들}.
7) Human activity zone: include casual customers and staff with natural posture, market-day clothing, and candid gestures such as pointing at the menu, handing over a tray, or arranging food.
8) Environment zone: situate the booth in {장소} with neighboring market stalls, folding chairs, fabric canopies, pavement seams, paper flyers, small balloons, warm bulbs, and late-afternoon street ambience.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: retro display fonts with bold weight for the main sign, condensed sans-serif for menu rows, handwritten chalk-style accents for recommendation cards, and clear Korean spacing for every price label.
- Color palette: navy, yellow, warm cream, muted red, charcoal, wood tones, kraft paper, brushed metal, and soft market fabric colors; coordinate all printed materials with {외관디자인}.
- Signage hierarchy: {브랜드명} should be the largest text, {업종설명} the second-largest, menu and price rows medium size, and contact/event information smaller but still readable.
- Printed materials: include physically plausible materials such as vinyl banner, chalkboard menu, laminated counter cards, kraft paper stickers, paper flyers, and a small sponsor strip on the event placard.
- Border/shadow: subtle natural cast shadows under the truck canopy, hanging boards, trays, and tables; soft realistic shadowing with 4px vertical offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity for any graphic overlays.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: documentary-style 35mm lens at f/4, eye-level outdoor product photography look, with enough depth of field to keep sign and menu readable.
- Lighting: soft overcast daylight or late-afternoon diffused sun from upper-left, with mild fill from the front to preserve food detail, skin tones, printed menu boards, and signage clarity.
- Color grade: warm vintage market grade with slightly desaturated blues, golden highlights, creamy whites, realistic fried-food browns, and natural Seoul street tones.
- Texture fidelity: show believable painted metal panels, canvas awning fabric, chalk dust, laminated menu sheen, wood tabletop grain, paper tray fibers, condiment bottle reflections, and gentle wear on wheels and counter edges.

[6. MOOD]
Indie market-day editorial — a candid lifestyle photo with the atmosphere of a Kinfolk street market spread mixed with a modern Seoul flea market vendor feature, lively enough to feel like a real pop-up booth and polished enough for a promotional listing.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following Korean strings must appear correctly and legibly in the rendered image: "치즈웨이 푸드트럭", "수제 치즈볼·치즈핫도그", "치즈볼", "치즈핫도그", "치즈튀김", "각 5,000원", "레트로·플리마켓·따뜻 빈티지".
- Additional booth text must appear correctly and legibly: "성수 주말 플리마켓", "2026.05.16 토 12:00-20:00", "B-12", "카드·현금·간편결제 가능", "서울 성동구 연무장길 38 / 010-2450-1919", "@cheeseway.market", "오늘만 치즈볼 1개 추가".
- The signage, menu boards, event placard, QR payment sign, counter labels, and contact card must have coherent Korean spacing, believable line breaks, and natural perspective.
- Keep the truck/booth design realistic and structurally plausible, with functional wheels or booth supports, service counter depth, awning hardware, visible cooking/prep area, and market-scale proportions.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters or garbled menu text
- Celebrity composites or recognizable public-figure faces
- Unrealistic official government-style endorsement marks

studio:prompts3:ours-190.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean food delivery app store main thumbnail, square promotional tile for app listing and search results.
Strong, scroll-stopping merchant hero image with clear food focus, coupon callout, price information, delivery metadata, and app-style CTA details for a realistic marketplace thumbnail.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject placement: the {시그니처메뉴} hero occupies about 56-60% of the frame, slightly lower-right, with glossy close-up food detail and a strong cropped hero-photo feeling.
- Merchant identity placement: place {매장명} and {업종} in the upper-left title block, paired with a small “대표메뉴” ribbon and a compact app-card label.
- Promotional structure: combine {할인쿠폰}, {메뉴가격}, {포인트카피}, and {주문CTA} as bold sticker, price tag, and button-like elements that feel native to a Korean delivery app.
- Information strip: show {평점리뷰}, {배달정보}, {영업정보}, and {매장주소} as realistic store metadata chips with thin dividers, small icons, and app UI hierarchy.
- Background treatment: vivid delivery-app promotional background with layered red, yellow, and black panels, halftone texture, diagonal delivery-ticket accents, sauce-splash shapes, and rounded app-card modules.
- Use {매장명}, {업종}, {시그니처메뉴}, {메뉴가격}, {할인쿠폰}, {포인트카피}, {평점리뷰}, {배달정보}, {영업정보}, {매장주소}, {주문CTA}, {컨셉톤} as the customizable content elements.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero food area (center-right, 56-60%): render {시그니처메뉴} as a high-detail commercial food close-up with glossy sauce, melted cheese stretch, visible rice-roll texture, steam-like freshness cues, sesame garnish, and shallow depth-of-field compression.
2. Merchant header area (top-left, 18%): place {매장명} in large bold Korean sans-serif, with {업종} below it in a smaller pill label; include a small “대표메뉴” ribbon and a warm yellow highlight bar behind the title.
3. Menu and price tag area (left-mid, 14%): display {시그니처메뉴} as the main menu label and {메뉴가격} as a price tag attached to the food photo, using thick black outline and a rounded rectangular sticker shape.
4. Discount badge area (upper-right or left-mid overlap, 12%): show {할인쿠폰} inside a compact coupon sticker with perforation marks, tiny scissors icon, strong contrast, and a bold red/yellow treatment.
5. Delivery app metadata strip (bottom band, 12%): arrange {평점리뷰}, {배달정보}, and {영업정보} as three app UI chips with star, clock, and bag icons; add thin divider lines between chips for a realistic store-card interface.
6. Point-copy area (bottom-left or bottom-center, 12%): display {포인트카피} as 2-3 short stacked lines, emphasizing key benefit words with alternating red, yellow, black, and white blocks.
7. Store footer and CTA (bottom-right, 8%): include {매장주소} in a small but readable caption line and render {주문CTA} as a rounded button-like callout, similar to an in-app order prompt.
8. Background graphic layer: reinforce {컨셉톤} through bold color blocks, diagonal accents, halftone dots, delivery-ticket motifs, sauce-splash graphics, and subtle paper-sticker shadows while keeping the food hero as the main focal point.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard ExtraBold or Noto Sans KR Black for major headings, 48-76px equivalent sizing; use 28-42px equivalent for secondary copy, and 18-24px equivalent for metadata chips with crisp Korean letterforms.
- Color palette: apply vivid delivery-app tones from {컨셉톤}; prioritize strong red #E53935, bright yellow #FFD400, deep black #111111, clean white #FFFFFF, and small warm-orange accents for coupon highlights.
- UI details: use rounded app-card modules, coupon perforation marks, price-tag corners, tiny star/clock/bag/location icons, thin divider lines, and sticker-style overlays with a realistic mobile commerce layout.
- Border/shadow: use crisp poster-style borders, 2-4px black outlines on headline boxes, and a soft drop shadow with 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity for the hero food, badges, price tags, and CTA button.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: commercial food photography look, 85mm f/2.8 close-up with crisp detail and slight background compression, studio-grade sharpness.
- Lighting: bright key light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from right, subtle specular highlights on sauce and cheese, controlled reflections on glossy food surfaces, and readable text zones.
- Color grade: punchy red-yellow-black delivery promo grade with high saturation, clean whites, rich warm highlights on the food hero, and appetizing contrast in the sauce and cheese.

[6. MOOD]
Korean delivery-app bestseller thumbnail — fast-scrolling marketplace promo aesthetic with the bold readability of a mobile food-commerce ad, the energy of a snack-food campaign, and the credibility of a real restaurant listing card.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 이미지에 정확히 보여야 함.
  - {매장명}
  - {업종}
  - {시그니처메뉴}
  - {메뉴가격}
  - {할인쿠폰}
  - {포인트카피}
  - {평점리뷰}
  - {배달정보}
  - {영업정보}
  - {매장주소}
  - {주문CTA}
- Layout invariant: the food hero must remain the largest visual element, and the store name, menu price, coupon badge, delivery metadata, and CTA must be clearly separated and readable at thumbnail size.
- Required rendered Korean labels may include realistic app-style micro labels such as “대표메뉴”, “쿠폰”, “배달정보”, “최소주문”, “오늘 영업”, and “주문하기”.
- The final image should feel like a polished Korean food delivery app merchant thumbnail, not a plain food photo or generic restaurant poster.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / government certifications
- Broken Korean characters or garbled Hangul
- Illegible tiny text in required copy
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized person likeness

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1536x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean educational lecture slide cover, 16:9 presentation opener for an AI-era career-planning talk.
Designed as a polished seminar title slide for parents and education professionals, suitable for classroom projectors, webinar thumbnails, printed handouts, and LMS course previews.
The slide should feel like a real first page from a premium Korean lecture deck, with practical session metadata, course navigation cues, and a compact infographic preview rather than an empty mockup.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Left panel occupies about 58% of the frame: large title block, subtitle, speaker line, mini agenda, and session label stacked with clear hierarchy.
- Right panel occupies about 42% of the frame: a compact educational infographic cluster combining upward bars, connected learning-path nodes, small subject icons, and note-card shapes, secondary to the title but rich enough to look like a real lecture opener.
- Background surface: calm off-white or light beige with subtle paper grain, soft translucent geometric blocks, faint grid ticks, and light editorial texture.
- Add a slim top header line with realistic course metadata such as "AI 진로 설계 워크숍", "2026 SPRING", "EDU INSIGHT SERIES", and a small slide code like "OPENING / 01".
- Add small realistic lecture-deck details: date label "2026.05.18", format label "LIVE CLASS + Q&A", page indicator "01 / INTRO", a small QR-code style square, and a short access note "자료 다운로드".
- Use {강의 주제}, {강사}, {대상}, {세션 번호/총 세션}, {컨셉 톤}, {추가 정보}, {비율/사이즈} as the content variables.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Title area (upper-left, 30% height): set {강의 주제} in the largest type, bold and highly legible, aligned left with confident line spacing and subtle emphasis marks such as a navy underline accent or olive highlight block behind one keyword.
- Subtitle line (under title): add a smaller supporting line describing the lecture context for {대상}, using concise Korean copy in medium weight, for example "AI 시대, 아이의 선택지를 넓히는 진로 로드맵".
- Speaker block (mid-left): present {강사} as a neat credential line, separated by a thin divider rule or small dot motif; add a small label such as "LECTURER" and a realistic role line like "교육전략 컨설턴트 · 진로 포트폴리오 코치".
- Mini agenda block (lower-mid left): include 3 short Korean agenda bullets in small cards: "1. 변화하는 직업 지형", "2. 역량 기반 진로 설계", "3. 가정에서의 대화 질문".
- Session label (lower-left): place {세션 번호/총 세션} inside a compact pill, tag, or boxed label with strong contrast; pair it with "SESSION" or "강의 순서".
- Right visual area (center-right): place a compact educational infographic dashboard: upward bars labeled "역량", "흥미", "경험", connected node path labeled "탐색 → 선택 → 실행", two small book/document icons, one checklist card, and a circular progress ring showing "72% 준비도".
- Add a small callout card near the right infographic with Korean microcopy: "핵심 질문", "무엇을 잘하는가?", "어떤 경험을 쌓을까?".
- Footer strip (bottom edge): place {추가 정보} in very small text, aligned to the lower-left or lower-right; include additional realistic footer metadata such as "교육 인포그래픽 슬라이드", "ver. 1.0", "문의: edu-lab@example.kr", and a page indicator "p.01".
- Overall spacing should feel like a professional slide deck with a clear alignment grid, readable projector-friendly hierarchy, and meaningful lecture-material details.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for the main title, Bold 42–56px; Medium 20–28px for supporting text; SemiBold 18–22px for labels; small metadata text 11–14px with excellent legibility.
- Color palette: navy #1F3A5F, olive #6B7D4C, beige #F3EBDD, warm gray #8A8F98, white #FFFFFF; use muted blue-gray and pale sage tints for small infographic cards.
- Border/shadow: use subtle 1px divider lines in muted gray and soft drop shadows on the right-side graphic cards, 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 12% opacity.
- Use {컨셉 톤} to influence accent intensity, icon softness, and wording style while keeping the deck professional and education-focused.
- Include tasteful editorial elements: micro labels, section tabs, tiny arrows, bracket marks, dotted connector lines, small chart legends, and light card layering.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: flat graphic presentation layout, top-down design composition, no photographic perspective, clean vector-like rendering.
- Lighting: even studio-style illumination with no harsh shadows, as if designed under a softbox-lit editorial template.
- Color grade: muted navy + sage + sand with high readability and low saturation.
- Rendering quality: crisp Korean typography, precise vector edges, realistic lecture-deck spacing, subtle paper grain, refined UI-card shadows, and balanced infographic density.

[6. MOOD]
Professional Korean education seminar opener — similar to a refined Inflearn/Taling instructor slide, a university lecture presentation deck, and a premium education consulting webinar cover.
Trustworthy, practical, calm, and content-rich, with the impression that the slide belongs to a complete lecture series rather than a placeholder template.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: "{강의 주제}", "{강사}", "{대상}", "{세션 번호/총 세션}", "{추가 정보}" must appear correctly if rendered as visible text.
- Render added Korean text cleanly and legibly, including examples such as "AI 진로 설계 워크숍", "2026.05.18", "자료 다운로드", "핵심 질문", "탐색 → 선택 → 실행", "강의 순서", and "교육 인포그래픽 슬라이드".
- Layout invariants: left-side text hierarchy must remain dominant; right-side illustration/data graphic must stay secondary and compact; all main text must be crisp, clean, and fully legible.
- Respect {비율/사이즈} while maintaining the 1536x1024 presentation-cover implication.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

studio:prompts3:ours-188.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean online/offline class 안내 카드 for social sharing, vertical promotional poster with clear hierarchy and realistic class-registration information.
Use a marketing-card layout inspired by Korean class platforms, balancing emotional hand-drawn accents, tactile paper details, ticket-style booking information, and neat informational blocks.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Top area (about 24%): place a small category pill {카테고리배지}, centered {클래스명} as the main title, and {강사명/소개} directly beneath in smaller type; add the bold hook headline {대표문구} to create a strong opening.
- Middle area (about 48%): create four separated info boxes for {일정·장소}, {온라인안내}, {구성/포함}, and {수강료·인원}, plus a compact schedule strip showing {세부일정}; use icon labels, dividers, and warm card surfaces.
- Lower area (about 18%): CTA zone featuring {CTA}, {신청링크}, {신청마감}, and a small mock QR-code box; include ticket/booking style microcopy and a clear application note.
- Footer band (about 10%): sponsor/organizer area with {주최/협력}, contact micro text {문의번호}, and small decorative class-related graphics such as brush stroke samples, washi tape, ink dots, pen nibs, and a tiny completed artwork thumbnail.
- Background: warm beige paper texture with visible subtle grain, layered off-white panels, muted gold accents, soft brown dividers, and handmade stationery motifs supporting the class theme.
- Spacing: polished editorial spacing with consistent 24–32px internal padding, readable grouping, layered but balanced visual rhythm, and strong hierarchy for mobile scanning.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header block: place {카테고리배지} at the very top as a rounded label, then set {클래스명} in the largest type, {강사명/소개} below in a lighter weight, and {대표문구} as a bold promotional line with a hand-brush underline.
2. Information grid: build a 2x2 card grid in the center section, each box clearly labeled and containing the exact class details for {일정·장소}, {온라인안내}, {구성/포함}, and {수강료·인원}; add small icons for calendar, pin, laptop, kit, and ticket.
3. Schedule and preparation strip: add a horizontal strip beneath the grid with {세부일정}, {준비물}, and {혜택태그}; treat it like a class timetable or checklist with tiny check marks.
4. Visual motif accents: add realistic small hand-drawn illustration elements such as pen nibs, brush strokes, ink swatches, paper tape, envelope corners, gold flecks, and spark-like decorative icons around the header and boxes while keeping the information fully readable.
5. CTA and ticket block: at the bottom, set {CTA} in a button-like rectangle or highlighted strip, place {신청링크} next to a mock QR-code box, show {신청마감} as a deadline badge, and include a ticket stub edge or perforation line for a practical booking feel.
6. Footer sponsor area: add {주최/협력} and {문의번호} in small but legible type, separated by thin dividers; include the phrase “온·오프라인 클래스 안내 카드” as a footer identifier.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for the main information, bold weight for headers, medium/regular for body text; pair with a hand-drawn brush/script accent only for emphasis phrases, labels, or underline details.
- Color palette: use {컨셉 톤} as the base direction, with beige #F4EBDD, warm ivory #FBF7F1, charcoal ink #2E2A27, muted gold #C8A45D, soft brown #8A6E56, and pale apricot #E9C9A7.
- Border/shadow: thin 1px warm-gray borders, soft drop shadow 0px 8px 24px rgba(46,42,39,0.10), lightly rounded 20px corners on info boxes, dotted ticket perforation on CTA area.
- Graphic details: use small realistic UI-like labels such as “D-7”, “정원 마감 임박”, “온라인 참여 가능”, and “키트 제공” when they support the card information.
- Text hierarchy: title must be immediately readable, feature details must be scannable, and the CTA must appear as the strongest action element near the bottom.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: flat graphic poster composition, top-down editorial layout inspired by clean social-card design rather than photography; if texture is needed, mimic scanned paper at 300dpi with subtle paper fiber detail.
- Lighting: diffuse studio-style illumination with no harsh highlights, even tonal distribution, soft shadowing only around cards and motif elements.
- Color grade: warm beige + muted gold + charcoal ink, with restrained contrast and paper-friendly tones.

[6. MOOD]
Korean class marketing card — like a polished Taling / Class101 promotional visual with a warm editorial layout, practical booking details, handmade stationery texture, and gentle hand-drawn charm.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 정확히 보여야 함
  - {카테고리배지}
  - {클래스명}
  - {강사명/소개}
  - {대표문구}
  - {일정·장소}
  - {온라인안내}
  - {구성/포함}
  - {수강료·인원}
  - {세부일정}
  - {준비물}
  - {혜택태그}
  - {신청마감}
  - {CTA}
  - {신청링크}
  - {주최/협력}
  - {문의번호}
  - 온·오프라인 클래스 안내 카드
- Layout invariants: top header contains category badge + class name + instructor + large headline; middle contains schedule/location, online information, inclusions, and price/capacity boxes; lower section contains schedule strip, QR-style application area, deadline badge, and CTA; footer contains organizer/sponsor information.
- Render realistic Korean poster microcopy such as “온라인 동시 진행”, “현장 수강 가능”, “준비물 안내”, “신청 마감”, “문의”, “주최/협력” as clean legible Korean text.
- All Korean text must be cleanly rendered with no broken characters.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- False government or institutional certification marks
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized celebrity likenesses

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean academy and private tutoring recruitment poster for English, math, coding, and arts.
Vertical admissions promo layout with a trust-forward school marketing feel, designed for parent-facing conversion, quick scanning, and real offline/online poster use.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Top header band: {학원명/분야} placed at the upper 14% with subject chips such as 영어·수학·코딩·예체능 and a large recruitment headline {모집 헤드라인} beneath it, left-aligned within a structured academy-ad grid.
- Main composition: centered information hierarchy with three boxed modules in the mid frame for {강조 포인트}, {합격 실적/후기}, and {이벤트}, each using short Korean labels and icon accents for fast reading.
- Event and visit strip: add a realistic poster information area with {설명회 일정}, {장소}, {등록 기간}, {참가/신청 안내}, and a small map-pin or calendar icon row.
- Footer conversion area: bottom bar contains {CTA}, {주소}, {운영 시간}, a QR-style 상담 신청 square, and a small sponsor/partner line {제휴 표기}.
- Background treatment: deep navy base with subtle gradient, faint premium paper grain, thin gold rules, warm ivory cards, and small education-themed decorative graphics such as pencil marks, book tabs, code brackets, music note, ruler line, and star stickers.
- Spacing and framing: readable padding, strong rectangular alignment, crisp separation between modules, and a balanced vertical flow from headline to benefits, proof, event details, then CTA.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header zone (top 18%): place {학원명/분야} in bold at the top, followed by {모집 헤드라인}; include a small date badge reading “2026 신학기” and a slim issue-style promo tag reading “ADMISSION GUIDE”.
2. Trust module (upper-mid 22%): create a prominent boxed area for {강조 포인트} with one or two highlighted lines, using gold accent labels, neat divider lines, and small check icons.
3. Achievement module (mid 18%): display {합격 실적/후기} in a compact stats-style card with visual emphasis on numbers, review count, outcomes, and a caption line “학부모 만족도 기반”.
4. Offer module (lower-mid 14%): show {이벤트} inside a highlighted callout box with a brighter gold accent, coupon-ticket graphic, and clear offer hierarchy.
5. Event detail strip (lower 14%): add “설명회 안내”, “등록 기간”, “장소”, and “신청 방법” labels with {설명회 일정}, {등록 기간}, {장소}, and {참가/신청 안내}; make it feel like a real recruitment poster rather than a simple banner.
6. CTA footer (bottom 14%): put {CTA} in a strong bottom bar with contact details, {주소}, {운영 시간}, QR-style box labeled “스캔하여 상담 신청”, and {제휴 표기} in small type.
7. Decorative support: use student illustration and subject icons as supportive visual anchors near the headline and module corners while keeping the text hierarchy primary.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR; headline ExtraBold 56–72px, section labels Semibold 24–28px, body Regular 20–24px, CTA Bold 26–32px, micro labels 14–18px.
- Color palette: navy #0B1F3A, deep blue #112B4A, gold #C9A24A, warm white #F7F4EE, muted gray #8A93A3, soft sky accent #DCEBFF for small chips.
- Border/shadow: thin gold borders 1.5–2px, ivory card edges, card shadows with 4px y-offset, 10px blur, 12% opacity, subtle embossed coupon edges for the event box.
- Information design: use real poster details including contact number, Kakao channel mention, QR box, date/time/venue row, address line, and sponsor/partner area.
- Decorative graphics: include small notebook tabs, check marks, calendar icon, map pin, code brackets, and subject stickers in navy/gold/ivory so the poster feels printed and realistic.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: clean graphic poster layout, top-down editorial composition feel inspired by modern Korean academy ads rather than photography-heavy ads.
- Lighting: soft studio-style illumination implied through subtle gradients and gentle contrast, with gold elements slightly brighter than the navy background.
- Color grade: navy + gold + warm ivory, restrained and premium, with mild contrast lift for legibility.
- Print realism: slight paper texture, precise vector-like text boxes, sharp Korean typography, and realistic academy flyer density suitable for A2 poster, window posting, and mobile sharing.

[6. MOOD]
Trustworthy Korean academy admissions poster — {컨셉 톤}. Premium education branding with the crisp hierarchy of a university brochure, realistic local academy information, and polished corporate-style layout.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: must render exactly the following strings if included in the design: {학원명/분야}, {모집 헤드라인}, {강조 포인트}, {합격 실적/후기}, {이벤트}, {설명회 일정}, {장소}, {등록 기간}, {참가/신청 안내}, {주소}, {운영 시간}, {CTA}, {제휴 표기}.
- Fixed Korean labels to include: “2026 신학기”, “ADMISSION GUIDE”, “무료 레벨 테스트”, “설명회 안내”, “등록 기간”, “오시는 길”, “스캔하여 상담 신청”, “학부모 만족도 기반”.
- Layout invariants: the top must contain academy name + field + large recruitment headline; the center must contain the three boxed modules; the lower area must contain event details; the bottom must contain CTA, contact information, QR-style 신청 box, and address.
- Typography must remain clean sans-serif with clear Korean readability across headline, body copy, contact line, and micro labels.
- Student illustration and subject icons should support the academy theme while preserving the poster’s parent-facing trust hierarchy.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / government or school certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or real-person endorsement likenesses

- output_size: 1536x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
IT startup app landing page hero visual, wide website header composition for a modern AI fitness coaching service. Create a realistic, content-rich product marketing key visual that looks like an actual launch landing page for a Korean mobile app, optimized for conversion, credibility, and immediate understanding of the service.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Left side hero block occupies about 52% of the frame: large headline at top, {태그라인} below, then feature list, trust/social-proof row, and CTA stack.
- Right side product block occupies about 40% of the frame: 2 vertically staggered mobile mockups showing app UI, slightly overlapping with realistic depth, glass reflection, device bevels, and app content visible.
- Add a realistic website header at the very top: small {서비스명} wordmark on the left, navigation labels in Korean such as “기능”, “AI 코칭”, “코스 추천”, “요금제”, “후기”, and a small login/start button on the right.
- Background is a polished startup gradient field with layered translucent UI panels, soft geometric shapes, subtle grid texture, faint route-map lines, AI data particles, and performance-themed motion arcs around the mockups.
- Include small credibility details: “Beta 2.4 업데이트”, “러너 48,219명 사용 중”, star rating micro text, and tiny partner/app-store style badges without claiming official certification.
- Use {서비스명}, {태그라인}, {핵심 기능 3}, {앱 스크린샷 자리}, {CTA}, {컨셉 톤}, {비율/사이즈} as the customizable content anchors.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Website nav zone (top, 8%): render a slim header bar with {서비스명}, Korean navigation menu items, and a compact rounded “무료 시작” or “앱 다운로드” button.
- Title zone (top-left, 18%): set {서비스명} as the main headline in large bold sans-serif, aligned left, with a clean modern hierarchy and strong visual weight. Add a small pill label above it: “AI FITNESS COACH · 2026 LAUNCH”.
- Tagline zone (under title, 8%): place {태그라인} in smaller regular-weight text with generous line spacing, readable at a glance, supported by one short Korean subcopy line such as “운동 기록, 페이스, 회복 데이터를 한 화면에서 확인하세요.”
- Feature zone (middle-left, 18%): present {핵심 기능 3} as three concise feature cards or bullet rows, each with a tiny icon: pace graph, route pin, trophy/community. Add small supporting labels like “LIVE”, “ROUTE”, “CREW”.
- CTA zone (bottom-left, 12%): place {CTA} as a clear button-style area with one primary CTA emphasis and one secondary option. Include realistic app download badges/text: “App Store”, “Google Play”, “무료 체험 7일”, and a tiny note “카드 등록 없이 시작”.
- Social proof strip (near CTA): add compact avatar circles, star rating, and Korean microcopy such as “오늘 12,804개의 러닝 세션 분석됨” and “평점 4.8 · 운동 코칭 앱”.
- Product zone (right side, 52% height): render {앱 스크린샷 자리} as realistic smartphone mockups with clean UI frames, subtle perspective tilt, soft shadow separation, glass highlights, and legible Korean UI details.
- Main phone UI: show a fitness dashboard with “오늘의 AI 코칭”, live pace card, heart-rate zone graph, weekly distance chart, route map preview, and a prominent button “코칭 시작”.
- Secondary phone UI: show “맞춤 코스 추천”, “한강 5K 회복런”, “인터벌 30분”, community challenge ranking, progress rings, and notification card “페이스가 안정적이에요”.
- Accent zone: add abstract line art, gradient orb, motion-trail accents, tiny floating analytics cards, route dots, and translucent data chips around the mockups to suggest AI, speed, and performance.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for Korean, Inter for English; headline 56–72px bold, body 20–28px regular/medium, CTA 18–22px semibold, navigation 15–17px medium, micro UI labels 10–14px.
- Color palette: use a modern startup gradient with violet #7C5CFF, teal #23D5D5, deep navy #0B1020, white #FFFFFF, and soft gray #E9EEF5.
- Border/shadow: mobile mockups with soft drop shadow 0px 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.18); CTA buttons with subtle 12px radius and gentle inner highlight; floating cards with translucent glassmorphism, fine 1px light strokes, and soft ambient glow.
- UI realism: app screens should include real interface density: status bars, tab bars, icons, graph axes, progress indicators, cards, route maps, small Korean labels, and notification banners.
- Landing page realism: include browser-like canvas proportions for {비율/사이즈}, crisp alignment, product screenshots, nav, CTAs, testimonial snippet, and small footer-like credit text such as “Made for everyday runners · Seoul”.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: high-end brand key visual look, equivalent to a 50mm standard lens on a full-frame camera, straight-on web hero composition with crisp product rendering.
- Lighting: studio softbox key from upper-left at 45°, faint cool fill from right, controlled glow around gradient accents, realistic reflections along phone glass and button surfaces.
- Color grade: polished violet-teal startup gradient with cool white UI surfaces and slightly darkened navy contrast for depth.
- Rendering quality: premium SaaS launch page, sharp vector typography, photoreal device edges, layered depth, soft shadows, realistic glow, polished Korean tech startup advertising finish.

[6. MOOD]
Korean tech startup landing hero — Stripe / Linear product marketing aesthetic with a polished premium SaaS feel, energetic fitness data storytelling, trustworthy AI coaching, and a real app-launch campaign atmosphere.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: must render these strings exactly as written: “WAVE — AI 운동 코치 앱”, “당신의 페이스를 AI가 분석합니다”, “실시간 페이스 분석 / 맞춤 코스 추천 / 커뮤니티 챌린지”, “앱 스토어 / Play 스토어 / 무료 시작”.
- Also include realistic supporting Korean UI text where appropriate: “오늘의 AI 코칭”, “코칭 시작”, “맞춤 코스 추천”, “한강 5K 회복런”, “주간 거리”, “페이스 안정”, “커뮤니티 챌린지”.
- Layout invariant: left text column and right smartphone mockups must remain clearly separated, with the hero composition balanced and conversion-focused.
- App UI in the mockups should look like a real fitness coaching app interface, clean and legible, with no distorted Korean characters.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

studio:prompts3:ours-185.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1536x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean new-car advertising poster, cinematic night skyline hero shot, premium luxury automotive campaign for social-media and billboard-style presentation.
Designed to feel like a global launch visual for a futuristic EV, with a dramatic road-at-night composition and minimal copy.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Canvas is horizontal 1536x1024 with a strong center-weighted vehicle hero composition; the car occupies about 55–60% of frame width and sits slightly lower than center for a powerful road-contact feel.
- Background treatment: dense urban night skyline with softened building silhouettes, wet asphalt reflections, and long-exposure light trails stretching diagonally into depth; keep the scene polished and premium, not crowded.
- Place {브랜드/모델} as the primary brand cue in a clean ad layout, while {브랜드 로고 위치} stays small and unobtrusive.
- Use {키 비주얼} as the visual base, but push the scene into a cinematic launch-poster look with controlled negative space around text.
- Reserve a clear text zone for {태그라인 (영문)} and {한글 카피 한 줄} so they remain highly legible against the dark backdrop.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero vehicle area (mid-lower 60%): the car is sharply lit with glossy body highlights, crisp wheel detail, and a slight front-three-quarter angle to reveal stance, grille/face, and aerodynamic lines; reflections from city lights should contour the body without washing it out.
2. Road and light-trail base (bottom 25%): reflective asphalt with subtle lane perspective, thin golden and cool-blue light streaks, and a few specular highlights to suggest speed and premium motion.
3. Skyline and atmosphere (upper 35%): dark urban towers receding into haze, deep blue-black sky, faint bokeh windows, and a restrained cinematic glow behind the car to separate silhouette from background.
4. Brand text block: set {태그라인 (영문)} as the largest copy element, with {한글 카피 한 줄} placed beneath it in a smaller but still confident size; keep both aligned cleanly with generous tracking and no extra marketing clutter.
5. Logo placement: position the small brand mark at {브랜드 로고 위치}, scaled down so it supports the ad rather than competing with the hero car.
6. Concept consistency: {컨셉 톤} should be expressed through high-contrast lighting, sleek reflections, and an upscale monochrome base with selective blue and gold accents.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard Bold or Inter Bold for {태그라인 (영문)}, sized like a headline, with slight letter spacing; use Pretendard Medium for {한글 카피 한 줄} at a smaller size; keep alignment crisp and premium.
- Color palette: deep black #050608, midnight blue #0A1630, steel gray #8A9099, electric blue #2D6BFF, warm gold #C8A24A, soft silver #D9DEE6.
- Border/shadow: no decorative border; use subtle typography shadow only if needed, such as 20% opacity soft shadow with 6px blur to preserve readability on the dark background.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: cinematic automotive ad look shot on a Canon EOS R5 with an 85mm f/1.4 for the hero angle, or a 70-200mm at roughly 120mm for compressed premium proportions; shallow depth of field with the car fully sharp and the city slightly softened.
- Lighting: controlled studio-like rim lights mixed with realistic night reflections; key light from upper-left at about 45°, faint blue fill from the right, and a thin gold edge highlight tracing the roofline and hood.
- Color grade: monochrome base with deep-blue shadows, cool metallic midtones, and restrained gold accents; high contrast, glossy blacks, and clean highlight roll-off.

[6. MOOD]
Luxury automotive launch poster — Hyundai IONIQ / Genesis / BMW / Porsche campaign energy, with a polished cinematic night-drive atmosphere and magazine-grade precision.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following strings must appear exactly as written: "내일을 달리다".
- English text accuracy: the following strings must appear exactly as written: "Drive the Future".
- Brand text accuracy: render {브랜드/모델} clearly and cleanly as the main brand identifier.
- No extra information panels, no pricing, no specs table, no CTA box, no paragraph copy beyond the headline/tagline and the single Korean line.
- Vehicle anatomy/layout: the car must look physically accurate, with proper wheel alignment, realistic reflections, and a believable road contact shadow.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Price, specs, financing copy, or CTA blocks
- Overly busy neon signage or toy-like car proportions
- Duplicate headline text or illegible text overlays
