args.name: 컨셉 톤
args.default: 럭셔리 시네마틱 광고 — 검+딥블루+골드 액센트, Hyundai N 또는 IONIQ 톤

studio:prompts3:ours-184.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean kids cafe store visual and event poster for print and social media.
A friendly, colorful vertical promo poster that highlights {매장명}, signature play facilities, seasonal event packages, pricing, date/time/venue information, reservation benefits, and a clear contact CTA.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main headline, {매장명}, and {이벤트명} occupy the top 24% of the poster, with playful children/animal illustrations, balloons, paper garlands, puzzle pieces, and toy blocks framing the title area.
- Center area uses a lively 2-column rounded-card layout: facilities on the left, event packages and pricing on the right, with icon stickers, small speech bubbles, and colorful dividers that feel like a real kids cafe flyer.
- Add a mid-lower information strip for {행사기간}, {운영시간}, {장소}, and {티켓혜택}, using calendar, clock, pin, and ticket icons.
- Bottom 14–16% forms a strong CTA band with {CTA}, {SNS해시태그}, and small save/share-style social icons arranged for social media reposting.
- Include a small sponsor/partner area near the footer labeled “함께하는 이웃” with {협찬문구}, styled as friendly local partner badges rather than official seals.
- Background is a bright cream base with pastel color blocks, soft confetti dots, star icons, crayons, toy-train shapes, sticker labels, and rounded decorative graphics, creating a full family-event poster atmosphere.
- Use {컨셉 톤} as the dominant visual direction while keeping the hierarchy readable and clearly divided into headline, benefits, details, and CTA.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top header area: Place {매장명} at the top center with a ribbon label “KIDS PLAY EVENT” and a large playful Korean headline such as “오늘도 신나는 놀이시간!” beneath it. Surround the title with cute bear, rabbit, dinosaur, balloon, crayon, and building-block illustrations.
2. Event hero badge: Add {이벤트명} in a bright starburst or cloud-shaped badge, with a small subcopy line “우리 아이 첫 파티부터 가족 모임까지 한 번에!” in rounded Korean lettering.
3. Middle content area, left card: Show {시그니처 시설} as a neat icon list with labels for ball pit, slide, block room, art corner, and snack bar. Add small childlike sticker captions such as “인기!”, “오늘의 놀이”, “사진 찍기 좋아요”.
4. Middle content area, right card: Present {이벤트 패키지} and {이용시간/요금} in stacked colorful boxes. Package names should be emphasized with cupcake/party-hat icons, and pricing should use a bolder weight with won-symbol readability.
5. Event details strip: Add four compact info chips: “행사기간 {행사기간}”, “운영시간 {운영시간}”, “장소 {장소}”, and “예약혜택 {티켓혜택}”. Use calendar, clock, map-pin, and ticket illustrations.
6. Reassurance band: Add {안내문구} with shield, smile, hand-wash, and socks icons, styled as friendly store guidance rather than warning text.
7. Sponsor/partner area: Include a small line “함께하는 이웃 · {협찬문구}” with tiny rounded partner badges and decorative dots, clearly secondary to the CTA.
8. Footer CTA area: Place {CTA} centered inside a high-contrast rounded banner with phone, chat, and Instagram-style icons. Add {SNS해시태그} below or beside it as a social-sharing line.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Use Pretendard ExtraBold for the main headline, Pretendard Bold for section labels, and Noto Sans KR Medium for details; add a rounded hand-drawn Korean accent font for sticker captions and small decorative phrases.
- Color palette: Bright yellow #FFD84D, bubble pink #FF7DB3, sky blue #6EC8FF, mint #7FE3C2, soft coral #FF8A6B, white #FFFFFF, warm cream #FFF9EF, charcoal #333333, and small lavender accents #BFA7FF.
- Border/shadow: Rounded cards with 18–24px corner radius, soft drop shadow 0px 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.10), subtle white stroke on colorful panels, sticker-like dashed dividers, scalloped ribbons, and soft paper-cut style labels.
- Information hierarchy: The store name and event headline must read first, then package/pricing, then date/time/venue, then CTA. Use bold color blocks and icon labels to guide the eye.
- Decorative graphics: Use toy blocks, confetti, stars, crayons, party hats, tiny animal faces, and balloon strings as thematic poster elements that support the kids cafe concept.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Clean graphic poster layout with a front-facing design approach, like a polished Adobe Illustrator / Figma promotional mockup rather than a photographed scene.
- Lighting: Bright even studio-style illumination with no visible harsh shadows, as if under diffused softbox light for a clean family-friendly retail poster.
- Color grade: High-saturation pastel grade with warm cream balance, candy-like accents, and crisp contrast for legibility.

[6. MOOD]
한국 키즈카페 마케팅 포스터 — 일본 캐릭터 카페 전단지의 친근함과 Pinterest-style family event flyer의 정돈감을 섞은 느낌. 실제 동네 키즈카페 입구, 엘리베이터 게시판, 인스타그램 피드에 붙어 있어도 자연스러운 활기찬 행사 안내물 분위기.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 들어가야 하는 문구: “{매장명}”, “{이벤트명}”, “{시그니처 시설}”, “{이벤트 패키지}”, “{이용시간/요금}”, “{행사기간}”, “{운영시간}”, “{장소}”, “{티켓혜택}”, “{CTA}”, “{SNS해시태그}”.
- Poster detail requirements: 행사 안내 문구로 “오늘도 신나는 놀이시간!”, “함께하는 이웃”, “예약혜택”, “KIDS PLAY EVENT”가 자연스럽게 보여야 한다.
- Layout invariants: Top area must contain the store name and a large headline; middle area must contain facility, event, and pricing boxes; event date/time/venue and ticket benefit must be visible; CTA must be clearly visible at the bottom.
- Safety tone: The poster should feel cheerful, trustworthy, warm, and suitable for children and parents.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Misleading celebrity composites or fake celebrity endorsements
- Unreadable contact, price, date, or venue information

studio:prompts3:ours-183.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean daycare / kindergarten recruitment and information poster, vertical A3-style social poster for mobile sharing and print display. It should feel like a real local preschool recruitment notice with parent-friendly details, clear admissions information, and warm educational branding.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Top 22%: {기관명} in a large friendly header, a small poster label such as “2026 신학기 안내”, and a bold recruitment headline using {안내종류}. Add issue-like detail text “모집 안내 포스터 · 2026 봄” and gentle children-and-nature illustration elements framing the header.
- Upper-middle 20%: cheerful hero banner with {모집대상}, {모집기간}, and {입학혜택} displayed as three rounded badges or sticky-note cards.
- Middle 34%: two stacked information boxes for {프로그램} and {견학안내}, separated by soft rounded dividers, small icons, friendly captions, and realistic parent guidance microcopy.
- Lower 14%: practical information strip showing {위치}, {운영시간}, {상담예약}, a small QR-style reservation box labeled {QR라벨}, and a compact sponsor / partner area using {협력문구}.
- Bottom 10%: high-contrast CTA button strip with {CTA}, plus a tiny footer line with “상담 가능 시간 · 평일 09:00–18:00”. Use {컨셉톤} as the overall visual direction.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header zone (top): Place {기관명} centered in a large masthead style, with a smaller ribbon label “2026 신학기 원아모집” and the main headline {안내종류} directly underneath. Add polished childlike motifs such as smiling sun, clouds, leaves, crayons, picture-book animals, tiny backpacks, and flower stickers around the header while keeping the headline dominant.
2. Recruitment detail badges (upper-middle): Create three pastel rounded badges: “대상: {모집대상}”, “기간: {모집기간}”, and “혜택: {입학혜택}”. Make them look like real poster information tags with small calendar, child, and gift icons.
3. Main hero accent: Build a cheerful recruitment banner feel with a large rounded pastel panel behind the headline and badges, layered paper-cut shapes, subtle grain texture, gentle drop shadows, and soft depth. Include a small illustration of diverse children reading, planting, painting, or playing safely in a classroom garden setting.
4. Program information box: Present {프로그램} as a neatly organized list with four icon bullets. Add supporting caption text such as “하루 일과 속에서 자연스럽게 배우는 통합 놀이 교육” and use a soft card with a thin border and subtle shadow.
5. Tour / visit information box: Present {견학안내} in a second rounded card with calendar and clock icons. Include practical lines: “견학 소요 시간 30분 내외”, “보호자 동반”, “사전 예약 후 방문”. Make the schedule line especially legible.
6. Parent information strip: Add {상담예약}, {위치}, and {운영시간} in three compact columns with small map-pin, phone, and clock icons. Add a QR-style square labeled {QR라벨}, visually like a real scannable reservation area without needing to be functional.
7. Sponsor / partner area: Add a small footer-side sponsor block reading {협력문구}, styled as a polite community-support line, with simple icon marks rather than fake official seals.
8. CTA zone (bottom): Set {CTA} in a warm coral or sky-blue pill button, with secondary microcopy “상담 신청은 선착순 예약제로 진행됩니다” and a clean footer line. Maintain consistent alignment and tactile paper-poster realism.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for all Korean text, bold 800 for headers, semi-bold 700 for badges, medium 500 for body copy, clear size hierarchy from masthead to footnote; friendly rounded Korean font feeling is allowed for accents but main information must stay highly readable.
- Color palette: soft pastel yellow #FFE8A3, sky blue #BFE6FF, fresh leaf green #CFE9B1, cream #FFF9EF, coral accent #FFB6A6, lavender #DCCBFF, charcoal text #2E2E2E.
- Border/shadow: rounded 24px cards, 1.5px soft border in #E9E2D6, shadow 0px 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.08), pill buttons, sticker-like badges, washi-tape accents, and paper-cut illustration layers.
- Printed-poster realism: add very subtle paper fiber texture, gentle ink softness, tiny registration-like footer details, and realistic spacing between information blocks so it resembles a professionally designed local recruitment poster.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: clean graphic poster layout, simulated front-on editorial composition, equivalent to a 35mm overhead design presentation with no perspective distortion.
- Lighting: bright diffused daylight feel, as if lit by a large softbox from upper-left with even fill across the page; no harsh contrast.
- Color grade: warm cream base with pastel sky blue, leaf green, sunlit yellow, coral, and lavender; slightly desaturated for a calm kindergarten brochure look.

[6. MOOD]
Korean childcare marketing poster — gentle, trustworthy family brochure aesthetic with a polished preschool-brand feel, practical admissions notice details, cheerful spring semester energy, and warm neighborhood credibility.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 표기할 문자열: “햇살 어린이집”, “신학기 모집 — 4·5세반 모집”, “대상: 4·5세반”, “모집 기간: 2026.02.01–02.28”, “놀이 중심 교육 / 외국어 / 미술·음악 / 자연 체험”, “매주 금요일 오전 10시 견학 가능 (예약 필수)”, “입학 상담 예약 무료”, “서울시 마포구 햇살로 12”, “평일 08:00–19:00”, “전화 02-XXX-XXXX / 홈페이지 / 카톡 채널”.
- Add small realistic poster text: “2026 신학기 원아모집”, “상담 신청은 선착순 예약제로 진행됩니다”, “QR로 견학 예약”, “협력: 지역 도서관·숲체험 교실”.
- Text layout must remain legible, with no broken Hangul, no missing punctuation, and clear separation between the header, recruitment badges, program box, visit box, parent information strip, QR label, sponsor area, and CTA.
- Use child-safe, warm, non-aggressive visual language; all characters and illustrations should feel friendly, age-appropriate, and suitable for a Korean daycare / kindergarten admissions poster.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications / government endorsement marks
- Broken Korean characters or unreadable Hangul
- Celebrity composites or real child likeness imitation without consent
- Misleading awards, rankings, or accreditation badges

studio:prompts3:ours-182.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1536x1024
- canvas_format: {비율사이즈}

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean pet shop and dog grooming salon brand visual, multi-cut store showcase and goods mockup for Instagram, blog, and homepage hero usage.
Create a realistic small-business campaign board that combines storefront, interior salon, merchandise, staff grooming action, service information, and local contact details in one cohesive branded canvas.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: a polished pet shop / dog grooming salon branded as {매장명}, described as {업종설명}, presented as a unified visual identity across all cuts.
- Composition: arrange {포함컷} across a single canvas with a dominant hero panel and supporting panels that feel like real campaign photography for a neighborhood premium pet salon.
- Layout: use {레이아웃} with consistent gutters, aligned panel edges, rounded cards, readable information blocks, and a natural magazine-style hierarchy.
- Background treatment: warm pastel retail environment with beige-pink-sage surfaces, soft rounded furniture, clean retail shelving, grooming tools, dog beds, treat jars, leash hooks, towel stacks, and subtle dog-illustration accent details.
- Information area: include a practical store-info zone with address, contact, operating hours, Instagram handle, signature service, and a small service-price preview.
- Local realism: make the storefront signage, window stickers, staff name badge, product shelf labels, and footer microcopy look like believable Korean shop branding rather than generic placeholder design.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Hero panel: feature the storefront of {매장명} with a welcoming street-facing facade, large glass windows, pastel awning, soft illuminated signage, a tidy entryway, seasonal potted plants, a small sandwich board, and window decals reading “펫부띠끄”, “강아지 전문 미용실 + 펫샵”, “예약 상담”. Use a realistic slightly wide perspective that shows the brand presence and sidewalk context.
- Interior panel: show the salon interior with grooming table, dryer, pet waiting corner, product shelves, towel cabinet, mirror, shampoo station, appointment clipboard, and clean floor reflections. Add small readable labels such as “오늘의 예약”, “목욕 케어”, “안심 미용룸” to make the space feel actively operated.
- Goods panel: display {굿즈목록} as styled retail goods on a shelf or tabletop: plush toys, dental chews, shampoo bottles, brushes, bows, bandanas, treat pouches, and sample gift bags. Packaging should use coordinated pastel labels with Korean product names, price tags, and small paw-shaped hang tags.
- Staff work panel: depict {직원명} gently grooming a small calm dog on a table, with careful hand positioning, visible scissors, comb, apron, name badge, towel, spray bottle, and a reassuring posture. The dog should have natural fur detail, relaxed eyes, and realistic proportions.
- Info strip: integrate {주소}, {전화번호}, {운영시간}, {인스타그램}, and {대표서비스} as a compact footer or side note block with simple icon-like separators, QR-style reservation box, and a short CTA chip reading “예약 문의하기”.
- Service and price module: add a small pricelist card using {가격표}, with clear dividers and Korean won symbols, like a real in-store service menu.
- Promotional detail: include a small pastel sticker or ribbon label with {프로모션문구}, placed on the goods or footer area without covering important imagery.
- Color unity: all cuts should share the same pastel grade, signage style, lighting direction, and typography so the set feels like one brand campaign rather than separate images.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR, medium to bold weight for headers, regular weight for body text, 24–42px equivalent sizing for main labels, 14–22px equivalent sizing for footer details and price tags.
- Color palette: {컨셉톤} with specific tones such as beige #EADCCF, blush pink #F4C9C6, sage #B9C7B4, warm cream #F7F1E8, soft cocoa #8B6A5A, and muted terracotta #C88E7F for CTA accents.
- Panel design: use rounded panel corners, subtle 1px warm-gray dividers, soft drop shadows with 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 12% opacity, and tactile paper-label chips that feel like premium pet boutique stationery.
- Graphic accents: use dog-line icons, small paw motifs, stitched-label shapes, tiny bone dividers, illustrated shampoo bubbles, leash-loop decorations, and pastel sticker graphics to enrich the retail identity.
- Text placement: keep key Korean copy large enough to read at 1536x1024, especially storefront signage, footer contact details, Instagram handle, and service-price preview.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: realistic commercial interior photography look, 24–35mm full-frame lens for the exterior and interior, 50mm for goods close-ups, f/4 to f/5.6 for balanced sharpness.
- Lighting: soft overcast daylight or diffused window light from upper-left at 45°, with gentle fill from the right and low-contrast shadows.
- Color grade: warm pastel editorial grade with creamy whites, muted blush, sage-green accents, and slight filmic softness; keep blacks lifted slightly for a friendly retail mood.
- Material rendering: realistic glass reflections, matte paper packaging, soft plush fabric, shiny shampoo bottles, brushed metal grooming tools, ceramic treat bowls, cotton towels, and natural dog fur texture.

[6. MOOD]
Premium neighborhood pet-brand editorial — a Kinfolk-style lifestyle spread mixed with polished small-business commercial photography, warm staff care, cute dog personality, and practical shop information for real customers.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 정확히 보여야 함: “펫부띠끄”, “강아지 전문 미용실 + 펫샵”, “매장 위치”, “인스타”, “시그니처 서비스”.
- 추가로 다음 매장 정보가 읽히게 표현되어야 함: “서울 마포구 연남로 24”, “02-1234-5678”, “화–일 10:00–19:00”, “@pet_boutique_kr”, “첫 방문 위생미용 20%”.
- 가격표 텍스트 예시가 자연스럽게 보여야 함: “위생미용 ₩35,000”, “스파 목욕 ₩45,000”, “풀케어 ₩75,000”.
- Layout consistency: all 4 cuts must use the same tone, palette, typography, and brand styling; no panel should feel visually disconnected.
- If any human hands are visible, they must be anatomically correct and natural in grooming posture.
- If dogs are shown, keep them cute, calm, and proportionate, with natural fur detail and no distortion.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or recognizable public figures
- Counterfeit award medals or government-style marks

studio:prompts3:ours-181.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
반려동물 SNS 콘텐츠용 정사각형 1컷 피드 카드. 한국 반려동물 계정에서 바로 업로드하기 좋은 생일 축하 비주얼로, {컨셉}에 맞춘 실제 인스타그램 카드뉴스 첫 장처럼 사진풍 또는 따뜻한 일러스트 스타일을 기반으로 구성한다. 완성 이미지는 {비율/사이즈} 업로드에 적합한 풍성한 생일 파티 장면, 계정 핸들, 날짜/장소 라벨, 해시태그, 저장·공유 마이크로 아이콘, 슬라이드 표시를 함께 담아 실제 운영 중인 반려동물 SNS 콘텐츠처럼 보이게 한다.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- {반려동물}가 프레임의 중심 55~60%를 차지하도록 배치하고, {장면} 요소는 주변을 감싸는 방식으로 360°를 채운다.
- 배경은 크림 화이트 기반의 따뜻한 파티룸 또는 홈스튜디오 느낌으로, 옅은 파스텔 그라데이션, 종이 가랜드, 패브릭 러그, 작은 테이블, 선물 상자, 꽃잎, 리본 끈, 종이 컨페티, 손글씨 카드 태그 같은 실제 생일 촬영 소품이 자연스럽게 보이도록 처리한다.
- 상단 15%에는 생일 헤드라인, {계정핸들}, {에디션라벨}, 작은 프로필 원형 썸네일 느낌의 UI 요소를 함께 넣는다.
- 하단 20%에는 서브텍스트, {날짜} · {장소} 라벨, {해시태그}, {좋아요수}, 하트·댓글·공유·저장 형태의 작은 SNS 마이크로 아이콘, {슬라이드표시} 페이지 인디케이터를 배치한다.
- 전체 구도는 중앙집중형이되, 풍선·꽃·모자·케이크·작은 카드 태그·파티 컨페티가 원형 리듬을 이루도록 {장면}을 균형 있게 분산한다.
- 카드 상단 좌측에는 작은 프로필 핸들 “{계정핸들}”, 상단 우측에는 “{에디션라벨}” 같은 에디션 라벨을 넣어 반려동물 SNS 콘텐츠 세트의 한 장처럼 보이게 한다.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Hero area (center 60%): {반려동물}을 가장 또렷한 피사체로 두고, 얼굴 표정이 잘 보이게 정면 또는 3/4 각도로 배치한다. 털결은 선명하지만 과도한 샤프닝은 피하고, 눈빛과 코의 촉촉한 질감, 목줄 또는 리본 액세서리의 섬세한 질감이 살아나도록 한다.
- Event props layer: {장면}의 케이크는 하단 중앙에 두고, “1” 숫자 풍선은 좌우 한쪽에 살짝 비대칭으로 세워 입체감을 준다. 꽃은 케이크 주변 바닥면과 작은 테이블 위에 낮게 흩어 배치하고, 모자는 {반려동물} 머리 위 또는 옆에 자연스럽게 얹는다. 케이크 위 초, 작은 이름표 “{반려동물이름}”, 리본 장식, 접시, 크림 자국, 떨어진 꽃잎, 작은 발자국 모양 쿠키 같은 현실적인 디테일을 더한다.
- Text block: 상단 헤더와 하단 보조 문구를 분리해 배치한다. {텍스트}는 각각 줄 간격을 넓혀 읽기 쉽게 구성하고, 한국어 문장은 가장 크게, 영어 문장은 그보다 15~20% 작게 처리한다. 헤드라인 주변에는 작은 말풍선 라벨 “오늘은 주인공”, 하단에는 “{날짜} · {장소}”처럼 날짜/장소 라벨을 넣는다.
- Instagram UI-inspired details: 하단 좌측에는 “{좋아요수}” 느낌의 작은 텍스트, 하단 중앙에는 “{해시태그}” 같은 짧은 해시태그, 하단 우측에는 하트·댓글·공유·저장 형태의 작은 라인 아이콘을 넣어 SNS 카드의 현실감을 높인다. 우측 하단 모서리에는 “{슬라이드표시}”를 작게 넣어 콘텐츠 세트의 첫 장처럼 보이게 한다.
- Caption sticker layer: 사진 위에 겹친 얇은 반투명 스티커로 “{짧은캡션}”, “오늘 간식 두 배”, “생일 축하해” 같은 문구를 배치하고, 테이프 조각과 둥근 라벨 스티커가 실제 종이 위에 붙은 듯한 그림자와 질감을 갖게 한다.
- Accent details: 작은 별, 하트, 반짝이 아이콘, 스티커형 라벨, 테이프 조각, 작은 생일 깃발을 텍스트 주변과 모서리에 배치한다. 장식은 {컨셉톤}에 맞게 귀엽고 따뜻하게 유지하되, 실제 촬영 세트처럼 재질감과 그림자가 느껴지도록 한다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard ExtraBold for headline, Noto Sans KR SemiBold for subtext, rounded and friendly letterforms, headline size hint 64~76px, subtext 30~36px, micro UI text 16~20px.
- Color palette: warm pastel pink #F7C9D4, cream #FFF6EC, butter yellow #F6E7A6, mint #CDEEDB, soft brown #7A5A48, light gray #E9E4DD.
- Border/shadow: subtle rounded card border, 12px corner radius, soft drop shadow 0 8px 24px rgba(122,90,72,0.12), tactile paper-card edge and gentle layered sticker shadows.
- Graphic finishing: combine real pet portrait texture with editorial social-card overlays; use cream paper grain, satin balloon highlights, matte sticker labels, glossy UI icon highlights, and soft floral details so the card feels printed, photographed, and posted rather than flat.
- Text hierarchy: main birthday message must be readable at thumbnail size, while handle, hashtags, date label, slide indicator, likes count, and UI icons remain smaller but legible enough to suggest a real Korean pet account post.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame 50mm f/2.0 pet portrait look, eye-level framing, shallow depth of field if photo-realistic; if illustrated, mimic clean editorial pet photography composition.
- Lighting: soft window light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from front-right, realistic catchlights in the eyes, mild contact shadows under cake, paws, balloons, paper tags, stickers, and props, bright and evenly exposed.
- Color grade: pastel editorial grade with cream highlights, warm beige midtones, soft pink accents, slightly desaturated greens.
- Realism cues: visible fur direction, fabric weave on party hat ribbon, glossy balloon reflections, buttercream texture on cake, paper fibers on labels, subtle floor shadows, slightly uneven ribbon ends, tiny confetti overlaps, and small imperfections that make the birthday set feel photographed.

[6. MOOD]
Korean pet SNS birthday post — cozy boutique social graphic with a Kinfolk-like pastel editorial feel, a gentle handmade-card aesthetic, and the lively realism of a beloved 반려동물 birthday party captured for Instagram. 따뜻하고 사랑스럽지만 실제 계정에 올라온 피드 카드처럼 정보 요소와 촬영 소품이 풍성하게 살아 있어야 한다.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 표시할 문구는 “해피 첫 생일”, “우리 콩이의 1살”, “Happy 1st Birthday”.
- 추가로 이미지 안에 작게 표시할 수 있는 한국어/SNS 문구: “오늘은 주인공”, “좋아요 12,847개”, “#첫생일 #강아지생일 #반려동물스타그램”, “2026.05.01 · 서울 홈스튜디오”, “@kong_petdiary”, “1/3”, “저장해두고 생일 준비 참고”.
- {반려동물}의 얼굴과 표정이 주인공처럼 가장 선명해야 하며, 소품이나 텍스트가 얼굴을 가리면 안 된다.
- 생일 숫자 “1”과 케이크는 반드시 화면에서 읽히고, 풍선·꽃·모자가 생일 테마로 명확히 인식되어야 한다.
- 전체 레이아웃은 정사각형 SNS 카드로 한눈에 읽히는 구조여야 하며, {컨셉톤}의 따뜻하고 사랑스러운 분위기를 유지해야 한다.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or real-person impersonation
- Aggressive, cruel, or scary pet 표현

args.name: 텍스트
args.default: 해피 첫 생일 / 우리 콩이의 1살 / 해피 퍼스트 버스데이

args.default: 따뜻한 파스텔과 작은 일러스트 액센트가 있는 인스타 친화 톤

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean veterinary clinic information poster and reservation card for front-desk printing, apartment bulletin boards, KakaoTalk sharing, and Instagram story reposting.
Vertical clinic promo layout with friendly pet illustration accents, designed to communicate services, hours, benefits, location, booking method, and a detachable-looking reservation card CTA at a glance.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Top 22%: {병원명} centered as the main brand title, with {대표문구} as a large service headline beneath it; include warm dog/cat illustration elements, paw-print stickers, a small date label {프로모션기간}, and a clinic badge-style label reading “예약 안내”.
- Middle 48%: three stacked info boxes for {진료항목}, {진료시간}, and {이벤트혜택}, each with rounded corners, icon bullets, tiny captions, and divider lines; add small pet-care micro graphics such as syringe, stethoscope, tooth, grooming scissors, and health-check clipboard icons.
- Lower 16%: clinic access strip with {주소}, {전화번호}, {카카오채널}, {QR안내}, and {진료대상}; include map-pin, phone, chat bubble, and QR placeholder frame.
- Bottom 14%: reservation card / coupon-style CTA block separated by a dotted cut line, showing {예약카드문구}, {예약마감}, {수의사명}, and a prominent button-like {CTA}; add small “방문 전 예약 권장” note and {소셜태그}.
- Background treatment: warm pastel base with cream-white paper feel, subtle beige paper grain, layered rounded blobs, paw-print confetti, small heart stickers, and gentle pet-themed illustration details.
- Overall format must feel like a realistic printed clinic poster plus a reservation card section, sized for {비율사이즈}.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Header area: place {병원명} in a bold rounded masthead style at the top center, with {대표문구} directly below; add a friendly puppy face on the left and a calm cat face on the right, plus small labels such as “동네 주치의”, “예약 가능”, and “초진 환영”.
- Info card 1: show section title “진료 항목” and render {진료항목} in a clean rounded box with icon-style separators; include a tiny caption “반려동물 상태에 맞춘 맞춤 상담”.
- Info card 2: show section title “진료 시간” and render {진료시간} in a matching box beneath the services section; include a clock icon, weekday / Saturday / Sunday row styling, and a small note “점심시간 및 공휴일은 병원 문의”.
- Info card 3: show section title “이벤트·혜택” and present {이벤트혜택} in a highlighted pastel accent panel; add a coupon ribbon reading “5월 예약 혜택” and a small date chip {프로모션기간}.
- Access information strip: place {주소}, {전화번호}, {카카오채널}, and {QR안내} in compact footer cards; include a simple illustrated map pin and a square QR-code placeholder graphic that looks scannable but not tied to a real service.
- Reservation card footer: create a dotted tear-off style band with the title {예약카드문구}; include fields “보호자명 / 반려동물명 / 희망일 / 연락처” as printed form lines, then place {CTA} as the strongest button element.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for all Korean text; title weight 800–900, section labels weight 700, body text weight 400–500, with the headline noticeably larger than all other text.
- Color palette: cream #FFF8F1, beige #EADBC8, sage #B9C7B0, dusty pink #E9B7C0, soft brown #7A5E52, charcoal #3A3432, plus tiny warm yellow #F4D58D accents for coupons and highlights.
- Border/shadow: rounded 20–28px corners, soft drop shadow with 0px x-offset, 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 14% opacity; use thin divider lines in muted beige and dotted cut-line decoration for the reservation card.
- Illustration style: friendly flat vector or gentle hand-drawn pet illustrations, soft outlines, expressive eyes, rounded paws, small hearts and paw prints, matching the warm clinic branding.
- Information density: include realistic poster details such as address, phone, KakaoTalk channel, booking deadline, doctor credit, QR placeholder, form fields, and social tags while keeping every major text block legible.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: clean graphic poster layout, top-down editorial composition inspired by modern Korean cafe signage and wellness brochure design, no photographic realism required.
- Lighting: soft diffused daylight feel from upper-left, with evenly lit surfaces and gentle soft shadows; keep the poster bright and reassuring.
- Color grade: warm cream + sage + blush pink with slightly muted saturation, similar to a premium lifestyle clinic brochure, printed appointment flyer, and gentle Instagram promo card.

[6. MOOD]
Warm Korean veterinary clinic branding — a friendly premium neighborhood animal hospital poster with the polished clarity of a modern lifestyle brochure, the usefulness of a front-desk reservation card, and the charm of a pet-care community notice.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 이미지에 정확히 들어가야 함.
  - {병원명}
  - {대표문구}
  - {진료항목}
  - {진료시간}
  - {이벤트혜택}
  - {주소}
  - {전화번호}
  - {카카오채널}
  - {예약카드문구}
  - {CTA}
- Render additional Korean labels clearly: “진료 항목”, “진료 시간”, “이벤트·혜택”, “예약 안내”, “보호자명”, “반려동물명”, “희망일”, “연락처”, “방문 전 예약 권장”.
- Layout must keep the three information boxes, access strip, and reservation card section clearly separated and readable.
- Pet illustrations must look friendly and non-threatening, with a reassuring neighborhood clinic atmosphere.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications / government emblems
- Broken Korean characters or unreadable Hangul
- Celebrity or real-person composites
- False emergency symbols implying official ambulance / 119 affiliation

studio:prompts3:ours-179.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1536x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
One-page real estate presentation sheet combining a clean floor plan and a matching 3D interior visualization. Designed for property sales catalogs, leasing brochures, and interior design proposal decks.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- The canvas is split according to {레이아웃}: either a left floor-plan panel and right 3D render panel, or a top/bottom split with balanced visual weight.
- The floor plan panel should occupy about 45–55% of the frame, with a technical drawing feel: thin black or charcoal lines, measured room blocks, and clear Korean labels.
- The 3D render panel should feel like a polished architectural interior photo, with realistic depth, material textures, and sales-presentation clarity.
- Use {매물 정보} as the basis for room count, scale, and spatial logic, keeping the apartment proportions believable.
- Apply {평면도 라벨} only inside the floor plan, with consistent label alignment and ample whitespace so every Korean character remains legible.
- Use {3D 렌더링 컷} for the render scene, matching one of the rooms shown in the plan so the layout-to-visual relationship is obvious.
- Keep the two halves visually connected through the same palette, material language, and trim details from {컨셉 톤}.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Floor plan panel: Draw a refined architectural plan with clean walls, door swings, window openings, room boundaries, and simple circulation lines. Use precise line weights, light gray service annotations, and bold Korean room names for readability.
2. Floor plan labels: Place {평면도 라벨} directly inside each room block, spaced to avoid overlaps. Use a neat grid-like hierarchy so major spaces read first and smaller spaces follow.
3. Measurement and plan logic: Indicate apartment organization implied by {매물 정보} with consistent room sizing, realistic corridor width, and a clear 4Bay-style spatial rhythm if applicable.
4. 3D render panel: Show {3D 렌더링 컷} as a photoreal interior scene that matches the plan’s room function. Include flooring, built-in storage, lighting fixtures, and furniture placement that feel ready for a brochure.
5. Material and concept alignment: Translate {컨셉 톤} into finishes across both panels — for example white walls, warm wood flooring, brushed gold accents, and minimal detailing — so the plan and render feel like one unified proposal.
6. Layout harmony: If using a vertical split, keep the floor plan slightly more schematic and the render slightly more atmospheric; if using a horizontal split, give the top area a technical-document look and the bottom area a lifestyle-photo look.
7. Page finish: Add thin margins, subtle separators, and a restrained presentation-frame aesthetic suitable for real estate marketing.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for labels and annotations, medium to bold weight for primary room names, regular weight for secondary notes, with compact but readable sizing.
- Color palette: Use white, warm gray, charcoal, light oak wood, and soft gold accents from {컨셉 톤}; keep the floor plan mostly monochrome and reserve warmer tones for the render.
- Border/shadow: Use a very subtle 1px divider line between panels and a soft drop shadow on the 3D render panel, around 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 12% opacity.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Use a 24mm architectural interior lens look for the render, as if shot on a full-frame camera; for the plan, use a crisp orthographic top-down drafting view with no perspective distortion.
- Lighting: For the render, use soft daylight from large windows with balanced fill, similar to a high-end real-estate brochure photo; add gentle highlights on wood and metal surfaces.
- Color grade: White + oak + champagne gold with neutral daylight balance, slightly lifted shadows, and clean low-contrast commercial grading.

[6. MOOD]
Premium real-estate brochure and interior design concept sheet — polished architectural marketing aesthetic with the clarity of a luxury developer catalogue.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구가 정확히 보여야 함 — "거실", "주방", "침실 1", "침실 2", "침실 3", "욕실", "발코니".
- The floor plan must remain a readable architectural diagram, not a stylized sketch or perspective drawing.
- The 3D render must depict the same apartment family and spatial logic shown in the plan.
- All Korean characters and spacing must be clean and correctly rendered.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Illegible room labels
- Perspective distortion in the floor plan
- Mismatched room counts between plan and render
- Overly decorative fantasy interiors that do not resemble a real apartment

args.name: 레이아웃
args.default: 좌측 평면도 / 우측 3D 렌더링, 또는 상하 분할

studio:prompts3:ours-178.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean luxury real estate advertisement poster for apartment, officetel, or commercial property sales, vertical promotional layout for print, brokerage display, and social media.
High-trust cinematic real-estate poster with a strong headline, exterior hero visual, property summary boxes, model-house event details, location/benefit callouts, legal footer, sponsor/agency area, and a clear CTA.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject placement: {매물 종류·이름} occupies the upper 34% as the primary headline, layered over a premium skyline, apartment complex exterior, officetel tower, or commercial-street night visual.
- Campaign label: Add a small premium label near the headline reading “GRAND OPEN” and “선착순 방문상담” with gold foil-like accents.
- Information layout: {평형·구조}, {입지}, {가격·조건}, and {분양 혜택} are arranged in polished info cards through the middle section, using icons for floor plan, map pin, price, and gift/benefit.
- Event details: {모델하우스 일정} and {행사 정보} appear as a dedicated invitation band below the price panel, like a realistic property sales event notice.
- CTA placement: {CTA} sits at the bottom as a prominent button-like banner, paired with a small QR-code placeholder box and phone/contact microcopy.
- Footer realism: {주소·주관} and {부동산 표기문구} appear in a compact legal/sponsor footer with agency, 시행/시공/분양대행 style labels and small divider lines.
- Background treatment: deep navy-to-black cinematic backdrop with city-light bokeh, architectural silhouettes, warm window lights, diagonal gold accent lines, small map-grid texture, and subtle brochure-style decorative frames.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero area (top 34%): Present {매물 종류·이름} in a large, confident headline over a cinematic night city or building exterior scene, with crisp separation from the background, elegant gold edge highlights, and a small “PREMIUM RESIDENCE” sublabel.
2. Property detail cards (upper-mid 18%): Show {평형·구조} and {입지} in two refined rectangular info cards with thin gold borders, dark glassmorphism-style fill, practical icon marks, and readable label text such as “TYPE” and “LOCATION”.
3. Price highlight panel (mid-lower 16%): Emphasize {가격·조건} in the most visually distinct box, using larger type, brighter gold accents, a subtle spotlight glow, and a “분양가 안내” label.
4. Benefit strip (lower-mid 10%): Add {분양 혜택} as a row of small premium benefit chips, such as 계약혜택, 중도금, 발코니, 방문상담, with tiny check icons.
5. Model-house invitation band (lower 10%): Render {모델하우스 일정} and {행사 정보} in a realistic event-poster style band with date/time/venue hierarchy, ticket/invitation wording, and a small “방문예약 필수” tag.
6. CTA footer (bottom 8%): Render {CTA} as a high-contrast call-to-action bar or button with rounded corners, paired with a small QR placeholder labeled “상담 예약 QR” and contact emphasis.
7. Legal and sponsor footer (bottom micro area): Place {주소·주관} and {부동산 표기문구} as small but legible real-estate disclaimer text, including 시행, 시공, 분양대행, 홍보관 address, and 상담 유의사항 styling.
8. Supporting accents: Add thin divider rules, metallic gold corner brackets, faint map-coordinate dots, small building-plan line art, and city-light reflections to reinforce the premium property-brand feel.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Use Pretendard ExtraBold for the main headline, Pretendard SemiBold for section labels, Noto Sans KR Medium for supporting details, and a condensed sans-serif for small legal/footer information; headline size should feel oversized and authoritative, with compact tracking.
- Color palette: navy #0B1020, deep black #050507, gold #C8A24A, champagne #E3C878, warm ivory #F4F0E6, cool gray #B9C0CC, accent white #FFFFFF, subtle emergency red #D94A38 only for reservation urgency tags.
- Border/shadow: thin 1px gold borders on info boxes, soft drop shadow 0px 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.28), faint inner glow on the CTA bar, and polished glass reflections on panels.
- Graphic devices: Use real-estate brochure elements such as small map pins, floor-plan outline icons, skyline silhouettes, QR placeholder, sponsor strip, ticket-like event tag, and legal footer dividers.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: ultra-wide 24mm architectural night photography look, high-detail exterior perspective with slight upward angle, f/8 clarity for building geometry.
- Lighting: twilight city lighting with practical window lights, soft rim from the upper-right, controlled gold reflections on facade edges, and luminous lobby/commercial street highlights.
- Color grade: cool navy shadows, restrained gold highlights, deep contrast, and a premium editorial finish similar to luxury real-estate campaign photography.
- Material feel: glossy brochure print finish, metallic foil impression on gold typography, semi-transparent dark glass cards, crisp architectural edges, and realistic printed-poster texture.

[6. MOOD]
Luxury Korean real-estate campaign — premium brokerage brochure meets cinematic city-night editorial, with the polished confidence of an upscale district development ad and the practical detail density of a real 분양 홍보 poster.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following strings must appear exactly as rendered text:
  - {매물 종류·이름}
  - {평형·구조}
  - {입지}
  - {가격·조건}
  - {분양 혜택}
  - {모델하우스 일정}
  - {행사 정보}
  - {주소·주관}
  - {CTA}
  - {부동산 표기문구}
- Additional realistic Korean poster text must be visible: “GRAND OPEN”, “선착순 방문상담”, “분양가 안내”, “방문예약 필수”, “상담 예약 QR”.
- Layout invariants: headline must be the largest text element, price panel must be more visually emphasized than the location and plan boxes, and the CTA must remain clearly separated at the bottom.
- Maintain trustworthy real-estate advertising tone with readable hierarchy, accurate-looking information blocks, and realistic brokerage/legal footer details.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top-left panel: show the exterior of {매물 종류} as a realistic wide-angle real-estate photo, straight horizon, tidy building lines, visible entrance or street context, planted greenery, parked cars or walkway details where natural, and bright daylight clarity.

The image should feel like a premium product styling board: realistic surface textures, refined lighting, clear comparison value, and enough editorial detail to work as an e-commerce thumbnail, product detail page asset, and SNS post.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main canvas is a square 1024x1024 sheet divided into a polished 2x2 grid, using {레이아웃} as the composition guide with equal cell sizes, narrow gutters, and crisp panel separation.
- Each cell contains the same accessory product from {참고 이미지}, preserved with identical shape, material, color, silhouette, and visible details, while only the background styling changes.
- Product placement should follow {제품 위치}: centered hero placement or aligned at the 1/3 point, kept visually consistent across all four cells.
- Apply {비율/사이즈} so the product reads at a consistent catalog scale in every panel, with matching crop logic and comparable visual weight.
- Use small editorial labels inside each cell, placed near the lower edge or upper corner so they remain legible and do not cover important product details.
- Apply {배경 4종} as four distinct backdrop styles, each clearly separated by grid boundaries and rendered with realistic material cues such as stone grain, paper fiber, satin sheen, brushed metal, linen weave, soft gradient, or warm tabletop texture depending on the selected backgrounds.
- Add a refined catalog-board header or footer strip in a small type treatment: “ACCESSORY BACKGROUND CUT”, “2026 S/S STYLE TEST”, and a tiny Korean subtitle such as “배경 비교 컷”.
- Include subtle visual merchandising details that belong to the backgrounds, such as faint surface shadows, texture seams, tiny corner tags, paper deckle edges, metallic reflection, or soft fabric folds, without competing with the accessory.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Global layout — Build a premium 2x2 comparison grid on a square canvas, with thin separators, consistent padding, and a small editorial title area that makes the sheet feel like a finished brand catalog asset.
2. Top-left cell — Place the same accessory on the first background in {배경 4종}, scaled consistently and positioned according to {제품 위치}; add a compact label such as “LOOK 01 / MARBLE” or Korean-friendly styling text like “룩 01”. Render the background with believable surface detail, soft contact shadow, and gentle tonal variation.
3. Top-right cell — Reuse the exact same product cutout and size, switch only the background to the second option in {배경 4종}, and keep the label aligned consistently with the first cell. Add realistic lighting response on the surface, such as subtle paper grain, fabric texture, warm reflection, or soft shadow falloff.
4. Bottom-left cell — Repeat the accessory unchanged over the third background, preserving color accuracy and product material texture. Let the background show a different mood through tactile details such as satin folds, terrazzo flecks, brushed metal, wood grain, or muted color blocking as appropriate to {배경 4종}.
5. Bottom-right cell — Show the accessory on the fourth background, maintaining the same framing, scale, and crop logic as the other three panels. Use matching label size and placement, plus a refined surface treatment such as warm gradient glow, ceramic texture, linen weave, or soft spotlight depending on the selected style.
6. Catalog detail pass — Add small comparison-board details: tiny product styling code “ACC-BG-04”, date text “2026.05”, small color swatch dots matching each panel, and fine divider rules in a premium editorial layout.
7. Consistency pass — Across all four cells, ensure {제품 보존} is strictly followed: no deformation, no redesign, no product color shift, no change in product silhouette, and no alteration to original engraved or printed details.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for Korean text such as “배경 비교 컷”, and a clean sans-serif English label style like Inter or Helvetica Neue, regular to medium weight, 18–28 px equivalent for panel labels and 10–14 px equivalent for micro catalog details.
- Color palette: derive the backgrounds from {배경 4종}, keeping the palette polished and commercial; support with neutral whites, soft blush, warm beige, muted metallic gold, charcoal accents, stone gray, and gentle cream tones.
- Border/shadow: use thin divider lines in cool gray #D9D9D9; add a realistic soft contact shadow under the product, 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity, consistent in every cell, with slight natural variation based on the surface reflectivity.
- Text labels should be small, refined, and legible, set in black or charcoal on light backgrounds, or white on darker backgrounds for contrast.
- Surface styling should feel tactile and photographed: visible but tasteful material grain, realistic reflected highlights, subtle depth, and carefully controlled shadow edges.
- Keep the product as the visual hero while allowing each background to feel like a real styled product-photo setup rather than a flat color block.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: product-photo look, 85mm macro lens at f/8 for crisp object detail and controlled perspective, as if shot for a premium studio catalog.
- Lighting: use {조명} as the primary lighting direction and mood; combine even studio softbox lighting with gentle top-left key light and subtle fill from the right, keeping highlights controlled and shadows soft but readable in each cell.
- Color grade: clean neutral commercial grade with slightly warm whites, soft blush accents, natural beige midtones, polished stone grays, and restrained gold shimmer for any gradient or metallic panel.
- Rendering quality: realistic product cutout integration, accurate contact shadows, consistent scale, clean panel boundaries, and natural background texture detail at high resolution.

[6. MOOD]
Premium e-commerce catalog comparison sheet with a calm editorial finish — like a refined accessory styling test page for a boutique brand, combining Aesop / Le Labo style restraint with richer real-world product photography textures.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the product itself must remain exactly as in {참고 이미지} with no broken characters or altered details.
- Render Korean text clearly where used: “배경 비교 컷”, “룩 01”, “룩 02”, “룩 03”, “룩 04”, and optional micro text such as “2026.05 촬영 샘플”.
- All 4 cells must show the same accessory, same scale logic, same framing rules, and the same product preservation standard from {제품 보존}.
- Backgrounds must change clearly across the four panels according to {배경 4종}, with richer texture, lighting, and material realism while the product remains unchanged.
- English labels and Korean micro labels must be small, clean, consistent, and placed so they do not obscure the accessory.

- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top-left panel: a tight accessory close-up on a warm cream surface, showing texture, metal shine, clasp/edge detail, soft shadows, a tiny paper product tag reading "925 silver", and editorial macro sharpness.
2. Top-middle panel: another product close-up from a slightly different angle, keeping the same lighting, palette, and shadow softness for continuity; include a small handwritten-style label strip such as "NEW DROP" and a faint @brandname mark.
3. Top-right panel: a typography-heavy Instagram promo card with {시그니처 카피 예시} as the main Korean line, plus short supporting copy "봄 신상 DROP", "무료 배송", "VOL.09", and tiny save/share micro icons along the lower edge.
4. Middle-left panel: model wearing shot featuring the accessory styled naturally on the body, cropped as a polished social-commerce image with skin, fabric texture, hair shadow, and the product readable at first glance; add a small date/location label "SEOUL · 2026.05".
5. Middle-center panel: signature brand text card using {시그니처 카피 예시}, arranged as a bold elegant editorial slogan panel with supporting lines "알러지 프리", "매일 착용", "#데일리주얼리", and a tiny carousel indicator "2/9".

7. Bottom-left panel: mood background panel with a styled tabletop, linen fabric, ceramic dish, folded brand card, ribbon shadow, warm sunlight gradient, and packaging texture that matches the accessory aesthetic while keeping the reference accessory as the hero context.
8. Bottom-middle panel: a secondary product detail cell highlighting the accessory finish, attachment point, clasp, stone setting, or silhouette with macro-level clarity; add small measurement-style annotations such as "light fit" and "925 silver" without changing the product design.
9. Bottom-right panel: final mood or brand-end card that closes the grid like a profile-feed teaser, with @brandname, "저장하고 다시 보기", "무료 배송", a short hashtag row "#데일리주얼리 #핸드메이드 #선물추천", and tiny Instagram-like bookmark/share icons.

- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트} with cream #F7F1E8, beige #E6D7C7, warm gold #C8A86A, soft taupe #B79D88, and dark brown text #3A2C24.

- Print-like finish: subtle matte paper texture, low-contrast highlights, crisp image edges, realistic micro grain, and tactile surfaces for a premium feed-grid mockup look.
- Social UI realism: use tiny line icons for heart, comment, share, and bookmark only as decorative Instagram-style micro details; keep them understated and aligned with the beige-gold brand system.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]

- Lighting: soft studio softbox at 45° from upper-left, gentle fill from lower-right, and a faint rim highlight on metallic edges; mood cells use overcast diffused daylight for even shadows, plus occasional soft window-shadow texture for realism.
- Color grade: warm cream + beige + muted gold grade with restrained contrast, slightly lifted blacks, natural skin tones, polished metal highlights, and a clean boutique-commerce finish.

[6. MOOD]

[7. CRITICAL]

studio:prompts3:ours-173.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean smart store detail page hero cut for a luxury accessory product. Vertical ecommerce header image with a split editorial composition: model wear shot on one side, product macro close-up and purchase-driving information block on the other.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Overall composition: a refined two-column smart store hero layout based on {레이아웃}, occupying the full 1024x1536 canvas with a premium mobile-detail-page rhythm.
- Left side: model 착용 컷 area takes about 48% of the width, framed tightly from upper chest to jawline/ear focus, so the earring is clearly visible while skin texture, hair strands, and natural styling feel realistic.
- Right side: product close-up takes about 30% of the width near the upper-right to mid-right area, with the copy block and shopping information stacked beneath it like a polished ecommerce landing header.
- Background treatment: soft cream-beige studio backdrop with visible fine paper texture, warm tabletop reflection, silk ribbon or jewelry tray detail, and subtle product styling that supports the accessory without overpowering it.
- Realistic ecommerce elements: include store name, price, benefit badge, delivery note, review/rating line, contact line, and small save/share/cart micro icons as part of the smart store head cut.
- Use {제품명/브랜드}, {스토어명}, {메인 카피}, {서브 카피}, {가격정보}, {혜택문구}, {배송문구}, {리뷰문구}, {상담정보}, {배지문구}, {컬러 팔레트}, {제품 보존} as user-controlled content and preservation rules.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Left hero area: render the model wearing the attached accessory naturally and elegantly, with the accessory preserved exactly from {제품 보존}, placed so the earring catches light clearly against skin and hair.
2. Right product area: place a crisp close-up of the attached accessory on a warm cream surface, jewelry tray, or folded satin styling cloth, keeping the product shape, stone detail, crystal placement, and metal finish accurate and undistorted.
3. Brand masthead block: set {스토어명} as a small boutique label near the upper-right, then set {제품명/브랜드} below it in a strong refined masthead-like treatment.
4. Main copy block: place {메인 카피} directly beneath the product name, followed by {서브 카피} as a compact material/spec line with slash formatting or fine dividers.
5. Commerce information block: add {가격정보} in a clear purchase-focused type size, then display {혜택문구}, {배송문구}, and {리뷰문구} as small rounded badges or neatly separated rows.
6. Trust and interaction details: include {배지문구} as a small premium-quality label, {상담정보} as a bottom contact line, and tiny smart-store style save/share/cart icons near the lower-right area.
7. Layout balance: keep the model image, product macro, copy, and shopping data visually connected through a consistent vertical grid, warm dividers, and layered cream/gold editorial blocks.
8. Visual emphasis: ensure the accessory is the visual hero, with the model shot supporting purchase confidence and the product shot providing clarity for material, finish, scale, and shine.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for Korean text, with semi-bold for {제품명/브랜드}, medium for {메인 카피}, and regular/medium for {서브 카피}, {가격정보}, {혜택문구}, {배송문구}, {리뷰문구}, and {상담정보}; sizes should feel like 42–56px for the product name, 28–34px for the main copy, 20–28px for the price, and 16–22px for support lines.
- Color palette: follow {컬러 팔레트}; add off-white #F6F1E8, warm beige #E8D9C6, soft gold #C8A86B, pearl ivory #FFF9EF, and deep cocoa #3A2E2A for text contrast.
- Graphic system: use fine muted-gold divider lines, rounded cream badges, delicate product-spec icons, small star-rating glyphs, and understated ecommerce micro icons for save/share/cart.
- Texture and finish: include tactile details such as satin folds, jewelry card stock, soft shadows, delicate reflection on metal, and crystal refraction so the page feels like a photographed premium accessory campaign.
- Border/shadow: use very soft layered shadows with about 4px vertical offset, 14px blur, and low opacity; use thin 1px divider lines in muted gold for product information rows.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: fashion product editorial look shot on a full-frame camera with an 85mm f/1.4 portrait lens for the model side, and a 100mm macro lens at f/8 for the product close-up.
- Lighting: soft studio key light from upper-left at about 45°, with gentle fill from front-right and a faint rim light to separate the jewelry from skin and background.
- Color grade: creamy beige base with restrained gold highlights, slightly desaturated skin tones, pearl-like whites, and polished metallic reflections for a Korean luxury accessory ecommerce aesthetic.
- Photorealism: realistic skin pores, natural ear shape, accurate jewelry scale, precise crystal facets, and believable product shadow contact on the surface.

[6. MOOD]
Luxury accessory brand smart store hero — Aesop x Korean premium jewelry editorial feel, polished and restrained like a high-end mobile detail-page header with real purchase information and boutique trust cues.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 아래 문구를 정확히 렌더링할 것
  - {스토어명}
  - {제품명/브랜드}
  - {메인 카피}
  - {서브 카피}
  - {가격정보}
  - {혜택문구}
  - {배송문구}
  - {리뷰문구}
  - {배지문구}
  - {상담정보}
- Preserve the attached accessory exactly from {제품 보존}: no redesign, no extra dangling parts, no missing stones, no shape changes.
- Model hand/face/ear anatomy must be natural and realistic if visible.
- Text must be crisp, clean, and legible in Korean and English mix.
- Smart store micro UI should look like real ecommerce content: price row, benefit badge, delivery row, review stars, save/share/cart icons, and contact information must feel integrated into the hero image.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness
- False medical or government-style approval marks

studio:prompts3:ours-172.content:
[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean accessory coordination styling editorial, 3-look fashion guide for Instagram carousel cover and store merchandising.
Show a real model wearing the attached main accessory plus coordinated earrings, necklace, ring, or bracelet in a polished, natural fashion-catalog presentation, with useful Korean guide text that makes the styling feel like a real brand post.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Vertical 1024x1536 editorial card with one large hero portrait occupying the upper 60% of the frame and three smaller styling detail modules in the lower 40%.
- Single model is visible from face to upper torso in the hero area; neck, ears, hands, collar line, and accessory placement must be clear enough to read the full coordination.
- The attached main accessory remains the visual anchor near the center of the chest, ears, wrist, or hands depending on the item, while matching pieces support it as a coherent set.
- Build the card like a realistic Korean Instagram styling guide: title, handle, date/location label, Look 01–03 captions, small save/share micro icons, hashtag-style text, and page indicator.
- Background should use {배경} with realistic fabric, chair, window, tabletop, curtain, or interior texture that supports the styling without competing with the accessory.
- Use {조합 컨셉}, {모델}, {구도}, {조명}, {배경}, {제품 보존}, {브랜드명}, {인스타핸들}, {촬영일자}, {촬영장소}, {메인타이틀}, {해시태그}, {페이지표기} as user-controlled variables.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Hero styling area: present the attached accessory clearly and preserve its shape, material, color, and proportions exactly; style the outfit around it with same-tone complementary pieces.
2) Model presentation: pose {모델} with a calm, neat expression, relaxed shoulders, and refined catalog posture; keep the styling modest and product-focused.
3) Three-look guide layout: create three labeled modules: “LOOK 01 데일리 셔츠”, “LOOK 02 오피스 니트”, “LOOK 03 저녁 약속”. Each module should show a close-up crop or small inset of ear/neck/hand coordination using the same accessory family.
4) Composition setup: follow {구도}; make the accessory set readable in the hero portrait and in all three detail modules, using natural editorial crops rather than empty card areas.
5) Coordination detail: apply {조합 컨셉} by pairing the main accessory with matching earrings, necklace, ring, or bracelet in the same visual family; metals, stones, pearls, chains, and finishes must feel intentionally matched.
6) Preservation rule: obey {제품 보존}; the attached accessory stays accurate and dominant, while added matching items remain subtle, coherent, and naturally wearable.
7) Realistic editorial interface: add a small top header with {브랜드명}, {인스타핸들}, {촬영일자}, {촬영장소}; add bottom hashtags {해시태그}, micro icons for 저장/공유, and page indicator {페이지표기}.
8) Surface and background: render {배경} with tactile warm textures such as linen, matte ceramic tray, soft curtain, wooden chair, or daylight wall shadow, keeping the jewelry crisp and premium.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use clean Korean editorial typography, Pretendard Medium / Noto Sans KR SemiBold / Apple SD Gothic Neo; title 48–68px, look labels 24–32px, captions 20–26px, micro text 16–20px.
- Required visible Korean copy: main title {메인타이틀}, “3가지 코디 제안”, “LOOK 01 데일리 셔츠”, “LOOK 02 오피스 니트”, “LOOK 03 저녁 약속”, “저장해두고 내일 코디에 참고하세요”.
- Color palette: cream #F4EFE7, beige #D8C6B1, warm ivory #FAF6F0, soft taupe #A89480, muted gold #C6A56A, light shadow gray #CFC7BE, ink brown #4E4035.
- Graphic elements: warm ivory label chips, thin beige dividers, small gold dot markers, translucent caption bands, subtle save/share/heart micro icons, and a small carousel page dot row.
- Border/shadow: subtle soft drop shadow with 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 16% opacity; use thin editorial divider lines and soft card layering where helpful.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame fashion portrait using a 85mm f/1.8 or 105mm lens, shot at f/2.8 for soft subject separation with crisp accessory detail.
- Lighting: soft window light from upper-left at 45° with gentle fill from front-right, plus a faint rim light to define the face and jewelry edges.
- Color grade: warm cream + beige + muted gold editorial grade, slightly desaturated skin tones, clean highlight roll-off, no heavy contrast.
- Rendering detail: jewelry edges must be sharp, metal reflections controlled, gemstones or pearl surfaces physically believable, skin texture natural, fabric weave softly visible.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean accessory catalog editorial with a refined Instagram brand guide mood: warm daylight, wearable styling, calm confidence, and tasteful boutique merchandising.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: all on-image Korean must be legible and correctly spelled, especially “{메인타이틀}”, “3가지 코디 제안”, “LOOK 01 데일리 셔츠”, “LOOK 02 오피스 니트”, “LOOK 03 저녁 약속”, “저장해두고 내일 코디에 참고하세요”, “{촬영일자} · {촬영장소}”, “{인스타핸들}”, “{해시태그}”, and “{페이지표기}”.
- The accessory must remain visually faithful to the reference image, including shape, material, color, clasp, chain thickness, gemstone count, pearl size, engraving, and decorative details.
- Model expression must stay natural, composed, and modest; no exaggerated pose, no sensual styling, no cleavage emphasis.
- If multiple accessories are shown, they must look like a coherent set from the same style family and remain balanced across the outfit.
- The three look modules must feel like a practical styling guide, not random duplicated portraits; each look should have a distinct outfit texture or neckline while preserving the same main accessory.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Excessive skin exposure or suggestive posing
- Jewelry distortion, extra gemstones, missing parts, or altered accessory design

studio:prompts3:ours-171.content:
[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean accessory multi-angle detail sheet, 4-panel grid, e-commerce catalog and Smart Store detail-page use.
Show one accessory in four synchronized views with clear product clarity, material fidelity, and a realistic premium catalog presentation, enriched with Korean product annotations, shop-style metadata, and detail-page information blocks.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Single product presented across a balanced 2x2 grid, with each product photo cell occupying roughly 24% of the canvas and equal gutters between panels.
- Add a slim top catalog header above the grid: store-style title “오늘의 액세서리”, small line “ACC DETAIL SHEET”, date label “2026.05”, and inventory text “SKU AC-0526”.
- Background is {배경/톤}: cream monochrome or very light beige gradient surface with subtle paper grain, warm tabletop realism, soft contact shadow under each product view, and lightly tinted panel cards.
- Keep all four panels visually coherent in tone, lighting, and backdrop so the set reads as one product sheet, while adding realistic micro-details such as small angle tags, tiny scale ticks, a material note, and an e-commerce info strip.
- Place a narrow footer strip below the grid with concise Korean catalog copy: “소재 확인”, “실측 기준”, “선물 포장 가능”, price text “₩29,000”, and page indicator “01 / 04”. Include a small barcode-like inventory area at one corner for catalog realism.
- Use {제품 종류}, {앵글 4종}, {배경/톤}, {조명}, {레이아웃}, {제품 보존}, {비율/사이즈} as production constraints.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Top-left panel: render {제품 종류} in {앵글 4종} first view, aligned neatly within the cell, with product edge crisp and material detail visible. Add label “정면” plus a tiny caption “메인 실루엣”.
2. Top-right panel: show the second angle of {제품 종류} with the same scale and lighting, preserving exact shape, color, and surface reflection. Add label “옆면” plus a small arrow marker indicating thickness or profile.
3. Bottom-left panel: show the third angle of {제품 종류}, maintaining identical background tone and a consistent shadow direction across the sheet. Add label “후면” with a tiny hardware note such as “클래스프 / 마감 확인”.
4. Bottom-right panel: show the close-up detail view of {제품 종류}, emphasizing crystal sparkle, metal grain, fabric texture, clasp, engraving, gemstone, bead, or hardware finish as applicable without changing the product’s true form. Add label “디테일” and a small magnifier-style callout ring around the key texture area.
5. Add small Korean labels inside each cell near a corner, using the angle names from {앵글 4종} while also clearly showing the fixed labels “정면”, “옆면”, “후면”, “디테일”. Labels should feel like real catalog annotations and must not cover important product details.
6. Add fine divider lines, rounded panel cards, small numeric markers ① ② ③ ④, and realistic Smart Store-style microcopy such as “컬러감은 조명에 따라 달라질 수 있어요” in tiny but legible type.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR, regular to medium weight, 18–24px for angle labels, 28–36px for the top title, 10–14px for SKU, date, price, captions, and footer notes; refined Korean editorial catalog style.
- Color palette: cream #F6F0E6, light beige #E9DDCF, warm gray #B8AEA3, soft charcoal #2B2B2B; preserve the product’s original colors exactly.
- Border/shadow: thin warm-gray panel dividers, soft rounded catalog cards, subtle drop shadow 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity under each item, plus faint paper texture and natural contact shadows.
- Graphic accents: small beige sticker tags, delicate measurement ticks, tiny barcode block, and restrained dot/line decorations that support the product sheet without overpowering the accessory.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: studio product photography look, 85mm macro lens at f/8 for clean edge definition and controlled reflection.
- Lighting: {조명}; studio key light from upper-left at 45° with a soft fill from front-right; gentle specular highlight to reveal crystal shine, polished metal, enamel, pearl, leather, or fabric texture without harsh hotspots.
- Color grade: neutral warm catalog grade, light cream and soft beige with restrained contrast, accurate whites, natural shadow falloff, and realistic printed-detail-page finish.
- Render quality: high-resolution macro product clarity, crisp Korean typography, believable reflections, consistent scale across all four angles, and natural material response based on {제품 보존} and {비율/사이즈}.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean e-commerce catalog sheet — like a Smart Store detail page blended with a boutique accessory brand lookbook: warm, tactile, realistic, polished, information-rich, and ready for a product sales page.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 표시할 문자열: 정면, 옆면, 후면, 디테일, 오늘의 액세서리, 소재 확인, 실측 기준, 선물 포장 가능, ₩29,000, 01 / 04.
- All 4 panels must show the same product identity, with no change in shape, material, color, or size between views.
- The accessory must remain anatomically and physically plausible as a real product; edges, clasps, stones, chains, hinges, engravings, stitching, plating, and crystal details must be clean and consistent.
- Preserve {제품 종류}, {앵글 4종}, {배경/톤}, {조명}, {레이아웃}, {제품 보존}, {비율/사이즈} exactly as the guiding constraints for subject, angles, layout, scale, and material fidelity.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536
- aspect_goal: {비율/사이즈}

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean accessory lifestyle editorial cut for Instagram, blog, and shop social posts, showing the accessory naturally integrated into an everyday cafe scene.
Portrait-format product lifestyle image that feels authentic, approachable, and shareable while keeping the accessory clearly visible, with subtle social-post details that make the scene feel like a real brand lifestyle upload.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject placement: {모델} occupies the mid-to-upper 60% of the frame, with the hands, wrist, neckline, and ear areas clearly visible for accessory emphasis.
- Scene concept: {장면 컨셉} is staged as a candid lifestyle moment rather than a rigid product shot.
- Framing: {구도}; keep the accessory readable through natural hand placement, coffee-cup grip, sleeve position, and gentle head angle.
- Background treatment: a friendly Korean cafe atmosphere with warm wood, cream walls, window reflections, menu-board blur, dessert display hints, ceramic cups, folded receipts, napkins, book pages, and soft bokeh from pendant lights.
- Product integration: {제품 보존} while keeping the accessory naturally worn on the body, proportionate, attached correctly, and lit with believable reflections.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Foreground action area: {모델} holds a coffee cup, opens a paperback, or adjusts a sleeve in a relaxed everyday gesture, with the accessory catching the eye through a slight wrist angle and shallow-focus highlight.
- Hero accessory focus: place the accessory on the visible hand, wrist, or ear area with crisp material definition, accurate color fidelity, clean edge rendering, and realistic contact with skin, knit fabric, or hair.
- Body posture: {구도} should feel casual and unforced, with shoulders relaxed, chin softly angled, and the head turned slightly toward the window light.
- Environment layer: {장면 컨셉} extends into the setting through {소품 디테일}, including cafe table grain, latte foam, dessert plate, book corner, paper receipt, tote strap, and a faint handwritten menu in the background.
- Social post layer: add a small tasteful Instagram-style overlay near a lower corner with {브랜드 핸들}, {위치 라벨}, {날짜 라벨}, {캡션 문구}, {해시태그}, plus tiny save/share/heart micro icons; keep it integrated like an editorial social template, not a poster.
- Light behavior: {조명} creates soft highlights on metal, stone, resin, pearl, leather, or bead surfaces, with gentle shadow separation to preserve accessory shape.
- Color harmony: {컬러 팔레트} should dominate the overall frame, with accessory tones balanced against the cafe environment so the product remains true to life.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: if social captions are included, use Pretendard SemiBold or Noto Sans KR Medium, small editorial caption scale, high Korean legibility, warm charcoal or muted brown text, and refined spacing.
- Color palette: {컬러 팔레트} with additional neutral support from off-white #F5F1EA, warm walnut #7A5A3A, muted taupe #B7A899, latte beige #D8C2A7, and soft espresso #4E3426.
- Border/shadow: soft editorial shadow, 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 16% opacity; use gentle card-like caption treatment only if it fits the social post design.
- Surface and texture: matte ceramic, natural skin texture, softly textured knit, realistic hair strands, latte foam, lightly glossy table varnish, paper fibers, and warm cafe table grain for tactile realism.
- Real-life details: include tiny signs of use such as a coffee spoon, receipt edge, pastry crumb, sleeve fold, cup condensation, and reflected window light to make the lifestyle scene believable.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 85mm f/1.8 portrait lens, medium-close framing, shallow depth of field with a creamy background falloff.
- Lighting: natural window light from upper-left at 45° mixed with warm cafe tungsten practicals in the background, creating soft cinematic bokeh.
- Color grade: warm beige, cream, and caramel grading with gentle contrast and slightly desaturated highlights for an editorial retail-lifestyle feel.
- Rendering: photoreal Korean cafe editorial, realistic skin tones, preserved accessory micro-reflections, smooth background separation, and refined retail-campaign polish.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean cafe lifestyle editorial with an effortless magazine-spread feel, similar to a Kinfolk x urban accessory brand campaign, but grounded with real cafe details, soft conversation energy, and wearable everyday styling.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: render the small overlay text exactly as Korean, including {브랜드 핸들}, {위치 라벨}, {날짜 라벨}, {캡션 문구}, and {해시태그}; no garbled Hangul.

- Anatomy/layout invariants: hands must be anatomically correct, with natural finger placement and no extra fingers; accessory must remain proportionate to the body and physically wearable.
- Scene consistency: the accessory must look truly worn in the daily cafe moment, not pasted on, isolated, floating, or unnaturally enlarged.
- Output fit: maintain {비율/사이즈} portrait composition suitable for Instagram, blog, and Korean shop social posts.

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean accessory model-wear close-up editorial for e-commerce detail page hero, focused on one accessory with realistic fit, natural skin texture, and premium product fidelity.
Instagram / SmartStore headline cut style, vertical portrait designed to make {악세서리 종류} feel wearable, tactile, and desirable on a natural Korean model.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Subject placement: the model occupies the right 40% of the frame, with a tight close-up on the ear, side cheek, hairline, and upper shoulder; the accessory sits at cheek-to-ear height as the clearest point of focus.
- Background treatment: build {배경} as a warm cream-to-ivory beauty studio corner with realistic depth — softly blurred silk fabric, a muted jewelry tray, and a faint product box or vanity surface in the far background, all kept secondary to the accessory.
- Framing direction: crop from upper shoulder to forehead edge using {구도}; use the left side as an editorial commerce area with subtle blurred styling elements and a small tasteful caption block, while the face and jewelry remain dominant.
- Styling detail: include natural hair strands tucked behind the ear, soft knit or satin neckline texture, gentle makeup, visible pores, and believable contact shadows where the accessory meets the skin.
- Use {악세서리 종류}, {모델 컨셉}, {구도}, {조명/톤}, {배경}, {제품 보존 항목}, {비율/사이즈}.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Main subject zone: {모델 컨셉} wears {악세서리 종류} naturally on the ear, with the accessory aligned flush to the lobe and shown in clear focus; preserve exact shape, crystal sparkle, metal highlights, fastening position, and {비율/사이즈} from the reference.
2) Face crop zone: use {구도} so the side cheek, ear line, hairline, and a small portion of jaw and shoulder remain visible; expression is calm and realistic, with clean but natural skin texture, subtle makeup, and fine baby hairs catching the light.
3) Product fidelity zone: render the accessory as a faithful reproduction of the source image, keeping material contrast, reflections, stone cut, prong placement, clasp thickness, edge thickness, and {제품 보존 항목} accurate; no redesign or simplification.
4) Lighting zone: apply {조명/톤} with soft directional lift on the product surface so cubic/metal reflections read clearly without blown-out glare; maintain gentle shadow contour under the ear, behind the jaw, and along the neckline.
5) Background zone: build {배경} as a real editorial product-shoot setting with shallow depth of field: a cream wall, ivory tabletop edge, blurred satin pouch, jewelry tray, and warm reflections that suggest a premium accessory boutique.
6) Commerce detail zone: add a small lower-left editorial caption area integrated into the photo, not a flat poster overlay. Include short Korean text such as “오늘의 포인트”, “착용감 가까이 보기”, “2026.05 서울”, and tiny handle “@mood.acc” in a refined magazine-style layout.
7) Finish zone: add a polished storefront-ready look with crisp product edges, realistic skin tones, visible micro-texture, premium metal sparkle, and a believable beauty editorial atmosphere.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: allow small, tasteful editorial commerce typography in the lower-left area only. Set Korean text cleanly and accurately: “오늘의 포인트”, “착용감 가까이 보기”, “2026.05 서울”, “@mood.acc”. Keep the text secondary to the accessory.
- Color palette: warm beige, cream, ivory, soft taupe, muted caramel, pale champagne, and metallic highlights matching the reference accessory.
- Surface styling: include tactile materials such as satin, ceramic, soft knit, and brushed paper packaging in shallow blur to create a premium retail environment.
- Border/shadow: very subtle soft drop shadow, 4px y-offset, 12px blur, 15% opacity, only enough to separate the face, accessory, and caption area from the background.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 85mm f/1.8 portrait lens, tight crop, shallow depth of field, high-resolution product-fashion close-up.
- Lighting: soft window light from upper-left at 45° plus gentle fill from front-right, with controlled specular accents on the accessory to preserve crystal and metal detail.
- Color grade: warm beige + ivory commercial grade with slightly lifted highlights, clean neutral skin tones, soft champagne reflections, and restrained contrast.
- Rendering quality: realistic skin pores, fine hair strands, accurate ear anatomy, crisp jewelry micro-detail, natural bokeh, and premium Korean beauty editorial finishing.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean accessory e-commerce editorial — feels like a real SmartStore hero image photographed during a boutique beauty campaign, with warm styling, intimate close-up detail, and a refined magazine-commerce tone.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: render only the listed Korean text exactly and legibly where visible: “오늘의 포인트”, “착용감 가까이 보기”, “2026.05 서울”, “@mood.acc”. Do not invent additional Korean words.
- Anatomy/layout invariants: Korean model proportions must look natural and realistic; exactly one ear accessory set should be shown clearly; facial features, ear anatomy, hairline, neck, and shoulder must be anatomically correct.
- Product fidelity: preserve the accessory’s exact form, material, color, stone placement, reflective behavior, {제품 보존 항목}, and {비율/사이즈} from the source image.
- Focus hierarchy: the accessory must be the sharpest and most visually important element, followed by ear/skin detail, then background styling and caption.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

[INPUT]
