[1. PURPOSE]
Korean small business storefront facade design mockup, signboard-centered exterior presentation, catalog-ready architectural visual.
Graphic design meets real street photography, suitable for branding proposal, leasing deck, local business launch, and interior magazine presentation.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Street-facing storefront shown from the front or a slight 15° angle, with the facade occupying about 70% of the frame and the remaining 30% used for sidewalk, curb, neighboring storefront edges, and believable Korean street context.
- Main signboard placed in the upper facade zone, entrance door and show window aligned directly beneath it, and a small A-frame menu board, standing side sign, or window poster visible near the entrance.
- Background is a real urban Korean street environment: textured pavement, yellow tactile paving blocks, curb line, utility pole or streetlamp, delivery scooter trace, small planter boxes, window reflections, neighboring shop trim, and natural street wear.
- Keep all design elements harmonized under {매장 컨셉}, with the overall architecture, signage hierarchy, finish quality, and night/day readability guided by {주요 재질}, {조명}, and {시각적 스타일}.
- Use {매장 이름}, {업종}, and {간판 언어} as the visible storefront identity, supported by small realistic retail information such as hours, address line, phone number, QR sticker, and promotional window text.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Facade header area: Place the main signboard across the top facade, with {매장 이름} as the primary brand text and a smaller secondary line that reflects {업종}, balanced left-to-right within a clean rectangular or softly rounded frame.
- Main signboard material: Render the signboard in {주요 재질} with visible grain, seams, brushed surface, painted texture, screw caps, mounting brackets, or edge thickness; make it slightly weathered but well-maintained, paired with matte painted surfaces for a neighborhood retail feel.
- Typography layer: Set the sign text in clear Korean lettering for {간판 언어}, with strong legibility from the street; use a modern sans serif for any English portion and a compact Korean font for the main name. Add smaller supporting text such as “SINCE 2026”, “LOCAL STORE”, “OPEN DAILY”, or “예약·문의 02-000-2026” without competing with the main name.
- Entrance zone: Place a glass door or framed wooden door directly below the signboard, with handle detail, door closer, threshold strip, small security keypad, business-hour decal, and subtle interior glimpse through the window.
- Show window area: Add a display window beside the door with believable merchandise or service-related silhouettes based on {업종}, layered reflections of the street, vinyl lettering, a small poster, and window decals that match {매장 컨셉}. Include Korean details such as “영업시간 10:00–21:00”, “월요일 휴무”, “신규 오픈 이벤트”, or “예약 가능”.
- Side display: Include a small stand sign or menu board near the sidewalk edge, angled slightly toward pedestrians, with short Korean copy like “오늘의 추천”, “대표 메뉴”, “상담 가능”, or “TAKE OUT”, plus a few price or service lines such as “₩7,500”, “30분 상담”, or “2인 세트”.
- Street context: Add Korean urban details such as potted plants, a narrow curb, drain cover, streetlamp, tactile paving, wall-mounted utility box, small parcel box, bicycle wheel edge, cafe-style stool, or neighboring awning edge positioned so they frame the facade while preserving sign visibility.
- Retail information layer: Add a small address strip or door decal in Korean, e.g. “서울 마포구 연남로 24 1F”, “@store_official”, “010-0000-2026”, and a small QR code-like square sticker near the entrance, rendered as realistic micro-graphics.
- Tone consistency: Keep the storefront palette and material contrast unified so the exterior feels like a real, buildable design proposal with accurate scale, believable installation details, and natural aging rather than an exaggerated concept render.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Use Pretendard Bold or Noto Sans KR Bold for the main Korean name, medium weight for supporting text, and clean condensed sans serif for English; main sign letters should be large enough to read clearly at street distance.
- Color palette: Base the scheme on warm wood brown, soft cream, muted beige, charcoal gray, and accent tones drawn from {매장 컨셉}; keep saturation calm and use approachable neighborhood storefront colors.
- Signage hierarchy: Make {매장 이름} the largest element, {업종} the second-level descriptor, and hours/address/promotional text as small but readable supporting details on the window, door, or side board.
- Border/shadow: Add subtle realistic contact shadows under the signboard and around the window frames, with a soft 4px y-offset and 12px blur at about 15% opacity.
- Surface treatment: Preserve crisp facade edges, lightly textured wall paint, realistic sealant lines, metal fasteners, wood or stone grain from {주요 재질}, and controlled reflections on glass; glossy finishes may appear only where they are physically plausible, such as acrylic channel letters or glass.
- Environmental realism: Include light dust, tiny scratches on metal, slight paint variation, rain marks near the curb, sticker residue on glass, and natural sidewalk wear to make the proposal feel photographed on an actual Korean street.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 35mm full-frame street photography perspective, equivalent to a 35mm f/2.8 lens at eye level, with mild architectural correction and natural perspective.
- Lighting: Use soft overcast daylight or late-afternoon golden hour from upper-left, with gentle shadow falloff and a faint warm bounce from the sidewalk; {조명} should visibly influence the sign edge, entrance glow, or window reflection.
- Color grade: Warm cream, honey brown, beige, soft charcoal, and muted urban gray, with an editorial tone similar to Kinfolk storefront features and Dezeen-style architectural photography.
- Rendering quality: Photorealistic facade visualization with accurate scale, realistic glass reflections, readable Korean signage, tactile materials, and small retail details that reward close viewing.

[6. MOOD]
Premium neighborhood storefront editorial — a calm Kinfolk x Aesop retail facade presentation with a realistic Korean street mood, lived-in commercial detail, and a believable opening-day branding atmosphere.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 다음 문구가 정확히 보여야 함: "{매장 이름}", "{업종}".
- The signboard typography must be fully legible, with no broken Hangul, no mirrored characters, and no mixed-up spacing in the Korean text.
- The composition must clearly show the main signboard, entrance, and window as a coherent storefront system.
- Add realistic Korean storefront micro-copy where appropriate, such as “영업시간 10:00–21:00”, “서울 마포구 연남로 24 1F”, “예약·문의 02-000-2026”, “신규 오픈”, or “오늘의 추천”, while keeping {매장 이름} visually dominant.
- If English text is used, it should remain secondary to the Korean brand name and should not overpower the facade identity.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites / unauthorized likeness

Korean mirror-selfie lookbook photo, full-body fashion editorial for social media. Natural indoor lifestyle image with a content-rich daily outfit presentation, realistic room details, and a casual but polished Korean Instagram aesthetic.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: {인물 연령대 및 성별} centered slightly right of frame, occupying about 55% of the vertical space, with the full-length mirror visible and the phone obscuring only part of the face.
- Outfit emphasis: {의상 스타일} styled clearly from head to toe, with legible silhouette, balanced proportions, visible fabric texture, accessories, socks, shoes, and natural folds from real movement.
- Hair and grooming: {헤어 스타일} kept neat and natural, with soft flyaway strands and everyday Korean beauty styling that fits a real lookbook selfie.
- Location and props: {배경 장소} with believable wardrobe-life details such as a clothing rack, folded knitwear, shoes near the mirror, tote bag, small perfume tray, hair clip, coffee cup, curtain edge, rug texture, and warm interior objects that make the room feel lived-in.
- Framing: {사진 구도} like a real handheld mirror selfie, with slight phone-camera perspective, mirror edge reflections, floor-level shoe detail, and a few natural cropped room elements around the mirror.
- Social media details: add subtle Instagram-style micro elements near the lower or side area, such as small Korean caption sticker text “오늘의 룩”, date/location label “2026.05.01 성수동”, handle “@daily_look.kr”, and tiny hashtag line “#데일리룩 #거울셀카 #ootd”.
- Atmosphere: {사진 분위기} expressed through warm beige and light brown tones, slightly desaturated film-like rendering, and relaxed indoor realism.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Full-body mirror area: {인물 연령대 및 성별} stands in front of the mirror, holding a smartphone naturally, with realistic body proportions, straight posture, slight weight shift, and a casual fashion pose.
2. Outfit read area: {의상 스타일} rendered with crisp fabric texture, clean seams, natural wrinkles, visible layering, realistic shoe shape, and clear contrast between outfit pieces.
3. Face and hair area: {헤어 스타일} with soft natural strands, understated makeup, a calm expression, and partial facial coverage from the phone consistent with a real mirror selfie.
4. Background layer: {배경 장소} filled with believable room elements like a rack of clothes, shoe placement near the floor, a canvas tote, stacked magazines, small mirror smudges, light switch, curtain folds, and understated interior decor that supports a lived-in lookbook setting.
5. Caption and diary layer: integrate small realistic Korean social text as if added in an app, including “오늘의 룩”, “2026.05.01 성수동”, “@daily_look.kr”, and “#출근룩 #데일리룩”, plus tiny save/share-style icons that remain secondary to the photo.
6. Light and tone area: {사진 분위기} established with window light and soft interior fill so the image feels like a real Korean social-media outfit post.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use only small, realistic Korean social-media sticker/caption text; it should feel like an Instagram diary detail, not a poster headline.
- Color palette: warm beige, light brown, off-white, soft gray, muted black, with a slightly faded film finish matching {사진 분위기}.
- Border/shadow: natural mirror edge shadowing, soft phone-screen reflection, subtle glass marks, and gentle room-depth shadows are allowed.
- Realism: include tactile materials such as denim grain, cotton weave, sneaker rubber, wooden floor texture, fabric curtain folds, and small everyday objects that would naturally exist in {배경 장소}.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame 50mm prime look, f/1.8–f/2.2, handheld phone-photo realism with mild background separation and modest bokeh.
- Lighting: soft daylight from a nearby window at 45° with gentle indoor ambient fill, creating even skin tones, soft reflections on the mirror, and warm highlights on fabric and floor surfaces.
- Color grade: warm beige + light brown + slightly desaturated film grade, similar to a muted Korean Instagram outfit snapshot.
- Detail rendering: realistic mirror reflection alignment, mild lens distortion from a phone selfie angle, subtle grain, natural skin texture, and small imperfections in the interior scene.

Indie Korean fashion diary — somewhere between a MUSINSA street-style lookbook and a quiet apartment snapshot, with understated editorial realism, cozy room atmosphere, and authentic daily-life styling.

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean solo-living daily life film photograph, vertical portrait editorial.
Designed like an Instagram-friendly lifestyle photo capturing a quiet apartment moment with realistic, natural domestic detail, as if taken during an ordinary late afternoon in a small Korean studio apartment.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Subject placement: {인물 특징} sits left-to-center in the frame near a window; {인물 행동} at chest level is the main focal point, captured with a candid, unforced rhythm.
- Background treatment: {장소 및 배경} with visible everyday apartment details such as a small wooden table, curtain edge, low bookshelf, ceramic mug, folded blanket, phone charger cable, tissue box, houseplant, and soft fabric textures.
- Spacing and framing: vertical upper-torso to mid-body framing with a slightly imperfect handheld crop, like a real film snapshot taken from across the table.
- Wardrobe integration: {의상 스타일} rendered as casual homewear with natural folds, lint, softened seams, and relaxed posture rather than fashion-styled posing.
- Domestic context: include believable Korean solo-living details such as a compact rice cooker or electric kettle in the far background, a delivery receipt on the table, a small stack of books, a laundry rack edge, and warm window reflections on the floor.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Foreground hero area: {인물 특징} clearly visible with a calm, ordinary expression; both hands wrap around a warm coffee cup, fingers naturally aligned and anatomically correct, with subtle knuckle detail and natural nail shape.
- Midground lifestyle layer: a small table edge, notebook, coaster, spoon, half-open paperback, crumpled receipt, or folded newspaper can sit partially in frame to reinforce the daily-home atmosphere while keeping the subject emotionally central.
- Background layer: {장소 및 배경} should show warm window light mixing with a tungsten lamp glow, creating layered domestic depth, soft shadows on walls and curtains, and small realistic imperfections such as curtain wrinkles, wall texture, and dust-catching highlights.
- Texture and realism layer: keep skin texture natural, hair soft and unstyled, and clothing fabric lightly wrinkled; preserve pores, flyaway hair, faint under-eye texture, and the tactile surface of ceramic, paper, cotton, and wood.
- Color and camera layer: render with {사진 스타일 및 색감} and {사진 기법}, emphasizing shallow depth of field, soft bokeh, gentle separation between subject and room, and realistic film grain.
- Environmental storytelling: make the room feel recently lived in — a bookmark tucked into a book, a pen beside a small planner, a dish towel over a chair, a tiny condensation ring under the mug, and a lamp switch or power strip partly visible.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: no graphic text overlay; any text must exist naturally on physical props such as a notebook, receipt, book spine, mug, or newspaper.
- Color palette: warm beige, light brown, cream, soft amber, muted caramel, dusty taupe, pale gray-green from plants, and faded off-white, with the palette guided by {사진 스타일 및 색감}.
- Image surface: realistic 35mm-inspired film scan feeling with fine grain, slight halation around warm highlights, soft ambient occlusion under the cup and along the jawline, and natural shadow falloff.
- Prop styling: use ordinary Korean apartment objects that feel affordable and personal rather than showroom-styled — ceramic cup, reusable shopping bag, paperback books, stationery, cotton blanket, delivery receipt, and compact appliances.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame mirrorless look, 50mm prime lens, f/1.8 to f/2.2, medium-close framing, natural perspective compression.
- Lighting: mixed natural window light from one side and a warm tungsten lamp practical in the room; window light should be diffused and directional, with a gentle warm fill from the lamp to avoid harsh contrast.
- Color grade: slightly desaturated film grade with beige and light brown dominance, lifted shadows, soft highlight roll-off, and a subtle Kodak Portra-like tone.
- Focus behavior: sharpest focus on the face, hands, and cup rim; background details fall into soft blur but remain recognizable enough to communicate a real Korean solo-living interior.
- Realism cues: include slight handheld framing, natural micro-contrast, believable skin undertones, soft film grain in the shadows, and mild highlight bloom around the window curtain.

[6. MOOD]
Quiet Korean apartment lifestyle editorial — like a candid frame from a Kinfolk-inspired domestic photo story with an indie film still sensibility, warm solitude, and the gentle realism of an ordinary evening at home.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: no graphic overlay text; if Korean appears on natural props, render it cleanly and legibly as short real phrases such as “오늘 할 일”, “동네 소식”, “영수증”, “따뜻한 하루”, or “2026.05.01”.
- Anatomy/layout invariants: {인물 특징} must remain a realistic Korean woman in her 20s–30s with natural facial proportions; body must be anatomically correct with exactly 2 arms, 2 legs, and 5 fingers on each hand; no extra limbs, no bent or distorted fingers, no duplicated hands.
- Pose must stay simple and natural, with no exaggerated gesture or stiff modeling pose.
- Maintain the core action of {인물 행동}; the cup, hands, face, and quiet apartment atmosphere must remain the emotional center of the image.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean informational infographic card news, single-page vertical social post for Instagram.
Design a polished data-driven editorial card that communicates one topic with headline, subtitle, ranked charts, icons, source note, account branding, slide indicator, and save/share cues.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Canvas uses a tall vertical hierarchy with an upper headline zone (18%), middle data-visualization zone (60%), and lower footer/CTA zone (22%).
- Main subject area centers on {카드뉴스 주제} with a strong typographic headline, compact supporting subtitle, and a visible slide marker {슬라이드 번호}/{총 슬라이드 수}.
- Background treatment: flat warm beige paper-like surface with subtle grain, soft editorial blocks, small sticker-like tags, and light geometric accents that support the information design.
- Use a precise editorial grid with clear card-like spacing between data blocks, crisp alignment, and mobile readability suitable for {대상 플랫폼}.
- Apply {카드뉴스 비율} proportions in the layout logic while rendering at 1024x1536.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header zone: Place a large Korean headline at the top, bold and high-contrast, followed by a one-line subtitle in smaller text directly beneath it.
2. Meta label strip: Add a slim topic tag near the headline reading {상단 라벨}, plus a small date/location label {날짜 위치 라벨} and the account handle {계정명}.
3. Data body: Present the main facts using {데이터 시각화 요소} with a balanced combination of icon rows, ranked numbers, horizontal bar charts, and compact value annotations.
4. Ranking content: Show five clear ranked rows for the TOP 5 list, each with an icon, rank number, menu/item name, percentage or score, and a coral-highlighted bar scaled consistently.
5. Visual hierarchy: Emphasize the top-ranking item with the largest number, stronger coral highlight, and slightly larger icon, then reduce emphasis progressively for the remaining items.
6. Social card details: Include a small page indicator {슬라이드 번호}/{총 슬라이드 수}, save/share micro icons, and a hashtag line {해시태그} integrated into the lower information area.
7. Footer zone: Place {하단 푸터 내용}, {출처 표기}, and the end-card CTA {저장 CTA} at the bottom in a compact footer area with a fine divider line above it.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for all text, headline in Bold 700-800 around 64-76px, subtitle in Medium 500 around 24-28px, labels in Regular 400 around 18-22px, micro text no smaller than 16px.
- Color palette: {색상 팔레트} with concrete mapping such as beige #F4EBDD, soft coral #F39C8F, navy #1E2A44; use navy for text, coral for highlights, beige as background, and muted cream blocks for secondary cards.
- Graphic system: flat icons, rounded info tiles, small sticker labels, thin navy dividers, soft coral accent shapes, and compact chart legends that feel like a real Korean social media infographic.
- Border/shadow: very subtle 1px divider lines; if any card shadow is used, keep it soft with 2px y-offset, 8px blur, 10% opacity.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: clean flat editorial infographic look, simulated top-down design composition equivalent to an art-directed magazine layout, no real camera subject.
- Lighting: evenly lit studio-style presentation with no directional drama, neutral diffused light feel, zero glare.
- Color grade: warm beige base with restrained coral accents and deep navy typography, overall muted and polished.
- Rendering feel: crisp vector-like Korean typography, precise chart geometry, high-resolution print-editorial finish adapted for a vertical mobile feed.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean editorial infographic — resembling a refined information page in a modern design magazine, with the clarity of a Bloomberg-style data card and the warmth of a Seoul lifestyle data post.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: every rendered Korean string must be exact, especially {카드뉴스 주제}, {상단 라벨}, {하단 푸터 내용}, {출처 표기}, {저장 CTA}, {계정명}, and {해시태그}.

[1. PURPOSE]
Cinematic K-drama still frame, single-scene capture, widescreen drama poster-style image for emotional storytelling.
A realistic Korean TV drama moment with a strong narrative freeze-frame feel, suitable for thumbnail, streaming preview, or promotional key art.
The image should feel like an actual captured frame from a rain-night episode, with believable location details, lived-in street texture, practical light sources, and subtle broadcast-drama text overlays.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subjects: two realistic Korean adults facing each other without an umbrella, occupying the central 55% of the frame, with one slightly foregrounded and the other a half-step back to emphasize relational tension.
- Scene placement: {장면 배경} fills the midground and background, with wet pavement reflections, puddles, curb edges, rain streaks, storefront glow, and street-level depth leading the eye toward the characters.
- Framing: {화면 비율} composition, low-angle perspective, tight enough for facial emotion to read clearly but wide enough to include environmental storytelling such as neon signs, old wall posters, a parked scooter, distant car headlights, utility cables, and softly blurred pedestrians.
- Background treatment: rain-softened urban alley textures, practical light sources, Korean street signage, damp brick or concrete, drainage grates, delivery boxes, vinyl awnings, and small everyday traces that make the scene feel filmed on location.
- Emphasis: {인물 상황} should feel immediately readable through posture, eye contact, distance between bodies, wet clothing edges, hand tension, and the way each character reacts to the pause between lines.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Foreground plane: dark wet asphalt with small reflective highlights, shallow puddles, scattered raindrops, painted lane marks, drain covers, cigarette-wet paper scraps, and amber-blue reflections creating a cinematic mirror effect around the characters’ feet.
2. Character block: two Korean characters rendered with natural proportions, detailed skin texture, visible rain on hair and coats, realistic hair strands, contemporary clothing folds, wet fabric cling, subtle makeup, and emotionally restrained facial micro-expressions; their eye lines should lock or break tension depending on the emotional beat of {감정 및 분위기}.
3. Midground environment: {장면 배경} shown with practical street realism, including damp walls, faint signage glow, small restaurant menu boards, window condensation, taped notices, a convenience-store light spill, scooter mirrors, plastic crates, and soft rain residue on surfaces.
4. Camera stance: {카메라 앵글} with compressed depth and subtle perspective tension, as if filmed by a drama DOP during a pivotal dialogue pause; include slight foreground bokeh from a nearby lamp edge or rain-splashed glass surface.
5. Light design: {조명 및 색감} mapped so the rim light defines hair and shoulders, while the alley stays moody and dimensional; amber practical lights should reflect in puddles, teal street fill should separate the silhouettes, and the actors’ faces should remain emotionally legible.
6. Subtitle area: a small lower-third subtitle box centered near the bottom edge, containing {자막 내용} in clean white sans-serif Korean text, unobtrusive and broadcast-like, with the box semi-transparent enough to reveal the wet pavement behind it.
7. Broadcast-detail layer: add a tiny upper-left episode label reading "EP.08  비 오는 밤" and a small lower-right schedule tag reading "본방송 10:30", both subtle and realistic like a Korean drama still, not overpowering the scene.
8. Production-realism details: include rain droplets catching highlights, faint steam from a manhole or food stall, lens moisture specks near the edge, soft background motion blur from a passing taxi, and naturally imperfect street textures.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: clean sans-serif Korean subtitle style, similar to Pretendard or Noto Sans KR, medium weight, 28–34px feel for the subtitle; broadcast labels should feel smaller, around 16–20px, crisp anti-aliased, with realistic TV-overlay spacing.
- Color palette: teal #2E6F7E, amber #D98A3A, charcoal #1E1E22, rain-slick gray #6C7178, soft off-white #F2F2F0.
- Border/shadow: subtle cinematic vignette, gentle 8px shadow separation on subtitle box, 15% opacity black with slight blur; add soft halation around practical lamps and neon reflections.
- Environmental typography: any Korean signs, posters, or menu boards in the background should be believable and short, such as "포차", "김밥", "24시", "오늘만", "따뜻한 어묵", rendered as secondary texture without competing with the subtitle.
- Wardrobe and surface realism: clothes should show rain-darkened seams, collar folds, sleeve creases, water beads, and natural fabric weight; skin should show pores, moisture, and nuanced facial color under mixed light.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: ARRI Alexa Mini look, 50mm prime at f/2.0, shallow-to-moderate depth of field, natural drama-camera perspective.
- Lighting: magic-hour base with soft rim light from streetlamps, diffused practical light from the alley, wet-surface bounce lifting the shadows slightly.
- Color grade: Korean drama grade with teal-and-amber separation, restrained contrast, lifted black levels just enough to preserve night detail.
- Image texture: high-end streaming-drama realism with subtle film grain, gentle highlight bloom, rain haze, realistic motion softness in the far background, and sharp emotional detail on the two faces.
- Depth handling: keep the characters as the primary focus while allowing signs, rain streaks, headlights, and architectural layers to create believable urban depth.

[6. MOOD]
High-end Korean melodrama still — feels like a pivotal frame from a Park Chan-wook-adjacent or Kim Eun-sook-style TV drama, with cinematic restraint and emotional suspense.
The atmosphere should carry {감정 및 분위기}: the rain, reflected lights, wet silence, and body language should make the viewer feel that a confession, breakup, reunion, or irreversible secret has just surfaced.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: render {자막 내용} exactly inside the subtitle box; if the subtitle content is "내레이션: '그날 밤, 모든 것이 시작되었다.'", preserve every Korean character, punctuation mark, space, and quotation mark exactly.
- Also render these small overlay strings exactly if visible: "EP.08  비 오는 밤" and "본방송 10:30".
- Anatomy/layout invariants: both characters must have realistic Korean facial structure, natural hands, proportional bodies, accurate wet hair behavior, no duplicated faces, and no warped limbs.
- The emotional relationship between the two figures must remain the visual focus, supported by the environment, lighting, subtitle, and rain details.
- Preserve {장면 배경}, {인물 상황}, {감정 및 분위기}, {카메라 앵글}, {조명 및 색감}, {화면 비율}, and {자막 내용} as the controlling creative inputs.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized celebrity likeness

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean RPG fantasy character sheet page, full-body hero illustration with richly layered side/bottom info panels, designed like a premium character design guidebook spread and in-game codex profile.
한국 전통 신화·민속 모티프와 MMORPG/픽시브 판타지가 융합된 설정화 스타일의 캐릭터 시트로, 게임 기획서, 아트북 페이지, 실제 서비스 중인 RPG 캐릭터 도감 UI가 함께 보이는 룩앤필을 목표로 한다.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: a full-body hero character occupies about 50% of the canvas, placed slightly off-center so the remaining space can hold dense but readable data panels, item callouts, skill badges, and profile labels.
- Composition: vertical character sheet layout with polished editorial structure, the hero on the left or center-left, and framed information panels stacked on the right and along the lower third like a collectible RPG class dossier.
- Background treatment: dark black-to-fog gradient backdrop with layered mist, faint ornamental Korean pattern texture, brushed paper grain, ink-wash cloud traces, and small magical glow particles that reinforce the fantasy atmosphere.
- Add guidebook realism: include a top title bar, class emblem, small page marker, update/date label, decorative stat badge, item thumbnail slots, weapon annotation line, and a tiny production credit line such as "ART CODE: KR-RPG-088" and "업데이트 2026.05".
- Use {캐릭터 종족}, {캐릭터 직업}, {주요 무기}, {전통 모티프}, {색감 테마}, {일러스트 스타일}, {정보 패널 내용} as customizable content anchors.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero area: render the main {캐릭터 종족} character as a full-body pose with dynamic silhouette, showing the combat identity of {캐릭터 직업}; the pose should feel like an official class illustration for a Korean fantasy MMORPG, with feet, weapon, cloak edges, armor shape, and silhouette fully visible.
2. Costume and gear detail: integrate {전통 모티프} into layered Korean-inspired clothing, armor trims, knots, talismans, norigae-style ornaments, patterned fabric panels, engraved metal pieces, leather straps, and animal-symbol accessories; make {주요 무기} visually prominent and readable from a distance, with a small weapon detail inset showing material, rune marks, and grip design.
3. Color emphasis: push the costume and effects with {색감 테마} as the dominant palette, using deep shadows, metallic highlights, lacquer-like surfaces, embroidered fabric textures, worn edges, subtle scratches, and a mystical glow that separates the character from the background.
4. Information panels: place framed cards beside and below the hero, each card showing parts of {정보 패널 내용}; include miniature item drawings, stat boxes, skill icons, affinity tags, passive trait chips, labeled separators, and a short Korean lore excerpt like a game guidebook page.
5. Title and labels: present the character sheet text in a polished MMORPG UI-meets-artbook style, with clear hierarchy between name, race, class, stats, skill description, weapon name, rarity badge, and role tags.
6. Profile/card details: add small realistic UI text blocks such as "도감 번호 088", "시즌: 달빛의 장", "전투 역할", "추천 포지션", "장비 등급", "출신 지역", "속성", "난이도", and "파티 시너지"; include a page indicator like "CHARACTER SHEET 01/03" and a decorative non-official crest motif.
7. Bottom strip: include a horizontal ability summary area with compact bars for HP, MP, 공격, 방어, 속도, plus three tiny skill cards labeled "기본기", "연계기", "궁극기" and one larger signature skill card labeled "시그니처 스킬".

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard Bold for major labels, Noto Sans KR Medium for body text, and a slightly condensed sans for stat numerals; sizes should feel like a professional game character sheet with readable Korean UI labels and tiny production notes.
- Color palette: anchor on deep burgundy, teal, antique gold, charcoal black, and mist gray, aligned with {색감 테마}; use warm gold as a premium accent for linework, badges, dividers, and key stat highlights.
- Border/shadow: thin gold UI lines, soft 4px y-offset drop shadow with 12px blur at 15% opacity, subtle inner panel strokes, layered translucent glass panels, paper-grain overlays, and engraved corner ornaments to mimic a premium design bible page.
- Decorative graphic elements: use Korean lattice-inspired dividers, faint cloud scrolls, ink-brush edge marks, small talisman tags, weapon-callout arrows, rarity stars, and class-emblem geometry to make the sheet feel complete and collectible.
- Panel density: include multiple readable micro-sections rather than empty space; balance large hero art with compact information blocks, item thumbnails, skill meters, lore text, and annotation labels.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: illustrative character-sheet framing with a 50mm portrait perspective feel for the body and clean orthographic-like treatment for the info panels.
- Lighting: dramatic studio key light from upper-left at 45°, faint rim light from upper-right, low-contrast mist diffusion around the silhouette, and small localized glows from talismans, weapon runes, or magical ornaments.
- Color grade: deep plum + jade teal + muted gold, with black background and smoky gray transitions, refined for a mystical Korean fantasy tone.
- Rendering style: {일러스트 스타일} with high-detail fabric folds, believable metal and leather materials, hand-painted fantasy polish, crisp UI overlays, and subtle printed-artbook texture.
- Realism cues: add tiny scratches on armor, embroidered thread detail, patterned cloth weave, lacquered wood or horn accents if relevant, visible seams, scuffed boot edges, layered shadows beneath the character, and slight atmospheric depth behind the panels.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean game artbook spread — a Riot Games champion splash art energy blended with a polished MMORPG class guide page, collectible character dossier, and Korean mythic fantasy atmosphere. The final image should feel like a real page from a high-budget Korean RPG artbook or in-game codex, with enough text, symbols, stats, and equipment details to reward close viewing.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following Korean strings must appear clearly and correctly rendered in the image: "캐릭터 이름", "종족", "직업", "HP", "MP", "공격", "방어", "속도", "시그니처 스킬".
- Additional Korean UI text must appear clearly where appropriate: "도감 번호 088", "업데이트 2026.05", "전투 역할", "추천 포지션", "장비 등급", "출신 지역", "속성", "난이도", "파티 시너지", "기본기", "연계기", "궁극기".
- Layout invariant: the main character must be full-body and occupy roughly half the canvas, with compact info panels clearly separated from the hero illustration.
- The character design must visibly combine Korean traditional motifs with fantasy RPG equipment and class identity.
- Use {캐릭터 종족}, {캐릭터 직업}, {주요 무기}, {전통 모티프}, {색감 테마}, {일러스트 스타일}, {정보 패널 내용} as active content drivers in the image, not as decorative afterthoughts.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals or certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean typography poster with an emotional quote as the main subject, designed as a print-ready editorial-style wall poster.
Create a realistic vertical art-poster that feels like it belongs to a small Korean indie gallery exhibition, with tactile paper, refined event information, and expressive Hangul typography.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main text area: {메인 문구} occupies the center 45–55% of the canvas, with strong visual hierarchy, deliberate line breaks, and the overall flow guided by {문구 배치}.
- Subtitle area: {부제 문구} placed below the main text in a smaller scale, aligned to the main block for a calm, poster-like rhythm.
- Poster information layer: add realistic event-poster details around the typography, including a small top label reading "감정문장 포스터전", a date/time/venue line such as "2026.05.01–05.31  11:00–19:00  성수 작은문장 갤러리", and ticket information such as "입장권 ₩7,500 / 현장 발권".
- Background: {배경 스타일} with {배경 오브젝트} integrated as a soft illustrated or photographic motif behind and around the text, using paper grain, ink texture, and a real printed-poster surface.
- Sponsor and credit area: include a small lower poster footer with sponsor-style text such as "후원: 문장상점 · 서울문화책방", designer credit "글·디자인  스튜디오 온기", and a tiny poster code like "POSTER 087 / PRINT EDITION".
- Color usage: build the design around {주요 색상}, allowing natural tonal variations, ink density differences, and paper shadows that make the print feel real.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Main typography block: render {메인 문구} as the focal point in a large calligraphic Hangul treatment, centered vertically and horizontally, with intentional variation in word size, tilt, brush pressure, and line break rhythm to create a hand-composed poster feel.
- Secondary text block: place {부제 문구} beneath the main phrase in a smaller, quieter style, reading like an emotional footnote while still being part of the finished poster design.
- Event header: place a compact header at the top with "감정문장 포스터전" and a tiny category label such as "KOREAN TYPOGRAPHY SERIES", set in clean sans-serif type to contrast with the main calligraphy.
- Background illustration layer: build {배경 스타일} behind the text with {배경 오브젝트} rendered as a poetic decorative element, such as a soft botanical shadow, folded paper shape, moonlit window, blurred flower stem, ink wash, or subtle object silhouette that supports the mood of the phrase.
- Footer information band: add date/time/venue, ticket info, sponsor line, tiny barcode-like ticket mark, and edition number near the bottom, small but legible, like a real gallery poster.
- Paper and print finish: add an off-white paper texture, visible fiber grain, slight ink absorption at letter edges, faint edge shadow, tiny registration imperfections, and gentle surface waviness so the image feels physically printed rather than digitally flat.
- Balance and legibility: ensure Hangul jamo are clean, proportioned, and fully readable, with no crowding, overlap errors, or broken strokes.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use a hand-drawn Hangul calligraphy style for {타이포그래피 스타일}, with bold brush-like strokes, slightly varied baseline, and sizes ranging from 72–160 px equivalent across the phrase; subtitle in Pretendard SemiBold or Noto Sans KR Medium at 28–42 px equivalent.
- Information typography: set the event details, ticket line, sponsor area, and designer credit in small Korean sans-serif type, approximately 16–28 px equivalent, carefully spaced and aligned to the poster grid.
- Color palette: use {주요 색상} as the primary palette; map them to specific tones such as beige #E8DDC8, olive #7A8450, and navy #1E2A3A, with off-white paper #F6F1E8 as the base if needed, plus natural ink-density variation from the same tones.
- Graphic elements: add delicate dividers, small dots, edition marks, ticket/barcode block, thin rule lines, and subtle ink or paper ornaments that feel printed and editorial.
- Border/shadow: add a soft drop shadow around the poster edge, 4 px y-offset, 12 px blur, 15% opacity, plus a very light inner paper shadow for depth.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: realistic flat poster composition photographed top-down with a Canon EOS R5 and RF 50mm f/1.8 lens, preserving a clean graphic-editorial layout without heavy perspective distortion.
- Lighting: diffused softbox lighting from upper-left with a gentle fill from lower-right, creating even tonal separation, faint paper texture highlights, and a soft physical shadow along the paper edge.
- Color grade: muted beige + olive + navy with low saturation, slightly warm paper-white balance, natural ink contrast, and the tactile finish of a high-end Korean graphic design print.

[6. MOOD]
Quiet contemporary Korean design-studio poster — the restrained emotional tone of a typographic print from an indie gallery shop, enriched with realistic exhibition details, tactile paper, and a refined editorial atmosphere.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following strings must appear exactly and clearly in the final image:
  - 오늘도 잘 살아남았다.
  - 작은 위로
- Additional Korean poster text should be readable and plausible, including short details such as "감정문장 포스터전", "2026.05.01–05.31", "성수 작은문장 갤러리", and "입장권 ₩7,500".
- Hangul legibility: all Korean characters must be fully formed, correctly spaced, and visually balanced; no broken consonants/vowels, no garbled text, no mirrored characters.
- Layout invariant: main phrase must remain the dominant focal point and the subtitle must stay secondary and unobtrusive.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[1. PURPOSE]
한국 소상공인 매장의 브랜드 로고 디자인 시트. One realistic portrait canvas presents 3 logo directions for the same brand, plus practical mockups, color chips, typography notes, and production-ready usage details for a believable local-store identity proposal.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Single poster-style canvas, portrait orientation, composed like a photographed brand-presentation board on a warm design desk.
- Arrange 3 logo options in the upper and middle area as the main focal point, with supporting mockups, color swatches, typography samples, small annotation labels, and material samples completing the lower area.
- Background treatment: 깔끔한 베이지 톤의 디자인 작업 매트 with subtle paper grain, matte cardstock texture, faint pencil registration marks, soft realistic shadows, a small binder clip, a kraft paper sample, and printed proof edges that make the scene feel like a real design review.
- Keep the composition tidy and systematic, with clear spacing between each option and each mockup, using {매장 이름}, {매장 컨셉}, {매장 키워드}, {로고 디자인 스타일}, {목업 적용 아이템}, {배경 및 연출}, {전체적인 색감 및 분위기}.
- Add realistic brand-sheet metadata: project code “BRAND SHEET 086”, date label “2026.05”, small note “소상공인 매장 로고 제안서”, and a compact designer credit line “Design review / local brand identity”.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Header area (top 10%): Set a polished brand-sheet title using {매장 이름} as the central wordmark example, with small supporting labels: “브랜드 로고 시안”, “{매장 컨셉}”, “키워드: {매장 키워드}”, “2026.05 / VOL.086”.
2. Logo option row (middle 45%): Present three distinct logo variants side by side, each clearly labeled “Option 1”, “Option 2”, “Option 3” with small Korean subtitles such as “간판형”, “패키지형”, “레트로형”. Include tiny usage notes under each: “Signage”, “Sticker”, “SNS Icon”.
3. Option 1: A refined modern wordmark version, thin-to-medium weight, restrained spacing, geometric balance, suitable for signage, receipt headers, stationery, and storefront decals.
4. Option 2: A hand-drawn serif version, slightly organic strokes, warm personality, subtle vintage flair, legible and refined for packaging, labels, and loyalty cards.
5. Option 3: A retro vintage version, slightly condensed, classic neighborhood-shop feel, with simple ornamental stability, a small emblem variation, and a timeless storefront identity.
6. Mockup strip (lower 35%): Show the same logo system applied to {목업 적용 아이템}, including realistic 명함, 간판, 컵 라벨, 인스타그램 프로필 화면, 스티커, 종이 쇼핑백, 영수증 상단, arranged as product-style mockups with consistent palette and realistic scale.
7. Production details: Add a small color palette block with labeled swatches “Cream”, “Cocoa”, “Terracotta”, “Charcoal”; add typography sample text “가나다라마바사 / ABC 123”; include a micro spec note “Logo clear space 8mm / Print proof 1차”.
8. Surface and framing: Items are aligned to a clear editorial grid, with natural printed-paper edges, subtle overlapping of real materials where appropriate, and believable shadows that reveal card thickness and paper texture.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Use Pretendard or Noto Sans KR for labels, medium weight 18–24px; use a hand-drawn serif display style for the vintage option; keep English accents in a simple serif or sans-serif that pairs with Korean.
- Color palette: warm beige #E8DDCF, cream #F6F0E8, cocoa brown #6B4E3D, muted terracotta #B7795B, soft charcoal #3A312C.
- Border/shadow: subtle 4px y-offset soft drop shadow, 12px blur, 15% opacity; thin divider lines in light brown for a tidy layout.
- Add tactile material realism: uncoated paper grain, slight ink absorption, debossed logo sample on one card, matte sticker finish, lightly curled receipt paper, and a soft highlight on the cup label.
- Include functional design annotations in Korean, such as “컬러 팔레트”, “간판 적용”, “명함 앞면”, “SNS 프로필”, “패키지 라벨”, while keeping every line short and legible.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: top-down flat lay look, as if shot with a 50mm lens on a high-resolution studio camera, crisp edges and minimal perspective distortion.
- Lighting: soft diffused studio light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from the right, even illumination with controlled shadows.
- Color grade: warm cream + beige + cocoa + muted terracotta, with slightly desaturated brand-guide neutrality.
- Rendering quality: photorealistic printed brand board, sharp Korean typography, believable paper depth, realistic scale relationships between business card, cup label, sign mockup, and Instagram profile card.

[6. MOOD]
Premium small-business identity sheet — inspired by a Kinfolk-style brand guidelines spread and the calm restraint of Aesop packaging visuals, but with warmer neighborhood-store realism, practical print samples, and handcrafted local-brand charm.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 보이는 텍스트: {매장 이름}, Option 1, Option 2, Option 3, {목업 적용 아이템}에 해당하는 한글 표기.
- Include clearly readable Korean labels: “브랜드 로고 시안”, “소상공인 매장 로고 제안서”, “컬러 팔레트”, “간판 적용”, “명함 앞면”, “SNS 프로필”, “패키지 라벨”, “키워드: {매장 키워드}”.
- All 3 logo options must represent the same brand name consistently across wordmarks and mockups.
- Korean typography must be clean, fully legible, and properly rendered without broken characters.
- Keep the mockup items matching the same brand identity and color palette across all applications.
- The final image must feel like a real printed logo proposal photographed on a design desk, not a sterile digital template.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

studio:prompts3:ours-085.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
한국풍 메이저 아르카나 타로카드 1장 일러스트, 세로형 럭셔리 카드 굿즈 비주얼.
전통 민화와 점성술 타로의 감성을 결합한 수집형 카드 디자인으로, 실제 인쇄된 프리미엄 덱의 대표 카드처럼 보이도록 종이 질감, 금박, 작은 해설 문구, 에디션 표기를 함께 구성한다.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 카드 전체는 세로형 직사각형 비율로 구성하고, 중앙에 카드 본체가 화면의 약 72%를 차지하도록 배치한다.
- 카드 외부 배경은 {카드 외부 배경}로 설정하고, 한지 섬유결과 은은한 보자기 천결, 금박 가루가 살짝 비치는 표면 위에 카드가 놓인 듯한 깊이를 만든다.
- 카드 아래에는 부드러운 그림자를 넣어 실제 굿즈 촬영처럼 떠 보이게 하고, 카드 모서리에는 아주 약한 두께감과 인쇄 단면을 표현한다.
- 카드 내부는 상단 헤더, 중앙 메인 일러스트, 하단 이름 영역, 아주 작은 키워드/크레딧 라인이 안정적으로 구분되도록 4단 구조로 정리한다.
- 외곽 장식은 {카드 테두리 디자인}이 정교하게 한 바퀴 둘러싸는 구조로 하고, 모서리에는 작은 매듭 장식과 구름 문양, 좌우 변에는 산수와 물결 문양이 이어지게 배치한다.
- 메인 인물과 배경 오브제는 {카드 일러스트 내용}을 중심으로 하되, 인물의 시선, 까치의 날개 방향, 매화 가지, 달빛 장식이 카드 중앙의 상징 축으로 자연스럽게 수렴하도록 설계한다.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Top header zone (약 12%): {카드 번호 및 이름}을 상단 중앙에 배치하고, 로마 숫자는 크게, 카드 이름은 그 아래 보조 크기로 정렬한다. 상단 가장자리에는 작은 컬렉션 표기 "{덱 컬렉션명}"과 에디션 코드 "{에디션 코드}"를 좌우로 배치한다.
- Border frame zone: {카드 테두리 디자인}을 골드 박선과 함께 카드 전체 외곽에 적용하고, 문양은 한국 전통 공예처럼 섬세하고 촘촘하게 반복한다. 금박 라인은 빛을 받는 부분만 미세하게 반짝이도록 한다.
- Main illustration zone (중앙 58%): {카드 일러스트 내용}을 민화풍으로 묘사하되, 남녀 인물은 서로 마주 보는 균형 구도에 두고, 뒤편에 두 마리의 까치와 매화나무를 배치한다. 배경에는 둥근 달, 낮은 산 능선, 작은 별자리 점묘, 전통 창호 실루엣을 레이어처럼 넣어 타로의 신비감을 강화한다.
- Symbolic detail zone: 한복 주름, 매화꽃, 까치의 위치, 전통 의상 실루엣, 달빛 원형 장식, 붉은 실 매듭이 서로 겹치지 않게 정리해 카드 읽기 좋은 상징 구조를 만든다.
- Keyword strip zone: 중앙 일러스트 아래 얇은 띠에 카드 해석 키워드 "{카드 키워드}"를 작은 한글 세리프 글자로 넣고, 좌우에는 작은 음양 구슬과 꽃잎 아이콘을 배치한다.
- Bottom title zone (약 10%): 카드 하단에 {하단 카드명}을 세리프 계열로 넣고, 중앙 정렬과 좁은 자간으로 고급스럽게 마감한다. 가장 하단에는 작은 제작 크레딧 "{작가 크레딧}"과 시리얼 표기 "{카드 시리얼}"을 넣어 실제 수집용 카드처럼 보이게 한다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Noto Serif KR, Cormorant Garamond, 또는 전통적인 세리프 계열 느낌으로, 상단 숫자는 semi-bold 48px 수준, 하단 이름은 28px 수준으로 설정한다. 키워드와 크레딧은 10–14px 수준의 선명한 인쇄 글자처럼 처리한다.
- Color palette: {주요 색감}을 기본으로 하고, 배경과 음영에는 짙은 먹색 #1B1B1B, 카드 바탕에는 미색 #F4E7C8, 골드 액센트는 #C9A24A, 진홍색 포인트는 #9E2A2B, 은은한 그림자에는 #00000033을 사용한다.
- Border/shadow: 카드 본체 아래에 4px y-offset, 18px blur, 20% opacity의 부드러운 드롭 섀도를 넣고, 외곽 골드 라인은 얇고 선명한 하이라이트로 마감한다.
- Surface finish: 인쇄용 고급 카드처럼 약한 한지 종이 질감, 미세한 잉크 번짐, 금박 압인, 가장자리의 얇은 코팅 반사를 더해 전통 민화의 수공예 느낌과 프리미엄 굿즈의 물성을 함께 살린다.
- Illustration finish: 얼굴과 손은 자연스러운 비례를 유지하고, 의복 패턴은 단청색과 금색 실자수처럼 보이게 하며, 민화 특유의 평면적 색면과 현대 타로 카드의 선명한 중심 구도를 결합한다.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: front-facing studio product shot 느낌으로 85mm lens, f/4, 정면 대칭 구도처럼 보이게 렌더링한다.
- Lighting: soft studio key light from upper-left at 45°, subtle rim light from upper-right, plus gentle gold edge glow around the card frame.
- Color grade: deep dancheong palette with warm gold highlights, slightly muted shadows, and rich lacquer-like contrast.
- Rendering detail: crisp printed typography, embossed foil border, tactile paper grain, controlled specular highlights on gold lines, museum-shop premium merchandise realism.

[6. MOOD]
프리미엄 전통 오컬트 카드 에디토리얼 — 한국 궁중 공예품의 정교함, 민화 병풍의 상징성, 현대 타로 덱 패키지의 수집 욕구가 함께 느껴지는 신비롭고 고급스러운 분위기.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 표시할 문자열 — "VI. 연인 / The Lovers", "한국풍 메이저 아르카나", "길 · 선택 · 조화", "달빛화방 2026 한정판".
- 상단에는 "VI. 연인 / The Lovers"가 선명하게 읽혀야 하고, 하단에는 "연인 / The Lovers"가 중앙 정렬로 또렷하게 보여야 한다.
- 작은 에디션 텍스트 "SEOUL FOLK TAROT", "No. 06", "ED. 2026-05"는 실제 인쇄된 카드처럼 작지만 판독 가능해야 한다.
- 카드 번호와 이름, 키워드, 작가 크레딧은 장식 문양과 겹치지 않게 정렬하고, 글자가 번지거나 잘리지 않도록 한다.
- 인물은 한국 민화풍이지만 얼굴과 손의 형태는 자연스럽고 균형 있게 표현하며, 한복의 옷고름과 붉은 실 매듭은 연인의 상징으로 명확히 보이게 한다.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Low-resolution text or unreadable typography
- Celebrity composites or recognizable real people

[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- figure_concept: {피규어 컨셉}
- package_type: {박스 패키지 형태}
- panel_design: {박스 패널 디자인}
- package_language: {박스 정보 언어}
- additional_box_info: {박스 추가 정보}
- background: {배경}
- direction: {전체적인 연출}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
1-2 English lines: realistic collector catalog product photograph of an original person transformed into a Funko Pop-style vinyl figure, presented with a premium retail box package full of believable shelf-ready details.
Suitable for e-commerce hero image, collectible catalog presentation, fan merchandise preview, and launch-page product photography.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: {참고 이미지} transformed into a vinyl figure with oversized head, dot eyes, simplified body proportions, while keeping the person’s face shape, hairstyle, outfit cues, and {피규어 컨셉} recognizable.
- Composition: figure stands in the left-mid area and the {박스 패키지 형태} retail box stands in the right-mid area, angled together like a real product set photographed for a collector catalog.
- Background treatment: {배경} interpreted as a realistic product-photo setting with a tactile tabletop surface, soft studio reflections, gentle depth, and a few believable retail-photography details such as faint shelf shadow, paper texture, or acrylic display riser if appropriate.
- Framing direction: slightly elevated 3/4 product angle so both the figure and the front + side panel of the box are clearly readable, with the box window, barcode area, warning label, and panel artwork visible.
- Overall staging: apply {전체적인 연출} with premium but realistic lighting, natural contact shadows, subtle plastic glare, and the slight imperfections of real printed packaging.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Figure area: place the {참고 이미지}-based collector figure standing upright, centered slightly left, with glossy vinyl surface, oversized head, small dot eyes, simplified hands and shoes, but preserving the original hairstyle, facial characteristics, outfit silhouette, and {피규어 컨셉} details.
2. Box front face: show a transparent window box with crisp edges, premium retail finish, clear PET plastic window, inner cardboard tray, and a front display layout that could plausibly hold the figure inside or present it immediately beside the box.
3. Side panel: apply {박스 패널 디자인} as an illustrated side panel with stylized character artwork, a vertical character name strip, small pose icons, product code blocks, and collectible-product labeling.
4. Box text zone: render {피규어 이름} in Korean prominently on the front and/or top panel, then add series line, serial number, edition label, age guide, manufacturer-style microcopy, and structured product details.
5. Package information: use {박스 정보 언어} for printed copy, with Korean-first retail packaging text such as 피규어 컬렉션, 한정 에디션, 캐릭터 카드 포함, VOL.084, NO.247, 2026 COLLECTION, and {박스 추가 정보} integrated naturally on the rear or side information panel.
6. Real retail details: include a small barcode block, QR-code-like square, price sticker reading ₩24,900, product SKU area, tiny recycling symbols, caution label, size label 약 10cm, and small credit line Designed for collector display.
7. Base and shadows: use a realistic studio tabletop base with soft contact shadows under both figure and box, controlled glossy reflections on the vinyl head and plastic window, and natural paperboard thickness along the box flaps.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard ExtraBold for the main Korean name, Pretendard Medium for secondary package details, and Noto Sans KR for small labels; name size large and bold, details at 1/4 to 1/6 of title size.
- Color palette: studio white #F7F7F5, cool gray #D9DDE3, premium black #111111, accent silver #BFC5CC, subtle warm beige #EDE6DA, with package accent colors derived from {박스 패널 디자인} and the clothing colors in {참고 이미지}.
- Print finish: thin box-edge lines, crisp printed borders, embossed-looking title area, soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 16% opacity, light reflection on the plastic window, and faint paper grain on matte cardboard.
- Packaging realism: show folded cardboard seams, tuck-tab edges, slight corner bevels, transparent window thickness, inner blister highlights, fine print alignment, and a believable retail shelf presentation.
- Text hierarchy: main name must dominate, product number and series details should read like authentic package information, and microcopy should remain small but visually structured.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame product shot, 85mm lens at f/8, slightly elevated 3/4 angle for clean catalog perspective.
- Lighting: large studio softbox from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from right, faint top kicker to define the plastic window, controlled reflections on glossy vinyl and box film.
- Color grade: neutral luxury product grade with clean whites, restrained contrast, slightly cool editorial toning, realistic shadow density, and commercial product-photo clarity.
- Material rendering: glossy vinyl for the figure, satin-matte paperboard for the box, clear PET plastic for the window, small metallic-silver accent ink, and believable printed label texture.

[6. MOOD]
Premium collector catalog product shot — like a high-end designer toy launch page with refined Korean retail packaging, polished studio photography, and a realistic limited-edition merchandise release feeling.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 다음 문구가 정확히 렌더링되어야 함: {피규어 이름}, 시리즈 라인, 시리얼 넘버, 정품 인증 마크.
- Additional Korean package text should be short and realistic: 피규어 컬렉션, 한정 에디션, 캐릭터 카드 포함, 2026 COLLECTION, VOL.084, NO.247, ₩24,900, 약 10cm.
- Figure anatomy/layout invariants: the figure must have exactly 5 fingers per hand when visible, oversized head with simplified body proportions, and the box + figure must both remain fully legible in a 3/4 product composition.
- The person’s face characteristics, hairstyle, and outfit cues from {참고 이미지} must remain recognizable after the Funko Pop-style transformation.
- Package must include a visible front window, side character artwork, barcode area, serial-number zone, small caution label, price sticker, and collector-edition product information.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

studio:prompts3:ours-083.content:
[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean character papertoy illustration, paper-craft diorama poster for kidult collectible display.
Vertical composition that looks like a premium folded paper figure kit: assembled character, printable template sheet, package-cover information, and miniature traditional Korean scene in one realistic product-poster layout.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main character placement: center hero occupies about 55% of the frame, standing upright like a cut-and-fold papertoy with visible tabs, fold edges, and glued seams.
- Background treatment: a cohesive paper diorama of {배경_장소}, built from layered cardstock with {배경_추가_요소} placed behind and around the character as physical cut-paper scenery.
- Framing direction: slight top-down product-poster angle; integrate a printed top title band, side product info strip, lower template sheet, and barcode area as parts of the craft-kit cover.
- Character design should clearly reflect {캐릭터_외형}, {캐릭터_직업_소품}, and {캐릭터_의상_색상} using flat-color print surfaces, visible ink registration, and clean die-cut outlines.
- Include {추가_배치_요소} as a physical printed sheet element near the lower area, aligned like an uncut papertoy template with fold guides, glue tabs, numbering, and small assembly icons.
- Add realistic package/poster details: product code, production date, difficulty rating, price, workshop name, address/contact line, simple barcode, event notice, ticket information, and decorative Korean craft motifs printed on cardstock.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero character (mid 55%): a papertoy-style Korean traditional maiden rendered as folded paper volumes, with crisp fold lines, glued seam hints, numbered tabs, and simple geometric limbs; show {캐릭터_외형} clearly in silhouette and face shape.
2. Outfit and props: emphasize {캐릭터_의상_색상} in flat printed panels, and place {캐릭터_직업_소품} as a recognizable accessory held or attached at the side, with stylized but readable decorative details such as printed embroidery, knot tassels, and small pattern blocks.
3. Base and staging: ground the figure on a paper floor plane that looks like a miniature display base, with cut-paper shadows, raised-edge cardstock trim, printed ruler ticks, and a small nameplate reading 한국의 멋.
4. Background scene: construct {배경_장소} as layered paper architecture and scenery, then add {배경_추가_요소} as simplified papercraft trees, stones, rooflines, petals, and horizon pieces with visible paper thickness.
5. Printed sheet element: place {추가_배치_요소} as a visible secondary layout area, including label blocks, fold indicators, dotted cut lines, glue zones, template-like panels, and tiny instruction pictograms that reinforce the assembled-from-paper concept.
6. Package information system: include top title {메인_제목}, subtitle {시리즈_명}, product code {제품_번호}, date {제작_날짜}, difficulty {난이도}, price {가격}, and a clean barcode block printed like a boutique craft kit.
7. Workshop / event strip: include {작업실_이름}, {작업실_주소}, {연락처}, plus a small poster-style event notice with {행사_날짜}, {행사_장소}, and {티켓_문구}; make these feel like real printed retail/event details rather than floating captions.
8. Surface realism: make paper grain, matte ink coverage, tiny cut burrs, pressed fold marks, adhesive shine, print misalignment, and cardstock layer shadows visible across both character and background so the whole image reads as handcrafted papercraft.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard Bold for the main title band and Noto Sans KR Medium for product labels, event notice, price, and template instructions; use clear Korean sans-serif letterforms sized like a premium museum gift-shop craft kit package.
- Color palette: use soft hanbok tones and paper neutrals such as #F7E6EA, #7FB7B0, #E9DDC8, #C8B39A, warm black ink #2C241F, plus small accent colors inspired by dancheong red, jade green, and muted gold ink.
- Border/shadow: add a thin off-white paper border with soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity; keep all shadows paper-like and tabletop-realistic.
- Graphic details: include decorative cloud curls, stitched paper tabs, hangul label stickers, tiny scissor icons, dotted folding arrows, and a compact sponsor/workshop area printed on the same cardstock material.
- Layout rhythm: balance assembled figure, lower template sheet, side information strip, and background diorama so it feels like a real collectible papertoy cover photographed for a catalog.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: simulated product poster shot with a 50mm lens look, f/5.6, mild perspective, as if photographed from slightly above a tabletop diorama.
- Lighting: {조명_스타일}, soft studio key light from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from front-right, and faint ambient bounce to reveal paper texture, raised ink, tabs, and folded edges.
- Color grade: warm cream paper base with muted pastel hanbok tones, slightly desaturated craft-store palette, clean matte finish, subtle tactile shadows, and realistic printed-paper contrast.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean kidult craft editorial — feels like a collectible museum gift-shop papercraft kit, a boutique workshop poster, and a charming traditional character diorama photographed with careful product styling.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the main visible printed text must include: {메인_제목}, {시리즈_명}, 한국의 멋, {제품_번호}, {제작_날짜}, 난이도 {난이도}, {가격}, {작업실_이름}, {작업실_주소}, {연락처}, {행사_날짜}, {행사_장소}, {티켓_문구}.
- Template micro text must be readable Korean: 접는 선, 풀칠면, 오려내기, 완성 높이 12cm, 조립 순서 1-2-3, 보관용 받침대.
- Barcode area may show numeric retail-style text: 880-083-247-0526, with a small caption 한정 종이공예 키트.
- The character must look like assembled paper with visible fold lines, cut edges, printed tabs, and glued seams; avoid smooth plastic or glossy 3D toy material.
- The background, props, package labels, event strip, barcode, and template sheet must all share the same paper-craft material language.
- The papertoy proportions and accessory placement should remain coherent and readable as a single collectible Korean character sheet.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or likeness of real people
- Illegible random filler text pretending to be Korean

[1. PURPOSE]
Designer vinyl toy collector shot with premium retail packaging, vertical editorial product render for limited-edition collaboration showcase.
Korean designer-toy luxury display scene featuring one character figure, one square window box package, and realistic collectible retail details for a gallery catalog image.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main toy placement: {토이 형태} occupies the left 58% of the frame as the hero object, standing upright in a polished 3/4 view with the head slightly turned toward camera.
- Package placement: {패키지 스타일} sits on the right 30% of the frame, aligned slightly behind the toy so the square window, logo, series copy, edition label, and barcode area remain readable.
- Background treatment: {배경 환경} with a white cube gallery wall, smooth floor plane, soft pedestal reflection, and a small acrylic nameplate placed near the toy base.
- Surface emphasis: {토이 컨셉} and {표면 디테일} must read as printed designer graphics integrated into the toy body, not as stickers.
- Framing direction: vertical luxury retail composition with the toy and box filling the frame confidently, leaving room for readable packaging typography and collectible details.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero toy body: render {토이 형태} as a geometric blocky bear-form vinyl figure with clean edges, compact limbs, and clearly defined wrist and leg joint lines.
2. Body graphics: apply {토이 컨셉} across the chest, limbs, and head panels in a balanced layout, with {주요 색상} distributed in crisp color-block segments.
3. Surface finish: add realistic vinyl gloss on outer curves and matte contrast on flatter panels, with {표면 디테일} wrapping around the body like premium tampo print work.
4. Packaging unit: place {패키지 스타일} beside the toy, showing a square clear window, black matte outer frame, metallic logo treatment, series Korean copy, a designer signature area, edition-number sticker, and side-panel product specs.
5. Retail information layer: include a small bottom-right barcode block, price label, release date, age guide, material line, and warning copy as believable package printing without using fake official seals.
6. Collector presentation: stage the toy and package as a matched limited-edition pair with a small acrylic display tag reading the series name and edition number.
7. Package face content: the front box must feature {브랜드명}, {시리즈명}, {제품 카피}, {에디션 번호}, {출시일}, {가격}, {디자이너명}, and {바코드 번호} in a premium Korean retail layout.
8. Side/spine detail: the visible package spine should include a vertical credit line reading "ART TOY SERIES / {디자이너명}" plus a small Hangul series label.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard Bold for the box title, Noto Sans KR Medium for series copy and product specs, and a small handwritten signature style for the designer mark; type sizes should feel like premium product packaging, with tight leading and clean kerning.
- Rendered package text examples: "{브랜드명}", "{시리즈명}", "{제품 카피}", "{에디션 번호}", "{출시일}", "{가격}", "디자인: {디자이너명}", "소재: 소프트 비닐 / 높이 18cm", "{주의문구}", "BARCODE {바코드 번호}".
- Color palette: charcoal black #111111, deep teal #0F6B6B, antique gold #C8A24A, cool white #F5F5F2, subtle silver highlights #BFC4C9.
- Border/shadow: soft drop shadow 4px y-offset, 16px blur, 18% opacity under both toy and box; faint edge highlight on the box window to suggest acrylic reflection.
- Decorative graphics: use thin gold divider lines, small geometric hanok lattice motifs, a round limited-edition sticker, and refined side-panel microcopy to make the retail box feel complete.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame studio product photo, Canon EOS R5 with 85mm f/4 lens perspective, crisp commercial clarity, slight telephoto compression, front-right angle.
- Lighting: large diffused softbox from upper-left at 45°, gentle fill from right, thin rim light to define edges, controlled specular highlights on vinyl and window plastic.
- Color grade: cool gallery white with restrained teal-black contrast and warm metallic gold accents, slightly desaturated luxury catalog finish.
- Material rendering: believable injection-molded vinyl, subtle mold parting lines at joints, acrylic window reflections, matte paperboard grain on the box, metallic foil catching light on the logo and edition sticker.

[6. MOOD]
High-end Korean designer toy catalog aesthetic — luxury collector retail photography with gallery presentation, precise packaging typography, and a limited-edition collaboration atmosphere.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: all visible package copy must be clean and legible Hangul, including "{브랜드명}", "{시리즈명}", "{제품 카피}", "{에디션 번호}", "{출시일}", "{가격}", "디자인: {디자이너명}", "{주의문구}".
- Package realism: include barcode "{바코드 번호}", side spine credit "ART TOY SERIES / {디자이너명}", material line "소재: 소프트 비닐", height line "높이 18cm", and a small acrylic display tag reading "{시리즈명} · {에디션 번호}".
- Anatomy/layout invariants: wrist and leg joint lines must be sharp and symmetrical; the toy must remain clearly bear-shaped and blocky; the box must stay square-window format.
- The toy and package must appear as a matched limited-edition set in the same scene, with the same colors, motifs, and designer signature repeated across toy, box, and display tag.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likenesses

[1. PURPOSE]
Kiddult collector catalog illustration of a Funko Pop-style vinyl character and retail collector box package, staged like a real premium toy product launch photograph.
Vertical packaging showcase for social-media and catalog use, with the figure and box clearly readable at a 3/4 angle, enriched with realistic package labeling, barcode area, edition details, and small collector-display accessories.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: a Funko Pop-style vinyl figure with an oversized square head, tiny body, black dot eyes, and no mouth, positioned in the foreground-left with the box package standing slightly behind it on the right.
- Character design details should follow {캐릭터 컨셉}, with simplified but recognizable color-block clothing, accessory shapes, molded vinyl seams, glossy highlights, and tiny sculpted details.
- Packaging: a tall collector box with a transparent plastic window, side panel character illustration, bold title placement, top number badge, item code, warning label area, barcode block, and small manufacturing-style micro text, using {박스 메인 컬러} as the dominant box treatment.
- Layout: figure occupies about 40% of the frame, box occupies about 45%, both fully in frame and angled for product visibility; include a realistic tabletop base with soft reflections, a small removable character-name card, a tiny price sticker, and a folded insert leaflet partly visible near the box.
- Background: {배경 스타일} as a warm studio product set with subtle paper sweep texture, soft gradient, faint shelf-line shadow, and realistic reflections on the box window.
- Title and name areas should feature {시리즈 타이틀} and {피규어 이름} in clearly legible Korean typography, plus realistic supporting package text such as series number, vinyl figure label, edition line, SKU, and barcode captions.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Foreground figure: render the vinyl character with the Funko Pop proportion logic—large head, reduced limbs, simplified hands, glossy black eyes, neutral mouthless expression, plastic specular highlights, visible molded edges, and the outfit/accessory cues from {캐릭터 컨셉}.
2. Packaging body: place the collector-style box immediately beside the figure, using {박스 메인 컬러} across the main surfaces, with a transparent front window that reveals a faint inner figure silhouette, plastic reflections, inner cardboard backing, and folded tabs at the top/bottom edges.
3. Front panel details: add a top title band with {시리즈 타이틀}, a large number mark "#007", a lower nameplate with {피규어 이름}, a small label "VINYL FIGURE", a Korean line "서울 오피스 에디션", and a lower-right barcode area with SKU-style micro text.
4. Side panel: add a character illustration panel on the visible side of the box, matching the same outfit and accessory cues as the figure, with clean graphic shapes, simplified shadows, a vertical name strip, and tiny collector-series copy.
5. Typography zone: set {시리즈 타이틀} near the top/front panel and {피규어 이름} prominently on the front name area, with Korean lettering crisp, centered, and packaged like a real retail toy box; include small readable package callouts such as "한정 컬렉터 라인", "NO.007", "KC-081", and "권장연령 15+" without making them look like official certification seals.
6. Display context: stage the entire product on a satin-finish tabletop with realistic contact shadows, a subtle clear acrylic riser edge behind the figure, a small collector card reading "오늘의 김대리", and a warm catalog lighting setup that emphasizes the box corners, window plastic, and vinyl material.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use bold, clean sans-serif packaging typography similar to Pretendard Bold or Noto Sans KR Bold, with small supporting labels in Regular; title size should be large enough to read at thumbnail scale, while micro text should feel like authentic packaging detail.
- Color palette: base the box on {박스 메인 컬러}, supported by warm white, soft cream, charcoal black, and a small amount of accent orange/yellow for hierarchy; use matching accent strips, small numbering tags, and graphic dividers across the box panels.
- Border/shadow: use soft product shadows with 4px y-offset, 12px blur, and 15% opacity under the box and figure; keep package edges crisp and toy-like, with realistic cardboard thickness, folded seams, and subtle glossy lamination.
- Add believable retail-package features: barcode block, SKU label, tiny caution copy, series number marker, inner backing pattern, side-panel portrait, top-flap tab line, and a small price sticker marked "₩17,900".
- Keep all Korean package text sharp and intentionally designed, not random filler; arrange labels with real hierarchy like a premium designer-toy package.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: Canon EOS R5 product photography look, 85mm lens at f/5.6 with a slightly elevated 3/4 angle, clean perspective and minimal distortion.
- Lighting: soft studio softbox from upper-left at 45° with a gentle fill from the right, producing even reflections on the window plastic, soft highlights on the vinyl head, and a subtle rim on the box edges.
- Color grade: bright catalog neutrals with controlled yellow-orange saturation, clean whites, a slight warm tint to the packaging colors, and realistic contrast in the shadows beneath the product.
- Material rendering: glossy vinyl figure, semi-gloss printed cardboard box, clear PET window with diagonal light streaks, satin tabletop surface, and tiny paper texture on the insert card.

[6. MOOD]
Premium kiddult collectible catalog — retail designer-toy display aesthetic with the polished feel of a real product shoot, playful Korean office-character charm, and enough package detail to feel like a collectible item customers could pick up in a toy shop.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 정확히 렌더링할 문구: "꼬마 시리즈 #007", "김대리".
- Also render these Korean package details clearly where appropriate: "서울 오피스 에디션", "한정 컬렉터 라인", "오늘의 김대리", "권장연령 15+", "₩17,900".
- The character must preserve the Funko Pop-style proportions: oversized square head, very small body, black dot eyes, mouthless face.
- The box and figure must both be visible at the same time, and the visible front/side panels must remain readable and not cropped.
- Use {캐릭터 컨셉}, {박스 메인 컬러}, {시리즈 타이틀}, {피규어 이름}, {배경 스타일}, and {전체적인 분위기} as the guiding content and mood references.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[INPUT]
