[1. PURPOSE]
Premium K-pop idol collectible action figure product shot, 1:6 scale studio catalog image for collector marketing.
Realistic luxury figure presentation with boxed packaging, molded tray inserts, miniature fan-item props, retail labels, and collector-card details, designed like a high-end collectible showcase photographed for a launch campaign.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main figure placement: the {피규어 종류} stands slightly right of center, occupying about 45% of the frame height, with the full body visible from head to boots and the face sharply readable.
- Packaging placement: the luxury box sits on the left rear quarter, angled 15° toward camera so the front face, side spine, foil product title, serial number, barcode block, and edition label are readable.
- Prop arrangement: {주변 소품} are grouped around the base as a realistic collector unboxing set: miniature album sleeve, tiny concert ticket, lightstick, photocard, spare hand parts, clear display stand pieces, sticker sheet, and folded instruction leaflet.
- Background treatment: dark studio gradient from charcoal to deep black, with a reflective acrylic floor, soft reflections under the boots and packaging, and faint stage-light haze for a realistic premium product shoot.
- Framing direction: vertical catalog composition with a polished collector-shop atmosphere, crisp separation between figure, box, tray insert, cards, ticket, and props.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero figure area: {피규어 브랜드/스타일} interpretation of a 30cm-class idol figure, posed in a confident stage-ready stance, with realistic articulation joints, sculpted hands, layered hair sculpt, interchangeable hand parts displayed nearby, and a balanced premium silhouette.
2. Outfit rendering: {아이돌 컨셉 의상} shown with visible leather grain, stitched seams, zipper teeth, tiny snap buttons, metallic reflections on silver accessories, layered fabric folds, molded boot texture, and physically manufactured seams that feel collectible-grade.
3. Head and face detail: {아이돌 메이크업/헤어} rendered with clean facial paint application, sharp eyeliner, soft blush control, glossy lip tint, subtle skin shading, and individual hair strands sculpted with salon-grade precision.
4. Accessory cluster: {주변 소품} placed as premium collector extras, each miniature item scaled consistently: album cover with tiny track list lines, translucent lightstick dome, concert ticket with seat code, photocard with caption, sticker decals, and a small display-base nameplate.
5. Packaging design: the collector box uses matte black surfaces, metallic foil-style branding, printed serial number, product code, barcode area, age label, edition label, and refined Korean/English copy in a luxury toy-brand layout. Add small spine/credit text such as STAGE UNIT 01, 1:6 SCALE COLLECTIBLE, ART DIRECTION K-POP FIGURE TEAM.
6. Retail realism: include a semi-gloss molded inner tray partly visible behind the figure, a small hanging price tag reading ₩189,000, tiny caution copy, QR-like square, and a collector card labeled 포토카드 SET A without implying any official certification.
7. Surface and shadow: all objects rest on a dark studio base with soft contact shadows, slight specular highlights, realistic dust-free acrylic reflections, and controlled light glints on metallic accessories, box foil, ticket varnish, and clear plastic tray edges.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: clean luxury product typography using Pretendard SemiBold for Korean copy, Neue Haas Grotesk or Helvetica Now for English marks, with clear hierarchy across front title, side spine, serial number, barcode label, price tag, photocard caption, and warning microcopy.
- Color palette: matte black #111111, graphite #2B2B2B, metallic silver #C7CCD1, cool gray #7A8088, deep wine accent #4A1F2A, off-white label text #F2F0EA.
- Packaging graphics: combine metallic foil logotype, deep wine accent strip, small silver rule lines, product-code labels, barcode block, tray window shine, and collector-edition typography printed directly on the box.
- Display detail: allow realistic retail and fan-culture elements such as ticket stubs, tiny stickers, molded plastic tray, nameplate, price label, instruction sheet, and photocard captions as long as they support the premium collectible presentation.
- Shadow and finish: soft drop shadow with 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 18% opacity; subtle rim light on edges; printed graphic frames and dividers may appear on packaging, cards, ticket, and labels.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame studio product photo look, 85mm lens at f/8 for crisp detail separation and low distortion.
- Lighting: large softbox key from upper-left at 45°, narrow rim light from upper-right, faint fill from front-center, controlled specular hits on metallic accessories, box foil, clear tray plastic, glossy photocard coating, and reflective acrylic base.
- Color grade: cool graphite base with silver highlights, slightly desaturated blacks, premium catalog contrast, clean neutral white balance, deep wine accent preserved in labels and packaging details.
- Material realism: matte cardboard box, foil stamping, molded PVC skin finish, satin-fabric outfit texture, rubberized boots, translucent lightstick plastic, semi-gloss album sleeve, perforated ticket paper, and tiny printed Korean microtext.

[6. MOOD]
High-end collectible catalog editorial — feels like a premium Hot Toys launch page mixed with a modern luxury toy brand campaign, photographed as a realistic limited-edition K-pop figure reveal with fan goods, packaging details, and collector-shop desirability.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the following Korean strings must appear correctly in the rendered image:
  - K-POP 아이돌 콜렉터 액션 피규어
  - 검은 가죽 자켓 + 실버 액세서리, 댄스 스테이지 의상
  - 스모키 메이크업, 정밀한 헤어 스컬프트
  - 럭셔리 콜렉터 박스 패키지(검은 매트 + 메탈릭 로고 + 아이돌 이름 + 시리얼 넘버 + 한글 카피), 앨범 미니어처, 응원봉 미니어처, 콘서트 티켓 미니어처
  - 스튜디오 콜렉터샷 스타일, 부드러운 스폿라이트 + 어두운 그라데이션 배경
  - 사실적이고 고품질의 피규어 콜렉터 카탈로그 룩
- Additional Korean packaging and prop text to render clearly where space allows:
  - STAGE UNIT 01
  - 1:6 SCALE COLLECTIBLE
  - VOL.247 LIMITED DROP
  - 출시일 2026.05
  - SERIAL NO. KID-0526-001
  - 포토카드 SET A
  - 콘서트 티켓 2026.05.24 / SEOUL DOME / A구역 12열
  - 공식 응원 컬러: 실버 와인
  - 가격 ₩189,000
  - 바코드 영역
  - 작은 부품 주의
- Layout invariants: the figure, box, inner tray, ticket, photocard, lightstick, album miniature, nameplate, barcode area, and price tag must all remain sharply legible and physically plausible at 1:6 scale.
- Preserve the exact input concepts: {피규어 종류}, {피규어 브랜드/스타일}, {아이돌 컨셉 의상}, {아이돌 메이크업/헤어}, {주변 소품}, {배경 및 조명}, {전체적인 룩} must guide the final appearance without changing the subject.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]

- Broken Korean characters

[INPUT]
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean blind-box mini figure catalog illustration, vertical product lookbook composition with both retail box and figure clearly visible.
Designed for social-media-ready collectible toy promotion with realistic package printing, playful unboxing accessories, and premium designer-toy merchandising detail.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject: {피규어 캐릭터} centered in the lower-mid 45% of the frame, scaled large enough to read as the hero product while still leaving room for the package and small retail details.
- Packaging: {패키지 컨셉} placed beside and slightly behind the figure, tilted 10–15 degrees for depth, with the front window, side illustration panel, series logo, barcode sticker, and price label visible.
- Layout: {전체 구도} with the box occupying one vertical third and the figure taking the opposite third, arranged like a collectible catalog spread for a 1024x1536 promotional image.
- Background: {배경연출} with a pastel tabletop sweep, faint paper texture, soft cast shadows, tiny sticker confetti, and a low acrylic riser to give the product a real studio-display setting.
- Props: sticker sheet, mini collector card, foil blind-bag wrapper, product tag, ribbon, and small price sticker arranged around the base as an unboxing scene, while keeping the figure face and package title readable.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Hero figure area: {피규어 캐릭터} rendered as {피규어 형태}, with glossy highlights on the face and shoes, matte accents on clothing folds, molded seams, and a tactile vinyl collectible finish.
2. Package area: {패키지 컨셉} shown as a premium blind-box carton with a clear transparent window, illustrated side panels, series logo, “블라인드 ?” badge, “랜덤 1종” label, age mark, price sticker, and barcode block.
3. Realistic retail details: include {시리즈명}, {태그라인}, {발매정보}, {가격표기}, {바코드번호}, {구성품문구}, {경고문구}, small SKU code, recycling mark, and a tiny manufacturer-info strip printed on the box side.
4. Side/back glimpse: show a partial lineup grid of tiny silhouette icons, a “SECRET 1종” teaser badge, and miniature collector checklist graphics on the side panel so it feels like an actual blind-box product.
5. Material detail layer: emphasize transparent plastic window reflections, printed cardboard grain, die-cut folds, crisp sticker edges, foil bag crinkles, satin ribbon fibers, and subtle dust-free product-photography highlights.
6. Companion props: add a collector card with the same character illustration, a small hang tag, pastel stickers, and a folded leaflet in coordinated {색감} tones, staged like a polished new-release unboxing display.
7. Typography zone: place the Korean series title, tagline, feature labels, warning copy, barcode digits, and price sticker on the box surface with sharp print edges and believable retail spacing.
8. Composition finish: keep both {피규어 스타일} and the package equally prominent, using layered depth, gentle shadows, and colorful merchandising accents rather than a flat empty backdrop.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: use Pretendard Bold for box titles, Pretendard Medium for secondary labels, compact Gothic-style text for warning and SKU lines, and a playful hand-drawn accent for small badge text; title size should feel like a premium retail package graphic.
- Color palette: {색감}; pastel pink, cherry blossom blush, cream white, mint blue, lavender, and coral accents with small metallic silver highlights on the foil bag and tag string.
- Graphic system: add rounded badge shapes, tiny star/sparkle icons, sticker-cut outlines, collector checklist thumbnails, and a price/barcode area that looks printed rather than floating.
- Shadow/rendering: apply a soft product-display shadow with 4px y-offset, 12px blur, and 15% opacity; keep edges crisp on the box window, barcode sticker, collector card, and figure silhouette.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: studio product photography look, shot with a Canon EOS R5 and RF 85mm f/1.2L at f/5.6 for crisp packaging detail and gentle depth separation.
- Lighting: large diffused softbox from upper-left at 45° with a faint fill from the right, plus a subtle rim light to define the clear window, foil bag wrinkles, acrylic riser edge, and vinyl contours.
- Color grade: pastel editorial grade with creamy whites, blush pinks, soft lavender shadows, clean mint accents, and polished retail-product contrast suitable for an Instagram shop post.

[6. MOOD]
Premium designer-toy catalog spread — a Kidrobot / Pop Mart showroom aesthetic with playful collectible merchandising precision, realistic Korean retail packaging, and the excitement of opening a new blind-box series.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: must render these strings exactly as printed on the package, sticker, or props:
  - “블라인드 ?”
  - “{시리즈명}”
  - “{태그라인}”
  - “{발매정보}”
  - “{가격표기}”
  - “{바코드번호}”
  - “{구성품문구}”
  - “{경고문구}”
  - “랜덤 1종”
  - “SECRET 1종”
  - “7세 이상”
- The figure must keep the exact cute vinyl collectible proportions: oversized head, small body, 7~10cm product scale impression.
- Box, figure, foil wrapper, collector card, sticker sheet, and tags must share one consistent illustration/rendering tone and the same pastel collectible aesthetic.
- Packaging print must remain readable, especially the title, badge, barcode, price sticker, age mark, and warning label.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or unauthorized likeness
- Unreadable or cropped required Korean package text

studio:prompts3:ours-078.content:
[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
한국 웹툰 일상 컷 변환용 i2i 프롬프트. 첨부된 일상 사진을 {변환 방향}에 맞춰 네이버웹툰·다음웹툰 풍의 세로형 한 컷 만화로 재해석하되, 실제 연재 에피소드의 한 장면처럼 인물 감정, 장소 정보, 말풍선, 효과음, 작은 캡션, 웹툰 화면 메타 요소까지 살아 있는 풍부한 컷으로 완성한다.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 중심 피사체는 사진 속 인물/장면을 그대로 유지하되, 웹툰 컷처럼 시선이 즉시 모이는 단일 세로 프레임으로 재구성한다.
- 배경은 원본 사진의 장소 윤곽을 보존하면서도 한국 웹툰식 선화와 색면으로 재해석한다. 카페라면 컵, 메뉴판, 테이블 질감, 창문 반사, 조명, 영수증, 냅킨, 의자 그림자를 살리고, 거리라면 간판, 보도블록, 전봇대, 버스 정류장 안내문, 사람 실루엣, 가게 스티커 등을 자연스럽게 넣는다.
- 인물 정체성, 구도, 핵심 소품, 배경 윤곽은 {보존 항목} 기준으로 유지한다.
- 전체 분위기와 컷의 감정선은 {분위기}를 중심으로 구성한다.
- 세로형 웹툰 캡처처럼 상단에는 작은 에피소드 라벨과 날짜/장소 정보, 중단에는 주 장면과 말풍선, 하단에는 짧은 감정 캡션과 다음 컷을 암시하는 여운을 배치한다.
- 장면 안에 자연스럽게 읽히는 생활 요소를 추가한다: 벽시계, 스마트폰 알림, 음료 라벨, 작은 스티커, 포스트잇, 빛 번짐, 책상 위 물건, 신발 그림자, 가방 키링, 창밖 간판, 종이컵 인쇄 글자 등 원본 장소에 맞는 소품을 웹툰풍으로 표현한다.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Full-frame conversion: 첨부 사진의 주요 구도를 유지하면서도 웹툰 1컷처럼 명확한 실루엣, 안정적인 시선 흐름, 완성된 배경 디테일을 가진 1024x1536 세로 패널로 재구성한다.
- Episode header: 화면 상단 한쪽에 {에피소드 라벨}, {날짜 라벨}, {시간대 라벨}을 작은 한국어 메타 텍스트로 넣어 실제 연재 컷처럼 보이게 한다.
- Location tag: 장면에 맞는 작은 위치 라벨 {장소 라벨}을 캡션 박스나 배경 표지판처럼 배치한다. 예: “서울, 망원동”, “집 앞 카페”, “학교 앞 골목”.
- Character rendering: 얼굴, 머리카락, 옷 주름, 손과 소품을 한국 웹툰 캐릭터 디자인 톤에 맞게 단순화하고, 표정과 포즈는 원본 사진의 개성을 보존한다. 눈빛, 입꼬리, 손동작, 어깨선 같은 감정 포인트는 또렷하게 살린다.
- Line treatment: {변환 효과}에 맞춰 외곽선은 선명하게, 내부 디테일은 웹툰식 펜선·잔선·하이라이트로 정리한다. 배경에는 얇은 보조선, 간단한 질감 패턴, 창문 반사선, 의류 주름선, 소품 윤곽선을 적절히 넣는다.
- Color treatment: 사진의 실제 색감을 유지하되, 부드러운 pastel flat colors와 제한된 팔레트로 통일해 웹툰 인쇄물 같은 완성도로 만든다. 포인트 소품이나 조명에는 원본 사진의 강조색을 1–2개 반영한다.
- Speech area: {주요 말풍선}을 상단 또는 인물 근처에 자연스럽게 배치한다. 말풍선은 짧고 생활감 있게 읽히도록 만들고, 작은 꼬리표, 손글씨 느낌의 효과음, 감탄 표시를 함께 넣을 수 있다.
- Caption area: 하단에는 {감정 캡션}을 작은 내레이션 박스로 넣고, 컷의 상황이 한눈에 이해되도록 사진의 분위기와 연결한다.
- Sound effects: 장면의 동작이나 감정에 맞춰 {효과음} 같은 짧은 한글 효과음을 넣는다. 예: “두근”, “힐끗”, “사각사각”, “톡”, “반짝”.
- Webtoon UI finishing: 얇은 웹툰 패널 프레임, 작은 {페이지 표시}, {작가 크레딧}, 하단의 {하단 문구}를 매우 작게 넣어 실제 웹툰 화면처럼 완성한다.
- Mood carryover: 원본 사진의 표정과 상황이 전달되도록 감정 포인트는 유지하되, 전체 결과는 {분위기}에 맞는 가벼운 일상 만화 톤으로 마감한다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Korean comic caption style, clean rounded sans-serif 느낌의 가독성 높은 한글 타이포. 말풍선은 얇고 균일한 검정 외곽선, 캡션은 14–20px 정도의 간결한 크기, 효과음은 손글씨풍 굵기 변화가 있는 한글 레터링으로 표현한다.
- Color palette: soft pastel flat colors, warm beige, muted peach, light sky blue, sage green, cool gray; 필요 시 원본 사진의 포인트 색을 1–2개 강조한다.
- Border/shadow: 얇은 검정 또는 짙은 회색 패널 선, 은은한 셀 셰이딩 그림자, 8–12% 불투명도의 약한 하이라이트, 캐릭터 아래 부드러운 접지 그림자, 사물 가장자리의 작은 빛 반사를 사용한다.
- Background detail: 원본 장소의 실제적인 생활 질감을 웹툰식으로 재해석한다. 나무결, 천 질감, 종이 포스터, 유리 반사, 타일 줄눈, 가방 장식, 책 표지, 음식 포장지, 메뉴판 가격표, 작은 안내 스티커 같은 요소가 장면을 풍부하게 만든다.
- Text hierarchy: 에피소드 라벨과 날짜는 작게, 말풍선은 가장 읽기 쉽게, 감정 캡션은 하단에서 차분하게 보이도록 크기와 굵기를 분리한다.
- Webtoon authenticity: 컷 안의 모든 한글은 실제 웹툰 캡처처럼 선명하고 자연스럽게 보여야 하며, 말풍선·캡션·배경 글자는 장면의 깊이에 맞춰 배치한다.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: medium smartphone snapshot perspective translated into a clean comic panel look, 35mm-equivalent feel, natural everyday framing without dramatic distortion.
- Lighting: soft diffused daylight 느낌으로 정리, 창가 자연광처럼 균일하고 그림자 대비가 과하지 않게 처리하되, 머리카락과 옷 가장자리에는 웹툰식 rim highlight를 추가한다.
- Color grade: gentle warm pastel grading with slightly desaturated highlights and clean skin tones, similar to a polished Korean webtoon episode screenshot.
- Rendering finish: crisp digital line art, smooth cel shading, subtle paper-like screen texture, tiny halftone dots in shadow areas, clean anti-aliased Korean text.

[6. MOOD]
Naver Webtoon / Daum Webtoon slice-of-life episode frame — quiet everyday warmth with polished digital comic clarity, small humorous details, readable in-scene Korean text, and believable daily-life atmosphere.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: {주요 말풍선}, {감정 캡션}, {에피소드 라벨}, {날짜 라벨}, {장소 라벨}, {효과음}, {작가 크레딧}, {하단 문구}에 포함되는 한글은 철자, 띄어쓰기, 조사까지 정확해야 한다.
- Render Korean in-image text clearly and naturally, such as “일상기록 EP. 12”, “2026.05.01”, “금요일 오후”, “서울, 망원동”, “잠깐만, 이거 좀 웃긴데?”, “오늘도 평범한 하루인 줄 알았다”, “두근”, “그림 @dailytoon”, “다음 컷에서 계속”.
- Preserve layout invariants: {보존 항목}에 포함된 인물 정체성·구도·핵심 소품·배경 윤곽을 유지하고, 원본의 상황 인지가 가능한 한 컷 구성을 유지한다.
- Follow {변환 방향} and {변환 효과} while keeping the image clearly readable as a finished Korean daily-life webtoon panel.
- Respect {금지} while keeping natural background details, props, captions, effect lettering, and webtoon UI-like elements that make the scene feel complete.
- The final image must clearly read as a Korean webtoon daily-life panel, not a simple photo filter.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Broken Korean characters or unreadable Hangul
- Fake official seals / certifications / government-like stamps
- Celebrity composites or implying a real celebrity cameo

studio:prompts3:ours-077.content:
[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Attached portrait photo transformation into a Joseon-era Korean historical drama character image, keeping the person recognizable while restyling clothing, setting, and cinematic tone.
Vertical full-body or half-body i2i result suitable for profile use, poster-style display, and social sharing, with a subtle period-drama portrait-card finish using the title and caption elements in {인물 호칭}, {촬영 표기}, and {캡션 문구}.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Main subject placement: single person centered in a 1024x1536 vertical frame, face occupying about 25–35% of image height, upper body clearly visible, with {변환 방향} guiding the overall historical re-styling.
- Identity retention: preserve the person’s facial identity, approximate hair color when possible, and original expression as specified by {보존 항목}, while adapting pose and costume naturally.
- Costume emphasis: render the clothing details described in {한복 디자인} with realistic textile folds, layered fabric depth, embroidered seams, collar overlap, sleeve weight, and period-appropriate silhouette.
- Background treatment: place the subject against {배경}, enriched with Joseon-era visual details such as wooden lattice doors, paper screen texture, stone courtyard floor, low ceramic vessel, seasonal branch shadows, silk curtain edges, or a faint oil-lamp glow when appropriate.
- Framing and spacing: keep an elegant portrait composition with the head ornament, shoulders, sleeves, and hands arranged naturally; allow robe drapery and background architecture to support the subject’s silhouette.
- Text placement: add a small cinematic portrait-card label using {인물 호칭}, {촬영 표기}, and {캡션 문구}; place it subtly near the lower-left or lower-right, integrated like a premium historical-drama still rather than a modern graphic poster.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- 1) Face and identity pass: keep the source face recognizable from {참고 이미지}, with natural skin texture, stable eye direction, and the same overall facial proportions.
- 2) Hair and head accessories: adapt the hairstyle to match the Joseon-era setting, integrating the hair treatment implied by {한복 디자인} with realistic strands, buns, gat straps, binyeo, daenggi, or traditional ornaments as appropriate.
- 3) Costume reconstruction: redraw the outfit from {한복 디자인} as authentic historical clothing, with accurate layer separation, sleeve drape, collar structure, waist tie tension, fabric weight, embroidery thread, and subtle wear from natural movement.
- 4) Background build: render {배경} as a soft, period-appropriate setting with muted tones, shallow depth separation, tactile paper grain, polished wood, aged stone, woven mat texture, and believable ambient props that would naturally belong in a Joseon portrait scene.
- 5) Cinematic finishing: apply the emotional tone in {분위기} through restrained contrast, film-like texture, creamy highlights, and a composed historical-drama atmosphere.
- 6) Portrait-card detailing: include a small Korean title/caption area with accurate text, date/location-style notation, and a subtle decorative stamp-like graphic motif that is clearly ornamental, not an official seal.
- 7) Constraint enforcement: avoid over-stylized fantasy edits; keep the portrait believable, dignified, and visually coherent from face to costume to setting.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: Korean text may appear as a subtle portrait-card overlay; use elegant serif-style Korean or neat Noto Serif KR / Noto Sans KR, 24–38px equivalent for the title, 16–22px equivalent for date/location and caption. Text must remain legible and correctly spelled.
- Color palette: use muted ivory, warm beige, charcoal black, deep indigo, subdued wine red, faded jade, natural wood brown, and soft paper-screen white; keep saturation moderate and film-like.
- Border/shadow: allow a thin hanji-paper edge texture, delicate vertical calligraphy guide line, or understated ornamental corner accent; use a subtle soft shadow around the subject separation only, about 4px y-offset, 14px blur, 12% opacity.
- Surface/detail quality: preserve realistic fabric weave, embroidery thread definition, hand-tied knots, paper grain, wood fibers, aged stone texture, and natural skin detail without plastic smoothing.
- Decorative graphics: use refined Joseon-inspired motifs such as cloud scrolls, plum blossom silhouettes, faint ink-wash brush texture, or a small ornamental red square mark that does not resemble an official seal.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 85mm portrait lens, f/2.0, shallow depth of field, full-frame look for a refined studio-portrait-meets-period-drama result.
- Lighting: soft window light from upper-left at about 45°, with gentle fill from front-right and a faint rim on the hairline, shoulder edge, hair ornament, and layered sleeve folds.
- Color grade: cinematic historical-drama grade with slightly desaturated shadows, creamy highlights, subtle indigo/wine accents, fine film grain, and a gentle warm-to-cool balance inspired by Korean film stills.
- Depth and realism: subject should feel physically present in the space, with contact shadows on the floor or seat, fabric gravity responding to posture, and background elements softly blurred rather than flattened.

[6. MOOD]
A restrained Korean sageuk film still — the composed, dignified atmosphere of historical drama portraits such as 관상, 사도, and 서편제, enriched with tactile hanji, wood, textile, and courtyard details for a realistic period-photo impression.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: render the visible text exactly as “{인물 호칭}”, “{촬영 표기}”, and “{캡션 문구}” if included; no misspellings, random syllables, or broken Hangul.
- Preserve the subject’s identity from the reference photo as much as possible, including facial structure, expression, and general likeness.
- If a male subject is detected, use the male Hanbok variant described in {한복 디자인}; if female, use the female Hanbok variant described in {한복 디자인}.
- Keep the image photorealistic and historically plausible, with accurate garment layering, natural fabric gravity, and dignified coverage.
- The portrait may include realistic Joseon-era atmosphere details such as 한옥 창살, 장지문, 돌마당, 청사초롱, 매화 가지, 도자기, 비단 주름, 먹빛 그림자, or 낮은 목가구.
- Use the caption as a tasteful drama-still element, for example: “{인물 호칭}”, “{촬영 표기}”, “{캡션 문구}”.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- fake official seals, certification marks, government emblems, or authoritative document stamps
- broken Korean characters, garbled Hangul, random pseudo-Korean text
- celebrity face composites or replacing the reference identity with a famous actor
- cartoonish/anime-style identity transformation

studio:prompts3:ours-076.content:
[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1536

[1. PURPOSE]
Korean studio-style profile portrait transformation for a business headshot, designed for LinkedIn, company bio, personal branding, and a polished portfolio profile card.
Vertical editorial portrait with realistic studio polish, using the attached selfie or daily photo as the identity base while adding tasteful Korean profile-card details.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- {변환 방향} should read as a refined Korean studio profile portrait, with the subject occupying roughly 62% of the frame and centered slightly above the vertical midpoint.
- Keep {보존 항목} strictly intact, while the background becomes a premium monochrome Korean studio backdrop with a soft gray-to-ivory gradient, faint paper-sweep texture, subtle vignette, and realistic light falloff.
- Pose framing: chest-up to just above the head, slight 3/4 angle, eyes looking directly at camera, shoulders relaxed and squared for a professional headshot feel.
- Outfit should be automatically restyled into a crisp white shirt or a clean casual blazer, with a neat collar line, natural fabric grain, realistic seams, and lightly pressed wrinkles.
- Add a refined lower profile-card band near the bottom edge: small Korean name/role credit, date/location label, and understated decorative tags, designed like a modern Korean studio proof sheet without covering the face.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1. Face and identity block: preserve the original facial structure, eye shape, smile tension, and hairstyle from {보존 항목}, with realistic skin pores, natural asymmetry, and believable complexion variation kept visible.
2. Studio conversion layer: apply {변환 효과} as a polished portrait treatment, including a seamless gray or ivory paper backdrop with subtle canvas/paper texture, gentle shadow behind the shoulders, and a faint curved sweep at the lower background.
3. Lighting setup: build a soft front-lit key light with a gentle fill from the opposite side, producing controlled shadows under the jawline and nose, natural cheek definition, and refined catchlights.
4. Composition refinement: follow {구도} so the head has balanced space at the top, the shoulders taper naturally, and the subject has realistic separation from the background through rim light and depth.
5. Profile-card details: include small, tasteful Korean studio metadata in the lower band such as “PROFILE 2026”, “서울 스튜디오”, “비즈니스 프로필”, and “촬영일 2026.05.01”, plus tiny save/share-style micro icons or dot dividers.
6. Finish and quality pass: render {품질} with natural catchlights, subtle skin smoothing only, crisp fabric detail on the shirt or blazer, clean hair-edge rendering, and high-resolution editorial sharpness.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: include small modern Korean typography only in the lower profile-card area; use clean sans-serif type, accurate Hangul, restrained tracking, and a premium studio proof-sheet feeling.
- Required visible Korean text examples: “PROFILE 2026”, “서울 스튜디오”, “비즈니스 프로필”, “촬영일 2026.05.01”, “개인 브랜딩 촬영”.
- Color palette: soft gray, ivory, off-white, muted taupe, neutral beige, subtle charcoal shadows, warm natural skin tones, and a small muted navy or graphite accent for the profile-card text.
- Graphic treatment: use a slim translucent lower band, tiny dot dividers, small caption blocks, and very subtle studio-card decoration that supports the portrait without overpowering it.
- Border/shadow: allow a soft editorial card edge or gentle printed-photo shadow if it makes the image feel like a premium studio profile deliverable.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame 85mm f/1.8 portrait lens, studio headshot framing, shallow depth of field with sharp focus on eyes.
- Lighting: soft diffused front key light at 20–30° above eye level, mild fill from camera-right, faint rim separation from camera-left, smooth catchlights in both eyes, and a believable studio shadow gradient on the backdrop.
- Color grade: clean editorial neutral grade with slightly warm skin tones, restrained contrast, desaturated background tones, and subtle filmic depth in the shadows.
- Realism details: natural skin texture, fine flyaway hairs, fabric weave, collar stitching, realistic neck shadow, delicate lip texture, and true optical depth rather than airbrushed flattening.

[6. MOOD]
Premium Korean studio portrait — akin to a modern LinkedIn headshot and personal branding profile card shot in a high-end Seoul studio, professional, approachable, confident, and editorially polished.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: all visible Korean must be legible and correctly spelled, especially “서울 스튜디오”, “비즈니스 프로필”, “촬영일 2026.05.01”, and “개인 브랜딩 촬영”.
- Preserve the subject’s identity from the reference image, including facial proportions, hairstyle silhouette, expression nuance, age impression, and natural facial asymmetry.
- Hands should not be prominently visible; if any part of the hands enters frame, anatomy must be natural and correct.
- Maintain a realistic, professional headshot look without beauty-app exaggeration, plastic skin, cartoon-like smoothing, or changing the person into a different identity.
- Keep all profile-card graphics secondary to the portrait; the face must remain the clear focal point.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

studio:prompts3:ours-075.content:
[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
1990년대 한국 일회용 필름 카메라와 VHS 노스탤지어를 재현하는 i2i 사진 변환 프롬프트.
첨부 사진의 인물 정체성, 구도, 시선, 핵심 분위기를 유지하면서 {변환 방향}의 질감으로 바꾸어, 실제 오래된 앨범이나 서랍 속 사진 봉투에서 꺼낸 듯한 소셜 공유용 정사각 이미지로 완성한다. 단순 필터가 아니라 인화지 질감, 스캔 흔적, 사진관 출력 코드, 생활감 있는 배경 디테일, 날짜 스탬프, 아주 작은 손때와 보관 흔적까지 자연스럽게 포함된 90년대 개인 스냅사진처럼 보이게 한다.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- 중심 인물은 {보존 항목}을 유지해 원본과 같은 사람으로 읽히게 하고, 얼굴·몸의 비율, 표정, 시선 방향, 손의 위치, 주요 포즈는 원본을 우선 보존한다.
- 배경은 원본 배경을 기반으로 하되, {장소 힌트}에 어울리는 1990년대 한국 스냅사진의 생활 디테일을 자연스럽게 살린다. 예: 벽지 무늬, 커튼 주름, 플라스틱 의자, 골목 간판, 카페 테이블, 오래된 컵, 방 안 소품, 형광등 반사, 아파트 베란다 창틀, 문방구 스티커, 여행지 안내판, 식탁 위 물건.
- 화면 전체는 1:1 프레이밍을 유지하며, 오래된 4x6 인화 사진을 정사각으로 스캔한 듯한 느낌을 준다. 사진 가장자리에는 살짝 누렇게 변한 인화지 여백, 미세한 종이 휘어짐, 모서리 눌림, 흐린 그림자가 보인다.
- 변환 톤은 {변환 방향}에 맞춰 전체 색감과 질감을 바꾸되, 원본의 핵심 인물 정보와 사진의 주요 사건성은 훼손하지 않는다.
- 사진 가장자리나 하단 여백에 {사진관 출력 코드} 같은 작은 출력 흔적을 넣어 실제 현상소에서 받은 사진처럼 만든다.
- 오른쪽 아래에는 {날짜 스탬프}가 작은 빨간 LCD 인쇄처럼 들어가며, 빛 번짐과 필름 입자 때문에 아주 살짝 퍼져 보인다.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Base layer: 첨부된 {참고 이미지}의 인물 정체성과 구도를 그대로 유지하고, 원본의 핵심 디테일은 필름 입자 속에서도 알아볼 수 있게 남긴다.
- Film texture layer: 전체 화면에 {변환 효과}를 적용해 90년대 필름 특유의 거친 입자감, 낮은 대비, 약간의 색 틀어짐, 현상된 필름 표면의 작은 먼지, 스캔 노이즈, 가벼운 압축감이 생기게 한다.
- Color treatment layer: 하이라이트는 따뜻하게 날리고, 그림자는 살짝 떠 보이게 처리해 인화 사진처럼 미세하게 바랜 느낌을 준다. 피부와 의상은 원본을 보존하되, 따뜻한 크림색과 faded amber 톤이 얇게 덮인 것처럼 보이게 한다.
- Environment memory layer: 원본에 존재하는 소품과 배경 질감을 90년대 생활 사진처럼 더 촉각적으로 보이게 한다. 낡은 나무결, 플라스틱 광택, 종이 포스터, 천 커튼, 벽지 패턴, 카세트/VHS 시대의 색감, 형광등 아래의 녹색 기운이 자연스럽게 섞인다.
- Edge artifacts layer: 프레임 주변에 은은한 light leak, 약한 motion blur, 모서리 색 번짐, 미세한 렌즈 플레어, 필름 게이트에서 생긴 듯한 가장자리 흔들림을 더해 즉석카메라/캠코더 출력물 같은 불완전함을 살린다.
- Print detail layer: 인화지 테두리 안쪽 또는 하단 여백에 {사진관 출력 코드}를 아주 작게 넣는다. 예: Korean text "현상 96-08", "서울", "FILM 24", "우리동네사진관". 중심 인물보다 훨씬 작고 사진 부가 정보처럼 보여야 한다.
- Timestamp layer: {날짜 스탬프}를 우하단에 작은 빨간 LCD 스타일로 배치해 실제 90년대 날짜 인화 느낌을 완성한다. 예시로 "1996 SUMMER", "96 08 17", "1997.05.03", "96 여름" 같은 짧은 표기감을 유지한다.
- Album feel layer: 사진 모서리에 아주 희미한 압착 자국, 접힌 듯한 종이 질감, 스캐너 유리 위의 작은 먼지 점, 오래된 앨범 비닐에 눌린 듯한 미세한 광택, 손가락으로 만진 듯한 희미한 얼룩을 더한다.
- Caption trace layer: 사진 뒷면 메모가 비쳐 보이거나 가장자리 스캔에 걸린 듯한 작은 손글씨 느낌의 {앨범 메모}를 희미하게 넣을 수 있다. 예: "수학여행", "방학날", "종로에서".
- Cleanup control: {금지}에 해당하는 현대적 정교함은 피하고, 필름 특유의 유기적인 흔들림, 색 번짐, 인화지 질감, 생활감 있는 배경, 실제 스캔 사진 같은 부드러운 해상도를 남긴다.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: 날짜 스탬프는 LCD 디지털 숫자 스타일에 맞춰 작고 또렷하게, 본문 텍스트가 아니라 카메라가 직접 인쇄한 사진 오버레이처럼 처리한다. 붉은색 또는 주황빛 빨강으로 살짝 번진 인쇄감을 준다.
- Micro typography: 사진관 출력 코드나 하단 여백의 작은 표기는 실제 스캔된 인화 사진의 부가 정보처럼 보이게 하며, 읽히더라도 매우 짧은 Korean text만 사용한다. 예: "서울 1996", "여름", "현상 24컷", "동네사진관", "재인화".
- Handwritten detail: {앨범 메모}는 볼펜이나 네임펜으로 적은 듯한 흐릿한 손글씨 느낌이며, 사진 내용보다 앞서 보이지 않게 가장자리나 여백에 작게 배치한다.
- Color palette: warm faded yellow, slightly desaturated green, muted beige, dusty brown, soft red timestamp, washed-out black, pale cyan shadow, cream paper white.
- Border/shadow: 인화지 가장자리는 약한 off-white border와 3px 정도의 흐린 그림자, 8%~12% opacity 수준으로 넣고, 종이 표면의 미세한 얼룩과 누런 가장자리 변색을 더한다.
- Texture behavior: 필름 그레인, 먼지, 스크래치, VHS식 색 흔들림은 사진 전체에 균일하게만 얹지 말고 하이라이트, 피부 주변, 흰 벽, 가장자리, 어두운 그림자에서 서로 다른 강도로 느껴지게 만든다.
- Authenticity: 현대 앱 필터처럼 선명한 프리셋 효과가 아니라, 실제 현상·보관·스캔 과정을 거친 사진처럼 색의 불균형과 물리적 질감이 섞이게 한다.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: 35mm disposable film camera look, fixed-lens snapshot aesthetic, 28mm plastic lens feel, built-in flash falloff, scanned print appearance, 약한 ISO 800~1600 film grain.
- Lighting: 원본 조명을 유지하되, 전체 톤은 overcast diffused light처럼 부드럽고, 하이라이트는 조금 번지게 처리한다. 실내라면 형광등의 녹색 기운과 플래시 반사를 약하게 살리고, 야외라면 흐린 하늘 아래 바랜 햇빛처럼 표현한다.
- Color grade: VHS nostalgia grade — warm cream + faded amber + muted olive + low-contrast cyan suppression.
- Realism details: 피부 질감, 의상 주름, 머리카락, 배경의 작은 물체는 필름 그레인 속에서도 자연스럽게 남아 있어야 하며, 오래된 사진의 초점 흔들림과 실제 스캔 해상도의 부드러움이 공존해야 한다.
- Print simulation: photo paper surface, tiny dust specks, faint roller marks, uneven scan exposure, slightly curled paper edge, mild chromatic misregistration.

[6. MOOD]
1990년대 한국 스냅사진과 VHS 테이프 캡처가 섞인 사적인 추억 앨범 느낌 — NewJeans 초기 레트로 무드와 90s family photo scan aesthetic. 방학, 동네 골목, 수학여행, 생일 파티, 오래된 카페, 집 안 거실, 아파트 놀이터, 버스 정류장, 바닷가 민박집에서 우연히 찍힌 사진처럼 친근하고 진짜 같은 공기를 만든다. 사진 속 세계가 꾸며진 세트가 아니라 당시의 생활 속 한 장면처럼 보여야 한다.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: 반드시 우하단에 작은 빨간 LCD 날짜 스탬프가 보여야 하며, 예시 형식은 "1996 SUMMER", "96 08 17", "1997.05.03", "96 여름"처럼 90년대 날짜 표기 느낌을 유지한다.
- Korean micro text must be clean and natural: tiny photo-lab or album details may include "서울 1996", "여름", "현상 24컷", "우리동네사진관", "수학여행", "방학날". 깨지지 않은 자연스러운 한글이어야 한다.
- 원본 인물의 정체성, 표정, 구도, 복장은 {보존 항목} 기준으로 유지한다.
- 전체 결과는 90년대 필름 사진처럼 보여야 하며, 현대적 디지털 보정 티가 나면 안 된다.
- {변환 방향}, {변환 효과}, {날짜 스탬프}, {사진관 출력 코드}, {앨범 메모}, {금지}의 의도를 반영하되, 실제 오래된 인화 사진에서 볼 수 있는 빛샘, 먼지, 스캔 흔적, 생활감 있는 배경 질감은 자연스럽게 포함한다.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- 가짜 공식 인증 마크나 실제 기관 인증처럼 보이는 seal/certification
- 깨진 한글 문자
- 유명인 합성 또는 무단 초상권을 암시하는 celebrity composite

studio:prompts3:ours-074.content:
[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Attached room photo transformed into a 1:6 scale LED miniature box diorama image.
Create a photorealistic closed-cube miniature scene that preserves the original interior layout while making it feel like a premium handcrafted display model photographed in a dark studio exhibit.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- The attached {참고 이미지} becomes the full scene reference; keep the original room’s furniture arrangement, key props, wall/floor relationship, and interior color balance visually recognizable.
- Follow {변환 방향} while converting the room into a contained miniature cube with a visible front cutaway, thick model-board walls, realistic depth, and readable interior layers.
- Compose the diorama as a museum-style boxed model occupying most of the square frame, with the interior warmly lit and the surrounding studio space falling into a deep charcoal-black exhibition void.
- Use a slightly elevated front isometric 3/4 angle, with the box face readable, the back wall visible, and furniture scale cues clear through the cutaway front.
- Include believable miniature construction details: tiny panel seams, mitered corner edges, LED strip channel, small screw heads, fine craft-paper texture, subtle dust specks, and a black display plinth beneath the box.
- Add a tiny front exhibit plaque on the plinth, rendered cleanly in Korean: “1:6 룸 디오라마” and “LED 전시 모델”, with a small date mark “2026.05”.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Outer frame: show the diorama sitting in a dark studio display environment according to {외부 처리}, with a faint tabletop/plinth reflection, soft edge glow, and only enough surrounding darkness to emphasize the cube silhouette.
- Box shell: render the miniature enclosure as a closed cube made from matte black MDF, acrylic-like side thickness, and warm beige interior wall panels; show realistic edges, seams, bevels, tiny nail points, and hand-built scale-model craftsmanship.
- Interior scene: preserve {보존 항목} exactly as the spatial backbone of the room, maintaining relative positions, object sizes, wall openings, furniture grouping, and proportions of major items from the reference image.
- Transformation layer: apply {변환 효과} so the room reads as a handcrafted miniature display, with softened model-scale materials, crisp tiny edges, convincing miniature depth, faint adhesive seams, and tactile surface grain.
- Lighting layer: install warm yellow LED strip illumination along the ceiling line and upper side edges, creating soft highlights on walls, furniture tops, floor edges, and small reflective surfaces; show a tiny visible LED diffuser strip where natural.
- Detail layer: add realistic miniature-photo cues such as shallow micro-shadows under furniture legs, delicate floor joins, small cable routing hidden along the top rear corner, tiny brackets, and a subtle acrylic front-edge reflection.
- View layer: match {시점} so the model is seen from an informative angle that reveals the front plane, side wall thickness, floor depth, back wall, and the preserved room layout.
- Final integration: make the entire interior feel like it belongs inside a curated diorama exhibit, with the warm room glowing inside the dark box and the exterior treated as a premium studio product photograph.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: preserve any text already visible in the source image; additionally render the small front plaque text exactly as “1:6 룸 디오라마”, “LED 전시 모델”, and “2026.05” in a clean engraved sans-serif style, scaled naturally to the model.
- Color palette: preserve the source room’s original color palette as the base interior palette, then add warm LED amber, soft tungsten yellow, charcoal black exterior, muted beige craft-board tones, acrylic edge highlights, and subtle wood-brown shadows.
- Materials: emphasize realistic miniature materials — matte model board, slightly satin acrylic edges, painted wood grain, paper-thin wall panels, tiny fabric texture on furnishings, and fine dust visible in the LED glow.
- Border/shadow: use soft studio shadowing around the cube, with a gentle 4px y-offset and 14px blur, plus a faint rim highlight on the box corners and a low reflection on the black plinth.
- Scale realism: make furniture and props look like carefully reduced handmade objects rather than full-size items; edges may be slightly thicker, textures slightly simplified, and lighting slightly theatrical like a display case.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: full-frame digital camera look, 50mm lens at f/8, crisp miniature-architecture photography with deep detail across the scene.
- Lighting: overhead warm LED strip light inside the box, complemented by low-intensity ambient fill from the front, small specular glints on acrylic and screw heads, while the exterior remains mostly unlit and nearly black.
- Color grade: warm amber interior against deep black surroundings, with slightly desaturated real-world furnishings so the miniature effect feels convincing rather than toy-like.
- Rendering quality: photorealistic macro product photography, clean depth clarity, accurate contact shadows, physically coherent perspective, and tactile handcrafted surface detail.

[6. MOOD]
Premium handcrafted scale-model photography — like a museum-quality LED room diorama featured in a high-end design editorial, intimate, warm, precise, and carefully made.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: the added plaque must read exactly “1:6 룸 디오라마”, “LED 전시 모델”, and “2026.05”; any Korean text already present in the reference image must remain legible and not become broken characters.
- Preserve the original room’s furniture placement, key props, wall/floor geometry, and interior color relationship as the visual basis of the miniature.
- The image must clearly read as a boxed 1:6 LED diorama, not a normal room photo; visible wall thickness, plinth, cube shell, LED strip, and miniature construction details are essential.
- Keep the room geometry physically coherent; walls, floor, ceiling, and objects must align cleanly within the box, with natural shadows and believable scale-model proportions.
- Maintain the requested {시점}, {변환 방향}, {변환 효과}, {보존 항목}, and {외부 처리} while enriching the scene with realistic exhibit and craft details.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters

[INPUT]
- reference_image: {참고 이미지}
- language: Korean
- output_size: 1024x1024

[1. PURPOSE]
Transform the attached person photo into a polished 3D animated character portrait, keeping the subject recognizable while shifting the look into a family-friendly feature-animation aesthetic.
Designed for i2i character conversion use, with a square composition that feels like a Pixar / Disney-style movie still and a finished social-profile portrait.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Center the subject as a half-body or chest-up hero portrait occupying about 65% of the frame, with the face clearly readable at first glance.
- Preserve {보존 항목} exactly enough that the person remains identifiable after stylization.
- Apply {변환 방향} as the primary style direction, while keeping proportions balanced, appealing, and expressive rather than exaggerated.
- Use {배경} as a softly stylized 3D environment that supports the character: include believable depth, gentle light falloff, and a few natural background details translated from the original photo.
- Add a small, elegant profile-card style label in the lower corner with {날짜 라벨}, {장소 라벨}, and a short caption {캡션 문구}; keep it secondary and integrated like a tasteful character poster tag.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
1) Subject conversion layer: Rebuild the attached person as a 3D animated character with smooth geometry, gentle facial planes, and readable expression while preserving the original identity cues.
2) Facial feature treatment: Keep the eyes slightly larger in a natural animation proportion, with soft cheeks, clean nose bridge, and a friendly mouth shape; do not distort the face into caricature.
3) Hair / glasses / clothing retention: Match the original hairstyle, eyeglasses, expression, and outfit details from {보존 항목}, then translate them into a tidy 3D material style with believable fabric folds, seams, buttons, knit texture, hair volume, and subtle strand grouping where visible.
4) Rendering finish: Apply {변환 효과} with glossy but controlled shading, rounded highlights, and subtle subsurface scattering on skin for a polished animated-film look.
5) Background conversion: Reinterpret the original surroundings into {배경}, using depth separation, soft blur on distant elements, and simplified but recognizable props such as a warm window glow, desk item, plant, wall art, café light, street bokeh, or room detail when appropriate to the source image.
6) Profile detail layer: Add tiny decorative tags {장식 태그} near the lower label, plus a soft rounded rectangle backing plate, miniature dot separators, and a small camera/date icon motif rendered as simple shapes.
7) Image integrity: Keep the same person, same general pose, and same framing logic from the input photo unless a small composition cleanup is needed for better character readability.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: if text is added, use clean readable Korean sans-serif lettering; label text must remain small, sharp, and secondary to the character.
- Rendered text content: lower-corner label should read exactly “{날짜 라벨} · {장소 라벨}” and “{캡션 문구}”, with optional tag text “{장식 태그}”.
- Color palette: warm cinematic tones inspired by amber, peach, cream, soft teal, and muted blue-gray; if source colors conflict, preserve identity-critical colors first and stylize the rest.
- Materials: skin should feel soft and luminous, hair should have molded animated-film volume, clothing should show stylized fabric texture, and glasses or accessories should have believable transparent/reflection behavior.
- Border/shadow: soft ambient occlusion under the chin and around the shoulders, plus a gentle 8px y-offset drop shadow with 18% opacity to separate the figure from the background.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: medium portrait framing, 85mm f/1.8 equivalent, shallow depth of field, subject-facing angle with minimal perspective distortion.
- Lighting: warm key light from upper-left at about 45°, subtle fill from front-right, and a soft rim light to carve the silhouette; keep skin highlights smooth and controlled.
- Color grade: Pixar-style warm highlights, creamy midtones, slightly cool shadows, and clean saturation without neon intensity.
- Surface detail: high-quality 3D render, soft subsurface skin, rounded specular highlights, clean contact shadows, fine fabric weave where clothing is close to camera, and cinematic bokeh in the background.

[6. MOOD]
Premium animated character portrait — like a high-end Pixar feature still with a polished Disney character turnaround feel, enhanced with a warm personal profile-card detail that makes it feel ready for a social avatar or keepsake poster.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: render the visible Korean label exactly as “{날짜 라벨} · {장소 라벨}”, “{캡션 문구}”, and “{장식 태그}” if included.
- Preserve the subject’s recognizable identity cues from the source photo, especially hairstyle, eyeglasses, facial expression, and clothing silhouette.
- Keep the output as a 3D animated character conversion, not a realistic photo retouch.
- Maintain anatomically correct facial proportions and natural pose structure.
- Make the environment feel lived-in and cinematic while keeping the person as the clear focal character.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Celebrity composites or impersonation of a real public figure
- Low-poly, flat 2D illustration, or photorealistic retouch that breaks the 3D animated character conversion

studio:prompts3:ours-072.content:
[INPUT]

- language: Korean

[1. PURPOSE]
Convert the attached photo into a Korean Pixiv-style citypop illustration portrait, keeping the subject recognizable while replacing raw photographic realism with polished anime rendering and a lively social portrait-card presentation.
Designed for i2i use as a shareable character-art transformation: the person remains the clear focus, while the surrounding layout gains realistic Korean social-post details, subtle stickers, date/location labels, and citypop graphic accents.

[2. OBJECT & COMPOSITION]
- Preserve the original subject’s identity, pose, composition, and clothing silhouette using {보존 항목} as the non-negotiable layout anchor.
- Keep the main subject dominant in frame, with the body and face proportions matching the source image and the original crop respected.
- Apply {변환 방향} as the overall art direction, while preserving the silhouette and spatial relationships from the source.
- Use {참고 이미지} as the visual base; retain key facial landmarks, hairstyle outline, hand position, and outfit outline, but re-render everything in illustration form.
- Enrich the square frame as a Korean Pixiv / citypop portrait card: add a tasteful top label reading “K-PIXIV CITYPOP”, a small date/location tag such as “2026.05 · 서울”, a short caption sticker “오늘의 무드”, and 2–3 small decorative tags like “#시티팝”, “#일러스트변환”, “SAVE”.
- Add small social-card details near the edge: a tiny handle such as “@my_pixiv.kr”, micro save/share icons, a small credit line “illust remake / model reference”, and soft geometric citypop accents that frame the subject without covering the face.

[3. CORE STRUCTURE]
- Base layer: rebuild the entire image as a clean 2D illustration, replacing raw photographic depth cues with confident anime cel shapes while retaining recognizable lighting and spatial placement from the reference.
- Subject rendering: draw the face, hair, skin, and clothing with smooth contour lines, simplified planes, expressive eyes, and carefully shaped highlights, while keeping the original likeness and pose intact.
- Color blocking: apply {변환 효과} across the full image, using large flat tone regions supported by small accent gradients in the background graphics.
- Texture pass: add {질감} to lines and shading so the result feels like a polished Pixiv-subculture illustration printed on a matte social card, with faint paper grain and soft scan-like warmth.
- Background and layout pass: translate the original background into a stylized citypop environment or graphic backdrop, adding believable details such as window-light shapes, neon sign fragments, cassette/star/sun motifs, subtle Korean label stickers, and layered translucent color panels.
- Final correction: ensure {금지} is fully avoided while maintaining the subject’s recognizable identity, natural expression, and original outfit silhouette.

[4. STYLE RULES]
- Typography: include small, readable Korean design text as part of the portrait-card layout. Use a Noto Sans KR-like sans serif style for labels and a slightly rounded bold Korean display style for one short caption sticker. Keep text crisp and correctly formed.
- Render visible Korean text examples: “오늘의 무드”, “서울 · 2026.05”, “#시티팝”, “#픽시브풍”, “@my_pixiv.kr”. If source text exists, preserve it where appropriate and integrate it into the illustration.
- Color palette: cream #F4E7D3, coral #F07F76, teal #67B7B0, soft peach #F6B89A, muted navy #2E3A57; keep saturation moderate and use matte finishes.
- Border/shadow: use illustration-friendly separation with soft contour shadow at 12% opacity, layered sticker shadows, small tape-label shapes, thin frame lines, and citypop graphic panels that make the card feel designed and complete.
- Details: add small but plausible social-post UI marks, decorative sparkles, tiny arrows, rounded caption chips, and subtle paper-print texture while keeping the face and upper body visually dominant.

[5. VISUAL STYLE]
- Camera / lens: reinterpret as a 50mm portrait photo translated into a flat illustration, with no visible lens distortion and no depth-of-field blur.
- Lighting: emulate gentle overcast daylight translated into even cel-shading, with a soft highlight from upper-left and a restrained shadow falloff.
- Color grade: matte citypop palette with cream, coral, and teal tones, slightly faded like a vintage Japanese pop illustration scan.
- Finish: crisp digital line art, layered cel shadows, smooth hair highlights, gentle blush tones, graphic poster-card layout, and faint matte paper grain that adds tactility.

[6. MOOD]
Korean Pixiv x citypop illustration — a polished subculture portrait with clean anime rendering, vintage pop color treatment, and a lively square social-card design that feels ready to post.

[7. CRITICAL]
- Korean text accuracy: must preserve the following verbatim Korean strings if any text is present in the source and should remain readable: "한국 픽시브·시티팝 풍 일러스트", "인물 정체성·포즈·구도·복장 윤곽", "flat anime cel-shading, 매트한 페이드 톤(크림·코랄·청록), 픽시브 서브컬처 일러스트 화풍", "clean line art + 부드러운 flat color, no pointillism, no halftone", "사진 같은 photo-realism, over-stylized 만화화, 인물 외형 변경".
- Add readable Korean portrait-card text where it fits the composition: “오늘의 무드”, “서울 · 2026.05”, “#시티팝”, “#일러스트변환”, “@my_pixiv.kr”. Keep every Korean character clean, complete, and legible.
- Keep facial identity, pose, framing, and outfit outline consistent with {보존 항목}; do not change the subject’s body type, age impression, or gender presentation.
- Render as a fully illustrated image with clean line art, flat color planes, expressive anime-style facial detail, and matte citypop graphic design.

[8. 🚫 PROHIBITED]
- Fake official seals / certifications
- Broken Korean characters
- Unauthorized celebrity composites or public-figure likeness if not present in the reference
